name: Midback Series Circles Outward
steps: Lay flat on carriage, legs in tabletop position.
Start with arms up toward ceiling.
Bring arms to your sides, then out to a t-pose, then back to start position.

name: Kettlebell Alternating Row
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell in one hand.
Bend at hips, row kettlebell to chest.
Alternate hands for each row.

name: Single Leg Balance 2
steps: Stand upright with a braced core.
Choose the supporting leg and shift your weight on that, while lifting the other slightly off the ground.
Try to maintain your balance while bouncing a tennis ball off the wall or ground.

name: Kettlebell Shrug
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hold one kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Lift your shoulders upward while keeping arms straight.
Lower shoulders back down, repeat for desired reps.

name: Dumbbell Concentration Curl
steps: Sit on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back straight.
Lean forward and place your elbow on the inside of your leg.
Curl the dumbbell while keeping your elbow against your leg. Make sure to fully extend your elbow on each rep.

name: Bodyweight Feet Down Russian Twist
steps: Sit with feet on floor, lean back slightly, and clasp hands at chest.
Rotate torso to one side without lifting feet.
Twist to opposite side, keeping core tight and movement controlled.

name: Weighted Chin Ups
steps: Grab the bar shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you). Use a dip belt and the let the weight hang between your legs.
With your body hanging and arms fully extended, pull yourself up until your chin is past the bar.
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.

name: Cat Pose
steps: Begin on your hands and knees with your wrists directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
Inhale and arch your back, lifting your tailbone and head towards the ceiling, while lowering your belly towards the floor.
Exhale and round your spine, tucking your chin towards your chest, and bringing your tailbone towards your knees.
Repeat these movements, flowing smoothly between the two poses, for several breaths.

name: Kettlebell High Incline Bench Press
steps: Position the bench between
and
degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground.
Lower the kettlebells to your mid chest
Raise the kettlebells (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

name: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
flex your knees and hips and sit back into the squat while lowering your body
Continue down to full depth
Return to starting position.

name: Gironda Chin Up
steps: Grab the bar shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you)
With your body hanging and arms fully extended, pull yourself up and lean backwards. Try to touch your chest to the bar.
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.

name: Dumbbell Long Lever Russian Twist
steps: Start by sitting on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground. Hold a dumbbell in both hands with your arms extended straight in front of you.
Twist your torso to the right, bringing the dumbbell towards the ground, then return to the center. Repeat on the left side, twisting to the left and bringing the dumbbell towards the ground.
Continue this twisting motion, alternating sides, for the desired number of repetitions. Keep your core engaged and avoid swinging your arms to generate momentum.

name: Cardio Row Erg Rower Four Stroke Sprint Start
steps: Sit on seat, feet strapped in, grip handle with arms extended.
Push with legs, lean back slightly. Do four small pulls with increasing distance on each rep.
Extend arms, lean forward from hips, bend knees to return to start.

name: Cable Half Kneeling High To Low Wood Chopper
steps: Set the cable just over your head. Take a half kneeling position. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

name: Cable Internal Rotation
steps: Stand tall, hold the cable handle with a neutral grip, your elbow should be at a
degree angle.
Rotate your shoulder by bringing your forearm across your body.

name: Frog Crunch
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands behind head.
Crunch up, flexing the spine and your abs.

name: Cable Goblet Squat
steps: Start with a straight bar or easy bar attachment .
Get your elbows directly underneath the bar, squat straight up and then walk back a few steps.
Break at your knees and hips to initiate the squat. Make sure you maintain a flat back.
Squat all the way back to a standing position.

name: Cardio Quick Feet
steps: Quickly tap each foot to the ground.

name: Back Rowing Preps Airplane Seated
steps: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps at shoulder height.
Start with arms forward, palms facing forward, shoulders relaxed.
Pull arms out to a T, squeezing upper back without leaning.
Return slowly to start, maintaining upright posture and controlled tension.

name: Reverse Expansion Teardrops Inward Kneeling
steps: Kneel tall facing straps, arms slightly forward and elevated.
Initiate movement from shoulder blades, drawing arms inward and down.
Create small teardrop shape, keeping neck relaxed.
Return to start smoothly, maintaining continuous tension.

name: Dumbbell Seated Rear Delt Fly
steps: With dumbbells in either hand, bend your knees with your feet slightly bowed out. Arch your back above your knees, and start with the weights touching in front of your chest.
With bent elbows, raise your arms up to shoulder level, pausing at the at the end of the motion.
Slowly lower your arms back to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Seated Y Press
steps: Sit on an upright bench , grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Press the dumbbells outward into a y shape.

name: Pilates Single Leg Heel
steps: Lie on reformer, one heel on footbar, other leg extended.
Press carriage out using working leg.
Keep hips level and core engaged.
Bend knee to return with control.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Forward Lunge
steps: Hold kettlebell in front rack position.
Step forward, lunge. Bringing your back knee to the floor.
Extend your knee and return to the starting position.

name: Kettlebell Alternating Curtsy Lunge
steps: Hold a kettlebell at your chest, feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally back into a lunge.
Alternate legs, keeping your chest up and core engaged.

name: Standing Neck Side Flexions
steps: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back.
Lean your head to the side (bring your ear to your shoulder) without shrugging your shoulder or leaning the spine to the side.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Stiff Leg Deadlift
steps: Start by standing on one leg with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding two dumbbells.
From this starting position, hinge at the hips to lower the dumbbell towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Once you feel a stretch in your hamstring, slowly return to the starting position.
Make sure to keep your standing leg slightly bent and avoid rounding your back as you lower the dumbbell.

name: Kettlebell Full Swing
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell between legs.
Hinge at hips, grip kettlebell, and swing it overhead.
Extend hips and knees, lock out arms at the top.

name: Crescent Moon Pose
steps: Begin in Runner's Lunge pose with your right foot forward.
Slowly lift your torso up and bring your arms overhead, palms facing each other.
Make sure your right knee is directly above your ankle, and your left leg is straight behind you.
Hold for a few breaths before repeating on the other side.

name: Cable Decline Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Lay on bench with cables above shoulder level.
Sweep both handles in front of your chest while keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Squeeze your chest, then lower the handles under control.

name: Dumbbell Laying Silverback Shrug
steps: Lay on an incline bench with your arms hanging freely.
Pull your shoulder blades back toward the ceiling.

name: Dumbbell Internal Rotation
steps: Lay flat on the ground with your elbow on the floor and dumbbell pointed toward the ceiling.
Lower the dumbbell until your knuckles get close to the ground. Then back to the starting position.

name: Bodyweight Inverted Curl
steps: Hang from a bar with your feet on the floor.
Break at the elbows and curl your body towards the bar.

name: Rower Pike
steps: Place your feet on the rower seat and get in to a plank position.
Pull your hips straight up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips until you're back in a plank position.

name: Bosu Ball Superman
steps: Lie face down on Bosu, arms extended.
Lift arms, chest, and legs off the Bosu.
Hold for a moment, then lower back down.

name: Band Pullthrough
steps: Anchor the band to the lowest point possible. Straddle the band and then grab with both hands.
Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Push your butt back until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings. Then extend the hips back into the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Lateral Lunge
steps: Hold one dumbbell with one or both hands, feet hip-width apart.
Step out to one side, bending the knee.
Push off, return to center, then switch sides.

name: Hip Rolls
steps: Lie supine with knees bent, feet hip-width, arms relaxed by sides.
Inhale to prepare, exhale and posteriorly tilt pelvis.
Roll spine up one vertebra at a time into bridge.
Press through legs until legs are nearly extended. Lower back to start.
Then begin rolling your spine downward until your back is flat against the carriage.

name: Bosu Ball Half Burpee
steps: Stand on Bosu with feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop into squat position and place hands on Bosu.
Jump feet back to plank, then jump back to squat.

name: Neutral Pulldown
steps: Use the V Bar attachment.
Hold the attachment as you sit on the machine and put your legs under the leg pads.
Pull the bar to your clavicle, then raise back up until your arm are extended.

name: Plate Clean And Press
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the feet.
Bend the knees and hips to pick up the plate, keeping the back straight and core engaged.
Stand up, lock the hips and legs, and press the plate overhead with straight arms.
Lower the plate back to the starting position, keeping control of it, and repeat for desired reps.

name: Kettlebell Reverse Lunge
steps: Hold kettlebells at your side.
Step backward, lower body.

name: Cable Single Arm 30 Degree Shrug
steps: Use a handle attachment. With the cable attachment set all the way to the bottom.
Grab one handle and make sure you are centered in the machine. Let your arm hang freely.
Pull your shoulder blade up and in towards your ears. Let your shoulder blade depress back to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
steps: Grip the dumbbell with your palm facing upwards with your forearm rested against the bench.
Slowly curl your wrist upwards in a semicircular motion.
Return to starting position and repeat.

name: Bodyweight Knee Push Ups
steps: Begin in a push-up position on your knees. Break at the elbow and shoulder joint.
Lower your body, keeping elbows close.
Push back up to the starting position.

name: Gate Pose Rounding Spine Looking Up
steps: Begin in a kneeling position with your knees hip-width apart.
Extend your right leg out to the side, placing your foot flat on the ground.
Reach your right arm overhead and then round your spine, bringing your right hand to your left ear.
Look down towards your left foot as you reach your left arm towards your right foot, feeling a stretch in your side body. Hold for a few breaths and then switch sides.

name: Landmine Concentration Curl
steps: Start on one knee facing the landmine, holding the end of the barbell with your hand on the side of your forward leg.
While keeping your elbow braced against the inside of your knee, curl the barbell upward towards your shoulder, then lower it back down with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

name: Long Lever Forearm Plank
steps: Start in a hand plank position and walk your elbows further out until your ears are between your biceps.
Hold in this position for the allotted amount of time.
Make sure you keep a flat back for the whole set.

name: Cable Alternating Bench Chest Fly
steps: Lie on bench, hold cable handles above chest, palms facing inward.
Lower one arm outward with slight elbow bend, keeping opposite arm extended.
Bring arm back to center, alternate sides while maintaining controlled movement.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand straight with your feet slightly apart and hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Bring the same leg as the arm holding the kettlebell behind you, squat down until your back knee touches the ground, keeping your back straight.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Barbell Upright Row
steps: Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the bar to chin level or slightly higher.

name: Underhand Pulldown
steps: Use the Straight Bar attachment. Hold with an underhand grip.
Hold the attachment as you sit on the machine and put your legs under the leg pads.
Pull the bar to your clavicle, then raise back up until your arm are extended.

name: Shoulders Stretch Variation Four
steps: Stand with you feet shoulder width apart. Place one arm across the front of your chest at shoulder height, press the forearm of your other arm above the elbow, hooking the stretching arm with your hand.
Press the arm until it is straight and rotate your upper torso to engage the stretch even deeper.
Repeat with your other arm.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Overhead Press
steps: Start with two dumbbells just above your shoulders.
Press one dumbbell to the ceiling while keeping the other in place.
Let the first dumbbell return to its starting position before pressing the other dumbbell.

name: Trap Bar Squat
steps: Stand inside trap bar, feet shoulder-width, grip handles.
Sit hips down and back, keeping chest upright.
Lower until thighs are at least parallel.
Push your heels into the floor and squat back to a standing position.

name: Cable Thruster
steps: Hold low cable handles at shoulder height with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down while keeping your chest raised and knees tracking outward.
Stand powerfully and press both handles overhead until your arms are extended.

name: Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise Double
steps: Start by sitting on a bench with a barbell resting on your knees. Your feet should be flat on the ground, about hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the barbell for support, and lift your heels off the ground.
Hold this position for a moment, then slowly lower your heels back to the ground.

name: Scorpion Twist Pose
steps: Begin in a downward-facing dog pose.
Slowly lift one leg up towards the ceiling, keeping your hips level and your toes pointed.
Bend your lifted leg and try to touch your toes to the back of your head.
Once you have a firm grip with your toes, slowly begin to twist your torso towards the lifted leg.
Keep your hands and feet firmly planted on the ground as you hold the pose for a few breaths. Release the pose and repeat on the other side.

name: Bodyweight Single Leg Calf Raise
steps: Hold onto something for balance. Raise one foot off the ground.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Heels Up Goblet Squat
steps: Hold the weight tucked into your upper chest area, keeping your elbows in. Your feet should be slightly wider than your shoulders and the heels slightly raised on a surface.
Sink down into the squat, keeping your elbows inside the track of your knees.
Push through your heels while keeping your chest up and return to the starting position.

name: Cable Bilateral Cross Cable Curl
steps: Stand between low cables
Curl one side by bringing your lower arm across your body. Make sure to keep your upper arm stationary.
Squeeze your biceps, then slowly extend your elbows.

name: Cable Single Arm Hammer Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Use a neutral grip thumb facing up pinky-facing down). Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Cable Kneeling Wood Chopper
steps: Kneel sideways to cable and grip handle with both hands in front of chest.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally across body in a smooth arc.
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.

name: Biceps Stretch Variation One
steps: Stand one foot in front of the other with the wall to your right, an arms width away.
Place your hand on the wall, fingers pointing away from you.
Gently lean forward, keeping your hand stationary.
Repeat with the other arm.

name: Dumbbell Arnold Press
steps: Stand with both palms facing you.
Begin to press the dumbbells to the ceiling while rotating your palms.
When you reach elbow extension, your palms should be facing forward.

name: Lats Stretch Variation One
steps: Place both hands on the wall in front of you.
Slowly lower your body until you feel the stretch.
Hold at the bottom of the stretch, return to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Full Lateral Raise
steps: Stand up straight with dumbbells at either side, palms facing your hips.
Raise your arms on either side with a slight bend in your elbow until they are over head. Pause at the top of the motion.
Slowly return your arms down to starting position.

name: Cable Rope Standing Crunch
steps: Stand facing cable, hold rope behind head with elbows tucked in.
Brace core and curl torso downward toward hips without pulling with arms.
Return slowly to standing tall, keeping constant tension on abs.

name: Barbell Shrug
steps: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with a barbell in front of you.
Bend down and grab the barbell with an overhand grip, your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your shoulders down as you grip the bar.
Stand up straight, lifting the barbell off the ground and pulling it toward your hips. Keep your elbows close to your body and your shoulders down as you do this.
Once the barbell is at your hips, raise your shoulders as high as you can, holding the position for a moment.

name: Quads Stretch Variation One
steps: Stand perpendicular to a wall, using one arm against the wall for balance. With your other arm, grab the top of your foot.
Pull your leg upwards and back to engage your quads, pausing at the apex of the stretch for a few seconds.
Return to starting position and repeat with your other leg.

name: Barbell Feet Elevated Single Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a box, the barbell placed over your hips. Raise one leg up and off the box.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the box.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Landmine Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand facing the landmine with your feet shoulder width apart while holding the end of the barbell in your hands with your arms fully extended down towards the ground.
While keeping your torso tall and core engaged, step directly out to one side, using the foot you have stepped out with to sit down into the lunge while keeping your other leg straight.
Drive through your heel on your bent leg as your step together to return to the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps on the same side before switching sides.

name: Glute Bridge Isometric Hold Single Alternate
steps: Lie on your back. Bend your knees so your feet are flat on the floor with heels under knees
Push through your heels into the ground, lifting your hips up to the point where there is a straight line from your chest to your knees. Squeeze your bum at the top of the movement
Maintain the top position and extend one leg at the time.

name: Barbell Behind The Back Wrist Curl
steps: Stand straight and hold the barbell behind you using a pronated grip with your hands and feet shoulder-width apart.
Slowly curl your wrists in a semi-circular motion upwards.
Hold the barbell at the apex of the motion and then slowly lower the barbell back down to starting position.

name: Seated Arm Stretch
steps: Sit cross-legged on the floor.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, palms facing forward.
Cross your right arm over your left arm and interlace your fingers.
Pull your hands away from your body and hold for a few breaths, then release and repeat with the opposite arm on top.

name: Band Bench Press
steps: Lie on bench with band looped behind your back.
Lower hands toward chest while keeping elbows at a comfortable angle.
Press upward and squeeze chest at the top, maintaining band tension.

name: Biceps Stretch Variation Two
steps: Stand facing the wall, an arm's width away.
Place your hand on the wall with your fingers pointing down.
Lean slightly into the wall to feel the stretch in your bicep.

name: Ez Bar Cuban Press
steps: Hold EZ bar with overhand grip, elbows bent, bar at upper abdomen.
Raise elbows to shoulder height while externally rotating forearms upward.
Press bar overhead once forearms are vertical and aligned.
Reverse motion slowly back to starting position.

name: Smith Machine Skullcrusher
steps: Take a shoulder width grip. Break at the elbows. Try to keep your elbows tucked in. Don't let them flare out.
Stop the bar a few inches from your forehead and extend your elbows back up.

name: Long Arm Adduction Side Kneeling
steps: Kneel sideways, supporting hand under shoulder, top arm reaching long overhead.
Engage core, keep torso upright and shoulders stacked.
Pull top arm down toward hip, using lats and obliques.
Return arm overhead with control, maintaining balance and steady breathing.

name: Dumbbell Seated Rear Delt Row
steps: Sit on a bench. Put your chest in your lap. Try to get your torso as close to parallel with the ground as your mobility will allow for.
Let your arms hang in front of you. Pull your elbows back towards the ceiling while flaring your elbows outward.

name: Smith Machine Glute Kickback
steps: Start on your hands and knees with one foot placed on the bottom of the bar.
Keeping your core braced, your back flat, and your moving leg bent at a
degree angle, drive the heel of your working leg up the ceiling while squeezing your glute.
Follow the movement path as you bring your knee back down to the ground beneath your hip, keeping your knee bent to maintain control of the bar.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Full Lateral Raise
steps: Stand tall with a single dumbbell at your side.
Raise the dumbbell with your elbow mostly extended until it is above your head.

name: Landmine Seated Alternating Overhead Press
steps: Start sitting on the ground facing the landmine attachment with your legs open for stability while holding the end of the bar in a neutral grip with your hand resting at your shoulder and your elbow beneath your wrist.

Leaning forward slightly, press the bar up into the air until your arm is fully extended. At the top of the movement, switch which hand is holding the end of the bar and lower the bar back down to the opposite shoulder. Perform again to return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

name: Cable Rope Rolling Pushdown
steps: Stand facing cable holding rope, elbows bent, and shoulders flexed.
First extend your shoulders (like performing a pullover), then extend the elbows.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Seated Hammer Curl
steps: Sit tall holding one dumbbell at your side with palm facing inward.
Curl dumbbell toward shoulder while keeping elbow tight to your torso.
Squeeze bicep, then lower slowly to full extension under control.

name: Smith Machine Pushup
steps: Place hands on the bar, in push-up position.
Lower yourself to the bar, maintaining proper form.

name: Kettlebell Alternating Forward Lunge
steps: Stand tall, holding kettlebells by your sides, feet hip-width apart.
Step forward with one leg, lowering until both knees form 90° angles.
Push through front foot, return to start, and switch legs.

name: Band Calf Raise
steps: Attach band to a low anchor point.
Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Lean back slightly. Raise your heels straight up and down

name: Bodyweight Assisted Pull Up
steps: Grasp the chin-up bar with an overhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Place your feet on the ground, legs bent slightly.
Use your legs to assist as you pull your chin above the bar.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm High Incline Chest Press
steps: Sit on high incline bench holding dumbbell at shoulder with arm bent.
Press dumbbell upward and slightly inward until arm fully extends.
Lower slowly to starting position, keeping torso stable and controlled.

name: Medicine Ball Ball Offset Squat
steps: Hold medicine ball at one shoulder, feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, keeping ball on same side throughout movement.
Stand back up, squeezing glutes. Repeat on other side.

name: Single Leg Box Jump
steps: Stand with a shoulder width stance.
Jump onto your box and land with one foot.
Try to land in the middle of the box and land as softly as possible.

name: Dumbbell Tate Press
steps: Lay flat on a bench with two dumbbells extended toward the ceiling.
Maintain an overhand grip. Flex at the elbows.
The dumbbells will land on your upper chest/clavicle.
Extend your elbows bringing the dumbbells back into their starting position.
*Named after Dave Tate*

name: Cable Standing Single Arm Chest Press
steps: Stand sideways to cable and hold handle at chest height with elbow bent.
Brace core and press handle straight forward without rotating torso.
Squeeze chest at extension, then return handle slowly to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Larsen Press
steps: Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding one dumbbell above chest.
Lower dumbbell toward chest while keeping core tight and legs raised.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting torso.

name: Bodyweight Assisted Sissy Squat
steps: Stand tall holding support for balance, feet shoulder-width apart.
Lean back while bending knees, keeping body straight from knees up.
Push through toes and extend knees to return upright.

name: Barbell Clean And Press
steps: Stand with feet hip-width, grip barbell just outside thighs.
Explosively extend hips and pull bar to shoulders in one motion.
Press overhead until arms lock out, then lower bar under control.

name: Cable Standing Alternating Decline Chest Fly
steps: Stand between high cables with your arms extended outward.
Sweep one handle downward and across your chest with a slightly bent elbow.
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.

name: Dumbbell Incline Reverse Curl
steps: Lay on an incline bench.
Grab the dumbbells with a pronated (overhand) grip. You can do this exercise thumbless if it's more comfortable on your wrists.
Flex at the elbows until your biceps touch your forearms. Try not to let your elbows flair outward.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive
steps: Hold dumbbells in front rack position and place one foot on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping chest tall and core braced.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

name: Single Leg Bicycle
steps: Lie supine, one knee bent, opposite leg extended.
Press through one leg. Simultaneously pull the raised leg up to a table top position.
As you lower, bring your non-working leg back into extension.

name: Cable Elevated Deadlift
steps: Start with handles set to the bottom of the machine. Grab a box, stand on top of the box, squat the weight up into a standing position.
Push your butt back to initiate the movement and then push your butt forward until you're back in a standing position.
To protect yourself from injury, always maintain a flat back on any exercise.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Wrist Curl
steps: Sit on bench, forearm resting on thigh, palm facing up holding dumbbell.
Lower wrist to stretch forearm, keeping forearm flat on thigh.
Curl wrist upward, squeezing forearm flexors at the top.

name: Machine Dips
steps: Sit on the machine and grab the handles.
Press the handles down until your elbows are nearly extended.

name: Abdominals Stretch Variation Four
steps: Lay on a ball or a Bosu ball with your feet firmly planted on the floor.
Lean all the way back until you feel a stretch in your abdomen.
Crunch upwards and hold for a 1-2 count.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Band Reverse Curl
steps: Start by standing on the center of the band with both feet, shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band with both hands, palms facing down, arms extended straight in front of you.
Slowly curl your hands towards your shoulders, pulling the band tight, then lower your arms back to the starting position, keeping tension on the band throughout the exercise.

name: Band Seated Single Arm Pulldown
steps: Sit facing anchor with band overhead, holding handle in one hand.
Pull elbow down toward your hip while keeping chest tall.
Squeeze lat at the bottom, then return slowly to full stretch.

name: Landmine Alternating Lunge And Twist
steps: Set up the landmine attachment and load weight.
Stand facing the landmine, holding the weight away from your chest.
Step backward with one leg, lunge down while twisting your torso toward the front leg, return to starting position, and repeat on the other side.

name: Standing Knee Raise Hold
steps: Stand up straight and with a good posture.
Shift your weight onto the supporting leg while driving the other knee.
Your thigh should be parallel to the ground.

name: Alternating Bent Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your back, legs bent and lifted off the ground.
Lower one leg to the ground until your foot taps the ground, keep your other leg up.
Alternate sides for the prescribed amount of reps.

name: Kettlebell Front Rack Single Arm Lateral Lunge
steps: Hold kettlebell in front rack.
Step sideways, lunge.

name: Standing Neck Rotations
steps: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back.
Rotate your head from side to side without rounding your shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Flat Preacher Curl
steps: Start with a with a dumbbell in one hand and your tricep resting on flat bench.
From this starting position, curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary on the bench.

name: Dumbbell Guillotine Bench Press
steps: Lie on the flat bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out. As you lower the dumbbells, exhale deeply.
Once your elbows reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position

name: Reach And Catch
steps: Lay flat on your back with both hands over one leg.
Reach toward your knee flexing your abs and obliques.
Do the prescribed amount of reps, then switch sides.

name: Band Single Arm Row
steps: Anchor band to a stable point.
Step back until there is no slack in the band and hold the end of the band with one hand.
Pull through the elbow straight back.

name: Dumbbell Seated Tibialis Raise
steps: Sit on a box or bench, place your heels on a step or plate, and place dumbbells on your quads.
Raise your toes straight toward the ceiling.

name: Machine Hip And Glute Adduction
steps: Stand on the platform and set the pad just over the hip of the working leg.
Place the working leg over the pad.
Press your leg inward. Aim to get the longest range of motion possible.

name: Ankle Circle
steps: Sit or stand, lift one foot slightly off the ground.
Rotate your ankle in a circular motion.
Complete the allotted amount of reps, then switch directions and repeat on the other foot.

name: Bosu Ball Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand on Bosu, step backward into a lunge.
Bend knees, lower until the front thigh is parallel.
Push off the back foot, return to starting position.

name: Bodyweight Box Squat
steps: Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position, sitting back onto the box and pausing for a moment before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.

name: Smith Machine Reverse Lunge
steps: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with the bar on your shoulders. Your feet should be slightly pointed outward, and your shoulders should be down and relaxed.
Step backward with one foot, lowering your body until your front thigh is parallel to the ground and your back knee is hovering just above the ground.
Push off your back foot, returning to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Wrist Curl
steps: Drape one arm over a bench while holding a dumbbell. Point your palm toward the ceiling.
Extend and curl your wrist against resistance.

name: Cable Cross Pushdown
steps: Either use two handles or no attachment at all. Both sides of the cable crossover should be set to the top.
Stand in the center of the machine holding each Cable in the opposing hand. Your upper arm should be at a
degree angle with your torso.
Extend your elbows until you feel a contraction and then return to the starting position

name: Cable Standing Straight Leg Mid Kickback
steps: Use an ankle attachment. The cable should be set to halfway up the crossover machine.
Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

name: Dumbbell Bench Wrist Extension
steps: Grab two dumbbells with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across a bench.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.

name: Smith Machine Hanging Knee Tuck
steps: Put a hip thrust pad on the smith machine bar at neck height. Put both arms over the bar and pull your feet off the ground.
Pull your knees to your chest and flex your abs.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Reverse Curl
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hold a kettlebell with palms facing down.
Lift kettlebell toward shoulders, squeezing biceps, then lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Seated Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Sit on the bench and hold a dumbbell with both hands. Raise the dumbbell overhead at arms length, holding the weight up with the palms of your hands.
Keep your elbows in while you lower the weight behind your head, your upper arms stationary.
Raise the weight back to starting position.

name: Hand Side Plank Reach Through
steps: Start in a side plank position.
Reach your top arm under your body.
Return to the plank position.

name: Frog Sit Up
steps: Lay on your back with knees bent and your feet together.
Keep your arms extended overhead. Swing your arms to generate some momentum and sit up.

name: Cable High Single Arm Reverse Bayesian Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set at elbow level.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards, and curl.

name: Barbell Snatch Grip Romanian Deadlift
steps: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart. The bar should be in a rack or box so it's lifted off the ground.
Grab the barbell with an overhand grip, your hands should be much wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hing forward at the hips keeping your knees mostly extended. Hinge until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you are back in a standing position.

name: Cable Belt Squat
steps: Put on a dip belt. Attach the strap/chain to the cable's carabiner.
Take a few steps back. Begin to squat by flexing at the knees and hips.
Let the weight pull you forward as you squat. Then push your toes through the front of your shoes as you squat back to the start position.

name: Barbell Front Rack Deficit Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, barbell in front rack, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Single Arm Thruster
steps: Hold two dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing inward.
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing one dumbbell overhead.
Lower dumbbell as you descend again, alternating arms each rep.

name: Machine Standing Lateral Raise
steps: Grab the two handles and raise the arms straight out to your sides.

name: Sphinx Pose
steps: Start by lying down on your stomach on a yoga mat or a comfortable surface.
Place your elbows underneath your shoulders, keeping your forearms parallel to each other.
Press your palms and forearms firmly into the ground to lift your chest up, while keeping your hips and legs relaxed.
Make sure your shoulders are relaxed and away from your ears. Gently roll your shoulder blades down and back to open up your chest.
Lengthen your spine by lifting the crown of your head towards the ceiling, while keeping your chin tucked in slightly.

name: Cable Seated Alternating High Curl
steps: Sit between high cables with your arms extended outward and palms upward.
Curl one handle toward your head while keeping your upper arm stationary.
Slowly extend your elbow, then repeat with the opposite arm.

name: Dumbbell Decline Single Arm Bench Press
steps: Start by laying on a decline bench with two dumbbells.
Position the dumbbell above your chest with your elbow bent and shoulder level.
Slowly lower the dumbbell towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and your core engaged while the other dumbbell remains pointed toward the ceiling.
Once the dumbbell reaches your side, pause for a moment and then press the weight back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to your other arm.

name: Biceps Stretch Variation Five
steps: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart.
Raise your arms out to your sides, bringing them up to shoulder level.
Rotate your palms so they are facing the ceiling.
Then, change direction and rotate the arms as much as you can.

name: Band Good Morning
steps: Anchor the band at hip level. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Push your hips back while keeping your back flat until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.

name: Plate Goblet Deficit Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, Holding a plate to your chest, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start.

name: Medicine Ball Walkover Pushup
steps: Place one hand on medicine ball, other on ground.
Perform push-up, walking hands to switch positions.

name: Table Top Pose Variation 3
steps: Beginner
Come onto your hands and knees on the mat with your wrists directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Turn your palms down and spread your fingers wide, with your fingertips pointing towards your knees.
Press into your palms and extend your arms fully to lift your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, and then release by slowly lowering your hands to the mat and coming back to a neutral tabletop position.

name: Trap Bar Shrug
steps: Stand inside trap bar, arms straight, shoulders relaxed.
Elevate shoulders straight upward toward ears.
Pause briefly at top, squeezing traps.
Lower shoulders slowly to starting position.

name: Child Pose Arms Extended
steps: Begin in a tabletop position with your hands and knees on the ground.
Sit back onto your heels and extend your arms out in front of you.
Rest your forehead on the ground.
Hold for a few breaths and then release.

name: Kettlebell Decline Skull Crusher
steps: Lie on the floor with your upper back and soles of feet on the floor, knees bent, and pelvis and lower back suspended in the air.
Hold the kettlebell in both hands directly above your chest.
Keeping your upper arms in place, bend your elbows to bring the kettlebell to the floor above your head.
Return the kettlebell to the starting position and repeat.

name: Barbell Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Maintain the natural arch in your back, squeezing your shoulder blades and raising your chest.
Grip the bar across your shoulders and support it on your upper back. Unwrack the bar by straightening your legs, and take a step back.
Bend your knees as you lower the weight without altering the form of your back until your hips are below your knees.
Raise the bar back to starting position, lift with your legs and exhale at the top.

name: Cable High Single Arm Rolling Curl
steps: Set cable at about elbow level. Stand facing away from the cables and grab handle attachment.
Take an underhand grip, flex your elbows, as you curl hinge forward.
As you extend your elbow, also extend your hips until you are back in a standing position.

name: Jumping Mountain Climber
steps: Begin in a plank position, hands under shoulders, feet together.
Jump feet forward, landing outside hands in a low squat.
Explode back to plank, repeat continuously for desired reps.

name: Pyramid Pose Blocks
steps: Begin in Tadasana (Mountain Pose) with two blocks at the top of your mat.
Step your left foot back about 3-4 feet and place your heel down, keeping your toes pointing forward.
Place the blocks on either side of your right foot at a height that allows you to comfortably place your hands on them.
Inhale and lengthen your spine, then exhale and fold forward from your hips, bringing your hands to the blocks. Hold for several breaths, then switch sides and repeat.

name: Vajrasana Variation 1
steps: Beginner
Begin in a kneeling position with your knees together and your shins and feet on the floor.
Sit back on your heels and place your palms face down on your thighs, with your fingers pointing towards your knees.
Relax your shoulders and take deep breaths.
Hold the pose for several breaths or as long as is comfortable.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Pulse Squat
steps: Hold a dumbbell in goblet position.
Squat down to parallel depth and then halfway back up.
Stay in this short range of motion for the duration of the set.

name: Barbell Pronated Pendlay Row
steps: Start hinged forward with a flat back and the plates resting on the floor. Make sure your elbows are fully extended.
Pull the bar to your sternum.
Return the plates back to the floor and let the bar come to a full dead stop.
Then initiate the next rep.

name: Medicine Ball Overhead Reverse Lunge
steps: Hold medicine ball overhead.
Step back into lunge position.
Return to starting position. Repeat on other leg.

name: Kettlebell Deficit Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, kettlebells in each hand, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start.

name: Dumbbell Plank Pullthrough
steps: Get into a plank position. Either from your knees or toes.
Start with the DB by your right hand. Reach with your left and pull the dumbbell to your left arm. Then repeat with the right.

name: Landmine T Bar Rows
steps: Grab a v bar and place it under the bar's collar.
Hinge forward with a flat back and pull your elbows straight back toward the ceiling.
Fully extend your elbows before initiating the next rep.

name: Kettlebell Quad Stomp
steps: Place your foot on a plate or a low box. Hold two kettlebells in each hand.
Put all of your weight on your front foot and lean forward.
Lower until your calves touch your hamstrings and then extend back up.

name: Plate Pinch Grip Side Bend
steps: Stand straight with the plate held at your side
Keep your hips and shoulders facing forward, bend to one side slowly
Return to the upright position.
Switch hands and repeat

name: Seated Doming
steps: Sit on a bench or box. Press the big toe into the ground till you feel the inside part of your foot raise off the ground
The arch of your foot should now look more pronounced. Do not roll your foot out to lift the inside part of your foot
You should perform the exercise bare foot or with socks, but do not wear shoes.

name: Ez Bar Romanian Deadlift
steps: Take a shoulder width, double overhand or mixed grip.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Dumbbell High Incline Skullover
steps: Set bench to high incline and hold dumbbells above chest.
Flex elbows first, then flex the shoulders until a stretch is felt in your triceps.
Bring your elbows back up until they are pointed at the ceiling, then extend your elbows.

name: Barbell Snatch Grip Deadlift
steps: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with your toes pointed slightly outward.
Place a barbell on the floor in front of you, with the weight plates on either side. Make sure that the bar is directly in line with your feet.
Bend down and grab the barbell with an overhand grip, your hands much wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your shoulders down as you grip the bar.
Stand up straight, lifting the barbell off the ground and pulling it toward your hips. Keep your elbows close to your body and your shoulders down as you do this.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the ground, making sure to keep your back straight and your shoulders down throughout the movement.

name: Seated Median Nerve Slider
steps: Abduct your arm at 90°, elbow straight and palm facing up.
Bend your elbow and wrist, bringing the fist close to the shoulder, while leaning the head to the opposite side.
Alternate between these positions to mobilise the median nerve.

name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
steps: Take a shoulder width, double overhand or mixed grip.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Standing Tibialis Raise
steps: Step on the plate, and place barbell on your back.
Raise your toes straight toward the ceiling.
Try holding at the top for a few seconds then bring your toes back down to the floor.

name: Barbell Full Front Raise
steps: Stand tall with an overhand grip on the barbell. Raise your arms until your fists are pointed toward the ceiling.
Return to the start under control. This exercise is prone to using momentum when you begin to fatigue.

name: Machine Hip Adduction
steps: Sit in the machine with your legs apart, pads against your outer thighs. Adjust the seat and pad position comfortably.
Slowly squeeze your legs together, focusing on using your inner thigh muscles. Pause when the pads are close together.
Slowly return to the starting position, maintaining control. Avoid letting the weights slam. Repeat for desired reps and sets.

name: Kettlebell Wrist Curl
steps: Stand up straight with a kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis, with your forearms facing outwards.
Flex your wrist towards your body until the kettlebell is level with your stomach.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

name: Band Single Arm Pushdown
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band with your right hand, with your arm at your side.
Flex and extend your elbow.

name: Plate Pinch Grip Row
steps: Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.
Bend forward at your hips while maintaining a flat back.
Pull the plate toward your upper abdomen.
Lower the weight in a controlled manner and repeat.

name: Band Kneeling Single Arm Pulldown
steps: Place the band at about eye level. Fall into a kneeling position.
The knee that is on the ground should be the same side as the working arm. Stick your chest out.
And then pull your elbow straight back. Flex your lats and then extend into the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Kneeling Wood Chopper
steps: Start in a kneeling position with your shoulder blades pulled back.
The dumbbell should begin by one of your hips.
Rotate at the spine and bring the dumbbell from your hip, 180 degrees around your body. The dumbbell should land at eye level.

name: Bodyweight Hand Plank Jack
steps: Start in high plank, hands under shoulders, body straight.
Jump hands outward simultaneously while keeping feet planted and core tight.
Jump hands back under shoulders, maintaining stable hips and spine.

name: Dumbbell Seated Arnold Press
steps: Begin seated on an upright bench with your palms facing you.
Begin pressing toward the ceiling. As you press, rotate your palms.
As you extend your elbows fully your palms should be facing forward.

name: Barbell High Bar Squat
steps: Place the bar on top of your traps.
Push your hips back and break at the knees. Push your elbows forward to keep yourself from getting pitched too far forward.
Aim to get your hamstrings to parallel with the floor.
Push your heels into the floor and squat back to a standing position.

name: Child Pose Arms Extended Left Right
steps: Begin in a tabletop position with your hands and knees on the ground.
Sit back onto your heels and extend your arms out in front of you to one side.
Rest your forehead on the ground.
Hold for a few breaths and then repeat on the other side.

name: Cardio In And Outs
steps: Start with both feet together.
Do a slight hop and bring your feet outwards, then back inwards.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Lateral Lunge
steps: Engage your core by drawing your belly button towards your spine. This will help to stabilize your body. Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Take a large step to the side with your right foot, planting it firmly on the ground.
As you step, bend your right knee and lower your hips until your right thigh is parallel to the ground. Your left leg should remain straight.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position. Repeat on the opposite side by stepping out with your left foot.

name: Barbell Zercher Squat
steps: Begin by standing with your feet about hip-width apart and holding a barbell in the crook of your arms, near your belly. Your palms should be facing towards your body.
Sit back and lower your body down until your thighs are parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Push through your heels to extend your hips and stand back up to the starting position.

name: Tree Pose
steps: Start in mountain pose, standing with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Shift your weight onto your left foot and bend your right knee, bringing the sole of your right foot to the inside of your left thigh.
Bring your hands together in front of your heart, or raise them overhead.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, then release and repeat on the other side.

name: Slow Tempo Mountain Climber
steps: To perform a bodyweight mountain climber, start in a plank position with your hands placed directly under your shoulders.
Bring your right knee towards your chest, keeping your foot close to your hand. Quickly switch legs, bringing your left knee towards your chest.
Continue this movement, alternating legs, at a slow pace for a set amount of time or repetitions.

name: Standing Neck Mobility Circumductions
steps: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back
Circumduct the head both clockwise and anti-clockwise making sure you are working on the end range throughout the movement.

name: Plate Halo
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate held in front of your face with both hands, palms facing each other.
Rotate the plate around the head, keeping the arms extended and moving the plate in a circular motion.
Complete one full circle, then reverse the direction to complete another circle.

name: Machine Cable V Bar Push Downs
steps: Grip the pulley bar with palms facing down at shoulder width.
Stand straight with a small forward incline. Keep your upper arms close to your body, and slowly bring the pulley bar down until your arms are fully extended.
Pause when you are at the contracted position of the motion, then slowly raise the pulley bar back to the starting point.

name: Plate Squat Hold Curl
steps: Lower into a squat position, keeping the plate at chest height.
Slowly curl the plate towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Hold for a moment at the top of the curl before lowering the plate back to chest height.
Repeat the curls as you hold the squat position.

name: Machine Single Leg Leg Press
steps: This particular leg press has two separate foot plates. There are holding pins on both sides. Engage the pin on one side.
Lower the weight but stop before your lower back begins to round.
Press back to the starting position.

name: Stability Ball Reverse Hyperextension
steps: Lie face down on a stability ball, hands on the floor, legs extended straight.
Engage glutes and lower back, raising legs until aligned with your torso.
Slowly lower legs back down without touching the ground, maintaining core engagement. Repeat.

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
steps: Lay flat on a bench with two dumbbells pressed to one another.
Break at the elbows and keep your elbows tucked as you bring the dumbbells to your chest.
Continue to press the dumbbells into one another throughout the rep.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, press back toward the ceiling.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Step Up
steps: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold two dumbbells at your shoulders with an overhand grip.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench and stand up straight, keeping the barbell at your shoulders.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, to return to the starting position.

name: Pilates Hamtring Curls Prone
steps: Lie prone, attach straps to ankles, legs extended.
Bend knees, pulling heels toward glutes.
Keep hips pressed down and core engaged.
Extend legs slowly back to start.

name: Cable Standing Alternating Decline Chest Press
steps: Stand facing away from high cables with handles beside your chest.
Press one handle forward and downward until your arm is extended.
Return under control, then press with the opposite arm.

name: Vajrasana Variation 2
steps: Beginner
Begin in a kneeling position with your knees together and your shins and feet on the floor.
Sit back on your heels and place the tops of your hands on your thighs, with your fingers pointing towards your knees.
Relax your shoulders and take deep breaths.
Hold the pose for several breaths or as long as is comfortable.

name: Seated Forward Bend
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Inhale and lengthen your spine, then exhale and fold forward from your hips, keeping your spine long.
Reach for your feet or ankles, keeping your elbows straight.
Hold for several breaths, then release.

name: Kettlebell Shoulder Flexion Bent Elbow Hold
steps: Stand up straight with the working arm in front of you and bent at the elbow (90°).
Hold an inverted kettlebell in that arm.
The goal is to maintain the position of the kettlebell without it falling over.

name: Ez Bar Front Raise
steps: Stand tall with an overhand grip on the barbell. Raise your arms until your fists are around eye level.
Return to the start under control. This exercise is prone to using momentum when you begin to fatigue.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Push Press
steps: Hold dumbbell at shoulder height, feet shoulder-width apart.
Dip slightly at knees, then drive upward, pressing dumbbell overhead.
Lock out arm briefly, then lower dumbbell under control.

name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
steps: Lay flat on the incline bench with your feet on the ground. Raise the dumbbells until you have straight arms.
Lower the dumbbells to your mid chest
Raise the dumbbells until you've locked your elbows.

name: Kettlebell Waiters Bow
steps: Place a barbell at about midway up your thigh. Press your quads into the barbell.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Band Rapunzel Pushdown
steps: Anchor the band to a high point and face away. Hold the band with both hands, placing your hands shoulder-width apart and keeping your elbows close to your body.
Slowly extend your arms downward, keeping your elbows close to your body. Push the band down as far as you can, feeling the contraction in your triceps.

name: Stability Ball Single Leg Hip Thrust
steps: Lie on the ball, one foot on the ground.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Pigeon Pose
steps: Extend your right leg behind you and place your right ankle on top of your left thigh, with your right knee pointing out to the side.
Sitting up straight, use your hands to gently press down on your right knee while at the same time pulling your left buttock back.
Hold for 5-10 deep breaths, then release and repeat on the other side.

name: TRX Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with your feet in the foot cradles of the TRX straps, with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your arms by your sides with your palms facing down.
Drive your hips up towards the ceiling, squeezing your glutes and hamstrings at the top of the movement.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Single Arm Press
steps: Start in a bench press position with two dumbbells.
Break at one of your elbows first while keeping the other elbow extended.
Your working arm should reach your side before pressing back to the ceiling.
Then alternate to the other arm.

name: Cardio Band Seal Jacks
steps: Loop a band around your back. Start with both arms extended at your side.
As you perform the jack. Bring both arms together and make a little clap.

name: Cable Behind The Back Lateral Raise
steps: Place the cable all the way at the bottom and stand with the cable crossing behind your body.
While keeping your elbow mostly extended, lift your arm until it's parallel with the floor.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Hammer Curl
steps: Sit on incline bench holding one dumbbell with a neutral grip with arm hanging straight down.
Curl dumbbell toward shoulder without moving upper arm.
Squeeze bicep, then lower slowly to full stretch.

name: Cable Half Kneeling Wood Chopper
steps: Set the cable at nipple level. Take a half kneeling position. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

name: Backstroke Prep Lying On Box
steps: Lie prone on the box, chest supported, arms holding straps forward.
Start with arms straight, palms facing down, shoulders relaxed.
Pull arms back in a sweeping motion, engaging upper back.
Return to start with control, keeping neck long and torso stable.

name: Single Arm Rapunzel Pushdown
steps: Stand with a band anchored to a high point. Face away from the band. Hold the loop in one hand.
Keep your elbow tucked in to your side. Extend your elbow. When you extend, don't let your upper arm raise. The band should land over your shoulder.

name: Cardio Assault Bike Arms Only
steps: Adjust seat and handlebar height for comfort and proper posture on the assault bike.
Start pedaling with even, controlled motion, maintaining your desired resistance level. Then keep the motion going with only your arms.

name: Cardio Figure Eight Sprint
steps: Perform s sprint in a figure eight pattern.
Make sure to stay low.

name: Ring Pull Up
steps: Grasp the rings with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the rings.
Lower your body back to starting position.

name: Cardio In And Out Forward
steps: Bring one leg forward and then the other.
Bring the original leg backwards and then the other.

name: Smith Machine Oblique Crunch
steps: Lay on your side with your knees bent.
Hold the bar extended over you.
Lift yourself up by flexing your obliques.

name: Barbell Step Up Knee Drive
steps: Hold barbell on upper back and place one foot firmly on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping torso tall and balanced.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

name: Kettlebell Upright Row Single
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

name: Dumbbell Clean And Press
steps: Hold dumbbells at sides, hinge slightly, and explosively pull to shoulders.
Catch dumbbells at shoulder height with knees slightly bent.
Press overhead until arms extend, then lower under control.

name: Pilates Single Arm Rotations Back Rowing Seated Row
steps: Sit tall, hold one strap, arm extended forward.
Pull handle while rotating torso slightly.
Keep hips stable and movement controlled.
Return arm and torso to start.

name: Kettlebell Half Kneeling Goblet Romanian Deadlift
steps: Place one knee on a bench and hold a kettlebell in a goblet position.
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Smith Machine Seated Overhead Press
steps: Sit on a bench with back support. Raise the bar to shoulder height with your palms forward.
Raise the bar upwards and pause at the contracted position.
Lower the weight back to starting position.

name: Bodyweight Step Down
steps: Stand on platform with one foot off edge and torso tall.
Lower hanging foot toward floor by bending standing knee under control.
Drive through standing heel to stand tall again without pushing off bottom foot.

name: Kettlebell Farmers March
steps: Stand tall holding two kettlebells in each hand.
March in place for the desired amount of reps or time.

name: Kettlebell Staggered Deadlift
steps: Begin with feet hip-width apart, one foot forward, kettlebell between feet.
Hinge at hips, grip kettlebell, and stand tall.
Lower kettlebell with control, then repeat.

name: Weighted Diamond Push Ups
steps: Place a plate on your back. Position your index fingers and thumbs so they are touching, forming a diamond shape.
Use a standard push up position
Lower your chest towards your hands, keep your elbows close to your body
Stop just before your chest touches the floor, then push back up to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Row
steps: Hinge forward at the hips while maintaining a flat back. Try to get your torso as close to parallel with the ground as your mobility will allow for.
Let your arms hang in front of you. Pull your elbows back towards the ceiling while flaring your elbows outward.

name: Barbell Calf Raises
steps: Place the bar on your back
Start with feet flat on the ground
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.

name: Barbell Hooklying Bench Press
steps: Start in a bench press position with your feet planted on the bench and knees bent.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, positioning your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and lower it to your chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.

name: Cable Wrist Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Start with your elbow at a 90° angle with your palm facing up. Flex and extend at the wrist.

name: Pole Rotation
steps: Start with the pole in front of you with an overhand wider than shoulder width grip.
Rotate both arms overhead and behind you while leaving your elbows mostly extended.

name: TRX Lateral Lunge
steps: Grasp the TRX handles with both hands and extend your arms straight in front of you.
Step laterally to one side, keeping your arms extended and your core engaged.
Lower your body into a lunge position, keeping your front knee bent at a 90-degree angle and your back leg straight.
Push off your front foot to return to the starting position, keeping your arms extended and your core engaged.

name: Plate Weighted Dead Hang
steps: Attach weight to yourself using a dip belt. Grip a pull-up bar with palms facing forward.
Hang with arms fully extended.
Hold for recommended amount of time, keeping your core engaged.

name: TRX Reverse Lunge
steps: Hold on to the TRX straps and step away until the strap is taut.
Step backwards with one leg in to a lunge position and gently tap your knee to the floor.
Lunge back to the starting position and repeat with the other leg.

name: Machine Assisted Chin Up
steps: Adjust weight for assistance. Stand on platform, grip handles above shoulder-width. Knees on pad if available.
Slowly pull up until chin is above the bar. Keep elbows close, core engaged.
Lower back with control. Pause at bottom. Repeat for reps.

name: Dumbbell Side Plank Up Down
steps: Start by lying on your side with your feet stacked on top of each other and a dumbbell on your hip.
Place your bottom elbow on the ground beneath your shoulder and engage your core to raise your hips off the ground.
Your hips will do all the moving. Think, "hips up, hips down."

name: Hip Flexor Stretch Kneeling Lunge 2
steps: Bring yourself to kneeling lunge position. Keep a 90° angle at knees.
Slide the front knee forward while gently leaning back. Raise your arm diagonally backwards
Squeeze the glute on the side of the leg that's to the front to avoid lower back complaints.

name: Hand Plank
steps: Start in a kneeling position with your hands planted on the ground.
Pick your knees up off the ground. Hold in this position with a flat back.

name: Dumbbell Incline Chest Fly
steps: Lay on an incline bench with two dumbbells extended in front of you.
You should have a slight bend in your elbows and maintain that bend. Your shoulder joint should do all the movement.
Bring the dumbbells out to your side. Stop the dumbbells before going behind your body.
Bring the dumbbells back together at the top.

name: Machine Assisted Neutral Chin Up
steps: Adjust weight for assistance. Stand on platform, grip handles above shoulder-width. Knees on pad if available.
Slowly pull up until chin is above the bar. Keep elbows close, core engaged.
Lower back with control. Pause at bottom. Repeat for reps.

name: Kettlebell Floor Fly
steps: Lie on your back holding kettlebells above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower arms out wide until elbows lightly touch the floor.
Bring kettlebells back together over chest, squeezing pecs at the top.

name: Burpee
steps: Start standing with your feet hip-width apart. Lower your body into a squat position, placing your hands on the ground in front of you.
Quickly jump your feet back into a plank position, keeping your body in a straight line from your head to your toes.
Perform a push-up, keeping your core tight and your elbows close to your body.
Jump your feet back towards your hands, and then jump up into the air, reaching your arms overhead.
Land softly and immediately lower your body back into the squat position to repeat the movement.

name: Slider Hamstring Curl
steps: Lie on your back with slightly bent knees and heels on sliders.
Pull your heels towards your glutes to lift your hips off the ground.
Extend knees to starting position, but do not rest hips on ground.

name: Stability Ball Glute Bridge
steps: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a ball.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the bar.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Barbell Suitcase Deadlift
steps: Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart and holding a barbell at one side of your body, with your palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and knees to lower the barbell down towards the ground.
As the barbell reaches the ground, use your legs and glutes to push through your heels and extend your hips and knees to raise your body back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of reps, then switch sides and repeat the exercise with the barbell on the opposite side of your body.

name: Pilates Short Spine
steps: Lie supine, feet in straps, legs extended upward.
Lift hips, rolling spine off carriage.
Bend knees, bringing heels toward glutes overhead.
Roll down slowly, extending legs to start.

name: EZ Bar Reverse Preacher Curl
steps: Sit on preacher bench, grip EZ bar overhand at shoulder width, elbows resting on pad.
Curl bar towards chin, keep elbows stable.
Lower bar slowly to starting position, maintaining control throughout.

name: Kettlebell Single Leg Calf Raise
steps: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, lift the same foot as the side without the kettlebell off the floor.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Cuban Press
steps: Perform an upright row until elbows are bent at 90 degrees and arms parallel to the ground.
Rotate your shoulders, raising the dumbbells overhead. Then press overhead.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Clean And Press
steps: Hold dumbbell between legs, hinge slightly, and pull explosively to shoulder.
Catch dumbbell at shoulder height with knees slightly bent.
Press overhead until arm fully extends, then lower under control.

name: Weighted Wall Sit
steps: Press your back against a wall, feet shoulder-width apart, holding weights at your sides.
Lower into a squat position, thighs parallel to the floor, knees above ankles.
Hold the position, maintaining tension in your core and legs.

name: Reverse Expansion Teardrops Outward Kneeling
steps: Kneel tall facing straps, arms forward and slightly elevated.
Pull arms outward and down in a controlled teardrop pattern.
Emphasize upper-back engagement, ribs stacked over pelvis.
Return with control, maintaining steady breathing.

name: Alternating Heel Touch
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Reach right hand to right heel.
Switch sides, left hand to left heel. Repeat.

name: Midback Series Triceps Press Lying
steps: Lie prone supported, arms bent, elbows pointing forward.
Set shoulders down and back, engaging mid-back for stability.
Extend elbows fully, pressing arms long without shoulder movement.
Bend elbows to return, maintaining control and upper-back engagement.

name: Mini Band Laying Hip Abduction
steps: Loop band above knees, lie on side legs straight.
Lift top leg upward without rotating hips.
Lower slowly, keeping tension on band.

name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Curl
steps: Stand tall holding one dumbbell at your side, palm facing forward.
Curl dumbbell toward shoulder, keeping elbow close to your torso.
Squeeze bicep, then lower slowly to starting position.

name: Barbell Landmine Side Bend
steps: Stand straight and hold the end of the Barbell
Keep your hips and shoulders facing forward, bend to one side slowly
Return to the upright position.
Switch hands and repeat.

name: Plate Reverse Lunge
steps: Hold the plate at chest height close to your body
Take a big step backwards with your left leg, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground and your right knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push through your right heel to return to standing, bringing your left leg back to starting position.
Repeat the movement on the other side, stepping backwards with your right leg and lowering your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground and your left knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.

name: Barbell Pullover
steps: Lie flat on bench holding barbell above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower bar in an arc behind head until you feel a deep stretch.
Pull bar back over chest using lats and triceps under control.

name: Cable Incline Press Around
steps: Set cables slightly below shoulder height and step forward into staggered stance.
Press arm forward and upward in an arc, finishing slightly across your torso.

name: Kettlebell Wrist Extension
steps: Stand up straight with a kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis, with your forearms facing inwards.
Flex your wrist upwards until wrists are fully extended.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Suitcase Deadlift
steps: Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart and holding a kettlebell at one side of your body, with your palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and knees to lower the kettlebell down towards the ground.
As the kettlebell reaches the ground, use your legs and glutes to push through your heels and extend your hips and knees to raise your body back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of reps, then switch sides and repeat the exercise with the kettlebell on the opposite side of your body.

name: Band Overhead Press
steps: Stand between the two anchored bands, grasp them with an overhand grip, and position the bands at shoulder level.
Brace your core and push the bands overhead, fully extending your arms.
Lower the bands back to shoulder level, keeping your core engaged and arms straight. Repeat for desired number of reps.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Calf Raise
steps: Sit on the machine and press your back into the back pad.
Place the balls of your feet on the edge of the foot plate.
Let your heels lower until you feel a stretch in your calves, then press back up until you feel a contraction.

name: Kettlebell Preacher Curl
steps: Stand behind a bench, with your chest leaning over the edge of the bench.
With one arm resting on the bench, hold the kettlebell, bending the arm at the elbow.
Lower your arm using the bench as a guide, keeping your forearm straight.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Band Pullover
steps: Place the band just above our level. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Push your hips back slightly. Extend and flex at the shoulder joint.

name: Barbell Muscle Snatch
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, grip the barbell with a wide overhand grip, and keep your back straight and core engaged.
Lift the barbell by explosively extending your hips, knees, and ankles while keeping the bar close to your body.
As the bar reaches chest level, rotate your wrists and elbows up and back, transitioning into an overhead press.
Fully extend your arms overhead, stabilize the bar, then lower it back to the starting position with control.

name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
steps: Position the bench between
and
degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

name: Lower back Stretch Variation One
steps: Sit on the floor with the tops of your feet pointed and flat on the ground. Move your arms out in front of you in the diving position, placing your palms flat against the ground.
With your arms fully extended, rest your buttocks on the heels of your feet, you can crawl your hands forward to extend the stretch if need be.
Hold the extended position for a few seconds, and return to starting position.

name: Machine Squat Press
steps: Place your legs on the platform with your feet at shoulder width.
Release the weight and extend your legs fully, without locking your knees.
Lower the weight until your legs are at a 90° angle (but DO NOT allow your butt and lower back to rise off of the pad. This will put your lower back in a rounded position, which is very dangerous.)
Raise the weight back to starting position.

name: Mini Band Bent Arm Lateral Raise
steps: Loop band around elbows, arms bent
degrees at sides.
Raise both elbows outward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly and alternate, keeping tension on band.

name: Seated Hip Flexion Hold
steps: Sit on a bench without back support.
Keep an upright back and your shoulders back.
Raise one leg and maintain the position for the specified duration.

name: Single Leg Bosu Ball Balance 2
steps: Place the supporting leg on the middle of a bosu ball.
Keep the knee of the suspended leg slightly bent.
Try to maintain your balance on the bosu ball while bouncing a tennis ball off the wall.

name: Cable Zercher Good Morning
steps: Begin by standing with your feet about hip-width apart and holding the bar in the crook of your elbows, with your palms facing towards your body.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and lower your torso forward until it is nearly parallel to the ground.
Push through your heels to extend your hips and raise your body back to the starting position.

name: Elevated Pike Shoulder Shrug
steps: Use a bench or an object like a chair to elevate your feet.
Slowly lower your body (scapula) while keeping your elbows locked (this is key)
Slowly raise your body back to the start position.

name: Glute Ham Raise
steps: Position yourself on a glute ham raise machine or find a suitable substitute like a stability ball or bench.
Adjust the equipment to fit your body by setting the footplate at an appropriate height and making sure your feet are securely anchored.
Begin the movement by slowly lowering your upper body towards the ground while keeping your torso and legs aligned.
Once you reach the lowest point where your body is parallel to the ground or as far as you can comfortably go, pause briefly.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings again as you push yourself back up to the starting position, using the strength of your posterior chain muscles.

name: Barbell Split Jerk
steps: Start with the barbell on your shoulders in a front rack position, feet hip-width apart. Slightly bend your knees and dip straight down.
Explosively extend your legs and push the barbell upward, generating momentum with your legs.
As the bar rises, quickly split your legs (one forward, one back) and drop under the bar, locking your arms overhead.
Bring your front foot back, then your back foot forward to a stable standing position with the bar locked overhead.

name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
steps: Place the bar on your back
Start with feet flat on the ground
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.

name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Incline Chest Fly
steps: Lay on an incline bench with two dumbbells extended in front of you.
