You should have a slight bend in your elbows and maintain that bend. Your shoulder joint should do all the movement. You should have an overhand grip.
Bring the dumbbells out to your side. Stop the dumbbells before going behind your body.
Bring the dumbbells back together at the top.

name: Dumbbell Decline Bench Press
steps: Lay on a decline bench with both arms extended in front of you.
Break at the elbows and bring your upper arms to your side.
Once your upper arms have reached your side, press the dumbbells back to the ceiling.

name: Wall Supported Dorsal Flexion
steps: Lean against a wall, raise your toes and balance on your heels for the given duration.
Maintain a good upper body form.

name: Band Bent Over Row
steps: Stand on band with feet hip-width, holding handles with palms facing in.
Hinge at hips, keeping back flat and elbows close to ribs.
Pull handles toward torso, squeeze back, then lower slowly with control.

name: Cable Bar Skullcrusher
steps: Use a bar attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Face away from the machine with your elbows up and the attachment just behind your head.
Extend at the elbows until you feel a contraction in your triceps and then flex at the elbow back to the starting position.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Farmers March
steps: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, lift the knee of one leg off the floor to knee height.
Bring the leg back to standing and repeat with the other leg, keeping the kettlebell on the same side.
Repeat.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
steps: Place your shoulder blades against a box or bench that won't move.
Both your feet should be planted and your heels should not come off the floor. Point your toes forward.
Break at the hips. Seek the longest range of motion possible. Focus on the top end of the movement. Push your hips as high as possible on each rep.

name: Cable Incline Fly Around
steps: Set cables slightly above shoulder height and step forward into staggered stance.
Fly arm forward and upward in an arc, finishing slightly across your torso.

name: Cable Belt Split Squat
steps: Put on a dip belt and attach the strap/ chain to the cable's carabiner.
Take a few steps back and take a split stance.
Lower into a split squat, letting the weight pull you forward. As you squat back to the starting position push yourself backwards against the resistance.

name: Bodyweight Quad Stomp
steps: Place your foot on a plate or a low box.
Put all of your weight on your front foot and lean forward.
Lower until your calves touch your hamstrings and then extend back up.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Reverse Lunge
steps: Hold two dumbbells by your side.
Take a big step backwards with your left leg, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground and your right knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push back up and switch legs, alternating each rep.

name: Cable High Internally Rotated Reverse Fly
steps: Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arms. Internally rotate the shoulders.
From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

name: Standing Neck Extensions
steps: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back.
Lean your head back trying to keep the front of the neck straight.
Point your chin to the ceiling.

name: Kettlebell Figure Four Hip Thrust
steps: Begin seated, kettlebell on hips.
Lift hips, form figure four leg shape.
Lower, repeat thrusts.

name: Cable Decline Press Around
steps: Set cables slightly above shoulder height and step forward into staggered stance.
Press arm forward and downward in an arc, finishing slightly across your torso.

name: Dumbbell Leg Curl
steps: Lay flat on a bench with a dumbbell between your feet.
Flex your knees and raise the dumbbell until the soles of your shoes are pointed at the ceiling.

name: Dumbbell Incline Zottman Curl
steps: Lay on an incline bench with your palms facing forward.
Flex at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps.
When you hit the top of the movement, rotate your palms and then lower the dumbbells slowly.

name: Core Stability 2 Opposite Shoulder Tap 4Pt Position
steps: Bring yourself to the 4 point position (on all fours). 90° angles at hips and shoulder and neutral spine.
Lift your knees slightly off the ground supporting your weight on palms and toes.
Maintain a toe placement roughly at shoulder width (the wider the leg stance the easier the exercise - the narrower the stance the more difficult it becomes.
Tap your opposite shoulder with your fingertips.

name: Big Toe Abduction
steps: Sit on a bench with your bare foot on the ground.
Slightly raise your big toe before trying to move it towards the opposite side (abduction).
Expect he range of motion is very limited and the movement to be very difficult.
It helps a lot having your toe on a line as benchmark.

name: Bodyweight Figure Four Heels Elevated Hip Thrust
steps: Start by lying on a bench with your foot resting on top of a box, and cross one leg over the other.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the box.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Extension
steps: Start by hinging over with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring the dumbbells to your sides, with your palms facing forward and your elbows slightly bent.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
steps: Use a rope attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Use a neutral grip thumb facing up pinky-facing down). Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Press
steps: Laying on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, leave one arm resting to the side of the body.
Using the other arm, hold the kettlebell at arms length directly upwards of your shoulder.
Lower your arm until your upper arm to elbow is resting on the floor.
Return to starting position.

name: Bosu Ball Hand Sideplank Hip Abduction
steps: Start in a side plank with hand on Bosu.
Lift the top leg while keeping the body stable.
Lower the leg back down.

name: TRX Jumping Squat
steps: Stand facing the TRX straps and place your feet shoulder-width apart.
Begin by lowering into a squat position by bending at the knees and hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Explosively jump up off the ground, using your arms for momentum if desired.
Land softly back in the squat position, making sure to absorb the impact with your legs.

name: Mini Band Leg Raise
steps: Loop band around ankles, lie flat on back.
Raise both legs upward, keeping them straight.
Lower slowly without arching lower back.

name: Landmine Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
steps: Grab the end of the landmine and stand perpendicular to the bar.
Lift your inside leg and keep your outside leg planted.
Push your hips back keeping your knees mostly extended. When you feel the stretch in your hams, push your hips forward until you are standing upright.

name: Ez Bar Close Grip Curl
steps: Stand upright, hold EZ bar with narrow underhand grip, elbows pinned to sides.
Curl bar upward by flexing elbows, keep shoulders still throughout movement.
Squeeze biceps at top, pause briefly for maximum contraction.
Lower bar slowly under control until arms fully extended.

name: Cable Single Arm Decline Bench Chest Fly
steps: Bring a bench over to the cables, set the cable above shoulder height.
Bring the handle to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbow stays in a fixed position.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Row On Bench
steps: Start by standing in front of a flat bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Place your other hand on the bench for support, and bend at the waist so that your chest is parallel to the ground.
From this starting position, row the kettlebell up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blade together as you do so.
Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.

name: Cable Half Kneeling Low To High Wood Chopper
steps: Set the cable at a low position. Take a half kneeling position. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

name: Ring Row
steps: Set up rings at a high point.
Grip rings and lean back, arms extended.
Pull chest to rings, keeping body straight.

name: Dumbbell Staggered Deadlift
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place one foot slightly behind the other, with the heel of your back foot elevated on a step or weight plate.
From this starting position, bend at the hips and knees to lower the dumbbells towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Once the dumbbells are below your knees, drive through your heels to stand back up to the starting position.

name: Barbell Bent Over Row
steps: Grab a barbell with a shoulder width pronated or supinated grip.
Bend forward at your hips while maintaining a flat back.
Pull the weight toward your upper abdomen.
Lower the weight in a controlled manner and repeat.

name: Bosu Ball Front Raise
steps: Hold the bosu vertically.
Raise the bosu toward the ceiling while keeping your elbows mostly extended.

name: Barbell Deficit Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, bar on your back, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

name: Cable Bar Kneeling Crunch
steps: Use a bar attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Walk a few steps forward and fall to a kneeling position.
Push your hips back and flex your abs, then push hips forward until in the starting position.

name: Plate Curl To Overhead Press To Tricep Extension
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the torso, palms facing forward.
Curl the plate up to the front of the shoulder while keeping the elbows close to the body.
Rotate the palms to face forward and press the plate overhead, locking out the arms.
Lower the plate back behind the head to the starting position of a tricep extension.
Push the plate back up overhead, then lower it back to the starting position and repeat for desired reps.

name: Cardio Single Leg Lateral Hop
steps: Pick up one leg off the ground.
Hop laterally quickly while staying on your toes.

name: Medicine Ball Press Jack
steps: Hold medicine ball at chest.
Jump, extending arms overhead.
Return to starting position. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Snatch
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell between legs.
Squat, grip kettlebell, explode hips, and lift kettlebell overhead.
Lower kettlebell safely to start position.

name: Cable Seated Leg Curl
steps: Bring a bench over to the cable stack, put the cable at head height (when seated). Use an ankle attachment.
Sit on the bench.
Flex at the knee and pull your ankle straight back.

name: Alternating Pole Rotation
steps: Start with the pole in front of you with an overhand wider than shoulder width grip.
Rotate one arm overhead and behind while keeping the other arm in front of you.
Then rotate the other arm.
Bring the original arm back to the starting position, then the other arm. Repeat.

name: Dumbbell Supinated Row
steps: Grab both dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips. Make sure you keep a flat back.
The closer your torso is to parallel with the ground the longer the range of motion will be at your shoulder. The better the results you'll get from the exercise.
Let your arms hang freely, maintain an underhand grip, and then pull your elbow joint straight back toward the ceiling.

name: Hanging Knee Raises
steps: Grab the bar and hang, your body still and your legs straight.
Slowly draw your knees up to your chest

Once you have raised your knees as high as possible, lower your legs and repeat. Duration of these movements should be slow so that you do not utilize momentum, enabling you to get the most out of the exercise.
Duration of these movements should be slow so that you do not utilize momentum, enabling you to get the most out of the exercise.

name: Stability Ball Windshield Wiper
steps: Lie on your back, legs extended, stability ball between your feet, arms out for support.
Engage your core, lift your legs, and rotate them side to side in a controlled motion.
Keep your upper body stable, move slowly, and return to center before switching directions.

name: Mini Band Squat
steps: Loop band above knees, stand shoulder width.
Sit back and down, pushing knees outward.
Stand up, maintaining tension on band.

name: Cable Single Arm Bayesian Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Kettlebell Somersault Squat
steps: Start in a deep squat holding a kettlebell between your thighs.
Extend your knees until mostly extended without extending the hips.

name: Band Crunch
steps: Place the band at the highest anchor point you have available. Grab both ends of the band and fall into a kneeling position.
Push your hips back flexing at the spine.
Squeeze your abs and then extend at the hips and spine back to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Hammer Flat Curl
steps: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips pushed toward the ceiling.
Use a hammer grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Machine Belt Squat
steps: Put the belt around your waist and hook the end of the belt onto the machines.
Stand up to disengage the holding mechanism. Hold the arms while you squat.
Once you've completed your set, reset the holding mechanism.

name: Runners Lunge
steps: Begin in Downward Facing Dog pose (Adho Mukha Svanasana).
Step your right foot forward between your hands.
Place your left knee on the ground behind you and slide it back until you feel a stretch in your left hip flexor.
Keep your hands on the ground or lift them to the sky and hold for a few breaths before repeating on the other side.

name: Landmine Sumo Deadlift
steps: Stand with a wide stance and straddle over the end of the bar.
Bend at the hips and knees, and grab the bar.
Stand up with the bar.

name: Cable Seated Leg Extension
steps: Use an ankle/wrist attachment. Pull the cable under the bench and attach it at your ankle.
Extend at the knee against the cable.

name: Standing Neck Flexions
steps: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back.
Tuck your chin in and drop your head forwards without rounding the back.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Neutral Overhead Press
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder, with your palm facing your body and your elbow bent.
From this starting position, press the dumbbell upwards so that it is directly above your shoulder.

name: Kettlebell Incline Shrug
steps: Leaning across the back section of the bench, with feet firmly on the floor and with arms hanging to the sides.
Holding the kettlebell in both hands engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together. Release the shrug.

name: Plate Single Leg Pinch Grip Deadlift
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and facing forwards. Grip the sides of a weight plate with your palms facing down.
Balance on one foot, as you raise the weight keep your arms and back straight, while you bring your other foot back towards the ground
Keep four raised leg straight and in alignment with your back as you lower the plate back down to the starting position.

name: Landmine Seated Single Arm Overhead Press
steps: Sit on the ground facing the landmine with your legs spread. Hold the end of the bar in one hand in front of that shoulder with your palm facing across your body.

While keeping your torso tall and your core braced, drive the bar upwards until your arm is fully extended, leaning forward slightly for full range of motion in the shoulder joint. Lower the bar back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for desired number of reps on one side, then switch sides.

name: Barbell Zercher Good Morning
steps: Begin by standing with your feet about hip-width apart and holding a barbell in the crook of your elbows, with your palms facing towards your body.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and lower your torso forward until it is nearly parallel to the ground.
Push through your heels to extend your hips and raise your body back to the starting position.

name: Ez Bar Curl
steps: Stand tall, hold EZ bar with shoulder-width underhand grip.
Curl bar upward, keeping elbows tucked and torso stable.
Pause and squeeze biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until arms fully extended.

name: TRX Kneeling Ab Rollout
steps: Begin in a kneeling position with the TRX straps adjusted to mid-calf length.
Grasp the TRX handles with both hands, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your abs engaged, roll forward onto your toes, and extend your arms in front of you.
Slowly lower your body down to the ground, keeping your arms straight and your abs engaged.

name: Bodyweight Partial Step Down
steps: Stand on platform with one foot hanging off edge.
Lower hanging foot toward floor by bending standing knee slightly.
Drive through standing heel to return upright under control.

name: Seated Radial Nerve Slider
steps: From the seated position bring your arm out to the side with the palm facing back.
Flex your wrist at the same time you are leaning your head towards your outstretched arm.
Bend your head away from the the outstretched arm while simultaneously extending the wrist.

name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding kettlebells in front.
Hinge at hips, keeping back straight, and lower kettlebells towards ground.
Return to start position, squeezing glutes at the top.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Pendlay Row
steps: The dumbbells should be set on the ground. Hinge forward while keeping a flat back.
Pull one elbow back toward the ceiling and then return the dumbbell to the ground softly.
Then pull with the other arm.

name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Reverse Curl
steps: Hold dumbbell with palm facing down and arm straight by your side.
Curl dumbbell toward shoulder, leading with back of hand.
Lower slowly to starting position, keeping wrist stable.

name: Barbell Feet Elevated Figure Four Glute Bridge
steps: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a box, the barbell placed over your hips, and cross one leg over the other.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the box.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Cable Rope Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: You can use any attachment. The cable should be all the way to the bottom of the machine. Face away from the machine.
Point your elbows straight up toward the ceiling.
From there, extend your elbows until your fists are pointed straight toward the ceiling.

name: Medicine Ball Plank
steps: Place forearms on medicine ball, extend legs.
Maintain straight body position for desired time.

name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Goblet Romanian Deadlift
steps: Place one knee on a bench and hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Kettlebell Staggered Waiters Bow
steps: Set up a bar at mid way up your quad. Place the working leg against the bar.
Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.

name: Cable Bench Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cables should be set to shoulder height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

name: Core Stability 4 Crosslateral Limb Raise Push Up Position
steps: Bring yourself to a strict push-up position
Maintain a toe placement roughly at shoulder width (the wider the leg stance the easier the exercise - the narrower the stance the more difficult it becomes.
Tap your opposite shoulder with your fingertips.
Do not tilt or shift your hips. Do not round or arch your back.

name: Dumbbell Cross Body Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand with a shoulder width stance holding one dumbbell. Push your butt back while leaving your knees MOSTLY extended.
Reach toward the opposing leg. You should feel a stretch in your hamstrings. When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward to complete the rep.
Do not push your hips all the way forward. This will hyperextend your spine. Just go to a normal standing position.

name: Glute Bridge Eccentric Unilateral
steps: Lie down with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Push your hips up so that your butt is elevated and your back straight.
Tense your glutes and raise your hips towards the ceiling.
Once you are at the highest point you can manage, hold the position for a few seconds, and raise one leg off the ground.
Lower slowly to the start position.

name: Plate Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the plate held in front of the torso.
Take a step to the side with one foot, bending the knee and lowering the hips into a lunge.
Push through the front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side by stepping to the other side with the other foot.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring the dumbbells to your shoulders, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, extend your arms upwards so that the dumbbells are overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Gluteator
steps: Sit on the seat upright with your knees placed on the pads and your feet on the foot pads.
Push your legs outwards and backwards and flex your glutes.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Forward Lunge
steps: Stand tall, holding dumbbells by your sides, feet hip-width apart.
Step forward with one leg, lowering until both knees form 90° angles.
Push through front foot, return to start, and switch legs.

name: Forearms Stretch Variation Two
steps: Place your hand against a wall, palms facing upward, with finger tips touching.
Slowly lean into your palm.
Hold at the peak of the stretch.
Return to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Elbow Side Plank
steps: Take an elbow side plank position. Place a dumbbell on your hip.
Raise your hip up into position for the allotted amount of time.

name: Barbell Curl
steps: While holding the upper arms stationary, curl the weights forward while contracting the biceps as you breathe out.
Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a second and squeeze the biceps hard.
Slowly bring the weight back down to the starting position.

name: Lower back Stretch Variation Three
steps: Lay on your back with your arms at either side.
Raise your knees so that they are pointing straight towards the ceiling. Keeping your legs pressed together, rotate your hips to either side.
Repeat this motion as necessary.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Curtsy Deficit Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, dumbbell in goblet squat position, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

name: Band Single Arm Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Stand sideways to anchor, hold band with arm slightly bent and palm turned inward.
Bring arm across chest in a sweeping arc while keeping internal rotation.
Squeeze chest at end range, then return slowly under control.

name: Cable Rope Pullover
steps: Use a rope attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward somewhat.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. Imagine trying to pull the attachment through your thighs at the bottom.

name: Cable Pallof Press Rotation
steps: Use a handle attachment, set the cable at nipple level, walk a few steps away, and face sideways.
Start with both hands on the handle and your fists against your chest.
Press the handle forward until your elbows are fully extended, then rotate away from the cable stack.
Then pull the handle back to your chest.

name: Bodyweight Kickstand Squat
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, one foot slightly behind.
Lower into a squat, keeping weight on front heel.
Return to standing, engaging glutes and core.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Thruster
steps: Hold dumbbell at shoulder height with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing dumbbell overhead in one motion.
Lower dumbbell as you descend into next rep smoothly.

name: Smith Machine Bodyweight Skullcrusher
steps: Hold the smith bar and lean forward.
Keep your elbows tucked in and then flex and extend at the elbows.

name: Double Pigeon Pose
steps: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Place a block under your left knee, then bend your right knee and stack it on top of your left ankle.
Flex both feet and gently press your knees towards the ground, feeling a stretch in your hips.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, then switch sides and repeat.

name: Cable Standing Crunch
steps: Use a double handle attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Face away from the cable tower and walk a few steps forward.
Push your hips back, and flex your abs.
Return to the starting standing position and repeat.

name: Barbell Rack Pull
steps: Set barbell just below knee height in rack and stand hip-width apart.
Hinge at hips, grip bar firmly, and keep back flat.
Drive hips forward and stand tall, locking out at the top.

name: Single Leg One Leg Bent
steps: Lie supine, one foot planted, opposite leg in a tabletop position.
Engage core, maintain neutral pelvis.

name: Cable High Single Arm Hammer Rolling Curl
steps: Set cable at about elbow level. Stand facing away from the cables and grab handle attachment.
Take a neutral grip, flex your elbows, as you curl hinge forward.
As you extend your elbow, also extend your hips until you are back in a standing position.

name: Gastrocnemius Stretch Unilateral On Box
steps: Stand on the edge of a box, knees extended.
Bend one leg while allowing the weight to push the heel of your straight leg towards the ground.
You should feel your calves being stretched.

name: Cable Silverback Shrug
steps: Use a bar attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the bottom.
Stand up with the attachment in hand, walk a couple of steps back make sure you are standing upright and not leaning backwards.
Retract your shoulder blades and then protract to return to the starting position.

name: Pilates Footwork First Position
steps: Lie on reformer, heels together, toes apart on footbar.
Press carriage out by extending legs evenly.
Keep pelvis stable and core engaged.
Bend knees to return with control.

name: Barbell Banded Deadlift
steps: Loop bands under your feet and around the barbell. Stand hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips, keep your back flat, and lower to grasp the bar.
Drive through heels, extend hips and knees, and stand tall with shoulders back.

name: Cable Rope Kneeling Oblique Crunch
steps: Use a rope attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Walk a few steps forward then fall into a kneeling position.
Push your hips back and flex your abs, then push hips forward until in the starting position.

name: Band High Reverse Curl
steps: Start with a band attached to a high point, your feet staggered, and an overhand grip.
Flex your elbows pulling your forearms to your biceps. Your fists should land by your forehead.

name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Wood Chopper
steps: Take a half kneeling position. Start with the dumbbell by your knee on the side of the kneeling leg.
Rotate at the upper spine, holding the dumbbell away from your body with nearly extended elbows.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
steps: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Laying 30 Degree Shrug
steps: Lay sideways on a bench letting your arm hang freely.
Pull your shoulder blade and joint toward the ceiling.

name: Rotator Cuff External Rotations 1
steps: Stand side ways to a pulley (you can also attach a theraband to a fixed point instead).
Hold the grip (or band) with the arm away from the pulley. Bring that arm by your side and bend it at 90°
Externally rotate the palm against the resistance. Your elbow should remain by your ribs throughout the movement

name: Kettlebell Staggered Swing
steps: Lower kettlebell with control, then repeat.
Explosively thrust hips forward, swing kettlebell to chest height.
Repeat for desired reps, keeping core engaged and maintaining a staggered stance for balance.

name: Bodyweight Hip Abduction
steps: Abduct at the hips and raise your leg out to the side.
Return to the starting position and stop just short of your foot touching back to the ground (to keep tension on the muscle).

name: Bosu Ball Pike Pushup
steps: Place feet on Bosu, hips high, hands on the floor.
Lower the head towards the ground, then push back up.
Keep legs straight and hips elevated throughout.

name: Kettlebell Silverback Shrug
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hold one kettlebell in each hand at your sides, and lean forward.
Lift your shoulders backward while keeping arms straight.
Lower shoulders back down, repeat for desired reps.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Squat
steps: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and hold two dumbbells overhead with both hands, using an overhand grip.
Begin the squat by bending at the hips and knees, keeping your core tight and the dumbbells balanced overhead.
Lower your body as far as you can while keeping the dumbbells overhead, then push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, making sure to keep your back straight, chest lifted, and the dumbbells stable overhead throughout the entire movement.

name: Band Bench Fly
steps: Lie on bench holding band handles with arms extended above chest.
Lower arms out wide in a controlled arc, keeping slight bend in elbows.
Bring arms back together over chest, squeezing pecs at the top.

name: Elevated Pike Press
steps: Use a bench or an object to elevate your feet.
Lower your head towards the floor by bending your elbows
Push through your hands and return to the starting pike position.
Repeat

name: Plate Clean
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the feet.
Bend the knees and hips to pick up the plate, keeping the back straight and core engaged.
Stand up while pulling the plate towards the chest.
Keep shoulder level while keeping the elbows high and in front of the plate.

name: Dumbbell Larsen Press
steps: Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding dumbbells above chest.
Lower dumbbells toward chest while keeping legs elevated and torso stable.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without arching lower back.

name: Barbell Shoulder Extension
steps: Hold barbell behind hips with straight arms and palms facing back.
Keeping arms straight, lift bar slightly backward until lats engage.
Lower bar slowly to starting position while maintaining tension.

name: Barbell Seated Calf Raise
steps: Start by sitting on a bench with a barbell resting on your knees. Your feet should be flat on the ground, about hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the barbell for support, and lift your heels off the ground.
Hold this position for a moment, then slowly lower your heels back to the ground.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Start by lying flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the dumbbells at chest level with your palms facing forward.
Engage your core and press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.

name: Trap Bar Staggered Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand inside trap bar. Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Hip Thrust
steps: Adjust the machine for your height, sit with your back against the pad, knees bent, feet flat on the platform.
Brace your core, push through your heels, and extend your hips upwards, lifting the weight while squeezing your glutes.
Lower the weight slowly back to the starting position, ensuring controlled movement; repeat for desired reps and sets.

name: Calves Stretch Variation Two
steps: With both feet flat on the ground, place one leg in front of your shoulder, your other leg should mirror this position behind your other shoulder. In the starting position both of your knees should be straight.
Place the palms of your hands against the wall at shoulder height in front of you, lean towards the wall and bend your front leg at the knee while keeping your back leg straight.
Pause at the apex of the stretch and return to the starting position. Switch the position of your legs and repeat.

name: Forearms Stretch Variation One
steps: Place your palm flush against the wall.
Take one step forward and straighten your arm slowly to extend your bicep.
Hold at the peak of the stretch.
Return to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Laying Incline Row
steps: Lay on an incline bench that is between 30-45 degrees high.
Let your arms hang freely. Pull your elbows straight back toward the ceiling.

name: Cable Oblique Pushdown
steps: Set the cable just over your head. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, push the handle down until your elbow is extended. Flex your obliques until you feel a contraction.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

name: Bench Lift Off Active
steps: While seated on a bench, place your palms on the bench by your sides
Palm placement should allow room for the fingers to grip the edge of the bench
Try to lift your bodyweight off the bench by pushing the palms into the bench
Lockout your elbows and repeat or hold isometrically

name: Cable Bar Face Pull
steps: Facing the pulley, pull the weight towards you while keeping your arms parallel to the ground.
Pull your hands back to both sides of your head and hold the position.
Slowly return weight to starting position. Repeat.

name: Cable Incline Alternating Bench Press
steps: Lie on bench, cables should be above shoulder height, hold handles beside chest, elbows bent.
Press one handle upward until arm extends, opposite arm remains stationary.
Lower slowly, alternate arms while keeping shoulders stable.

name: Barbell High Bar Good Morning
steps: Place the bar on your traps. You may need a pad so the bar doesn't dig into your cervical spine.
Push your hips straight back. Your knees should stay MOSTLY extended (think soft knees). Also make sure to
Look for what feels like a stretch in your hamstrings. The stretch feeling means you're likely nearing the end of your Range of Motion without rounding your spine.
When you feel the stretch push your hips forward until you're in a standing position.

name: Cable Pull Around
steps: Place cable pin all the way at the top or nearly at the top of the cable stack.
Face sideways and take a half kneeling position.
Grab the handle and reach across the body, begin the pull.
As you pull, imagine you are trying to put your elbow into your pocket.

name: Band Leg Press
steps: Lay flat on the ground with your head by the anchor point of the band, which should be
to
inches above your head
Place the band around your midfoot and extend at the knees and hip.

name: Calf Raise 3B Soleus Bias Unilateral
steps: From the standing position, bend your knees till you get to a squated or semi-squated position. Be close to a pole or squat rack to use for balance
Maintain the squat while shifting your weight onto the working leg and raising the other off the ground
Raise your heel off the ground
Hold the position for a split second before lowering your heel again
Do not rest at the bottom. As soon as you feel your heel touch the ground, repeat the movement

name: Plate Weighted Inverted Row
steps: Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip. Place a plate on your chest.
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.

name: Barbell Toes Up Calf Raise
steps: Begin by standing on a raised surface (such as a step or box) with the balls of your feet on the edge of the surface and your heels hanging off. Hold a barbell across your upper back and shoulders, using an overhand grip.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels up as high as you can.
Lower your heels back down to the starting position, allowing your calves to stretch.

name: Kettlebell Bench Wrist Extension
steps: Grab two kettlebells with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across a bench.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.

name: TRX W Raise
steps: Hold the TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point.
Pull your elbows back while externally rotating your shoulder joint. Your arms should make a W shape at the back portion of the exercise.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Leg Extension
steps: Sit on the machine with your back against the cushion and adjust the machine you are using so that your knees are at a
degree angle at the starting position.
Raise the weight by extending your knees outward, then lower your leg to the starting position. Both movements should be done in a slow, controlled motion.

name: Bodyweight Close Grip Inverted Curl
steps: Grab the bar with a close grip. Feet on the floor.
Break at the elbow and curl your body toward the bar.

name: Cable Rope Front Raise
steps: Face away from the cables. Use a rope attachment.
With your elbows extended raise your fists straight up to the ceiling until they are at eye level.

name: Dumbbell Farmer Walk
steps: Grab a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight down.
Walk forward with a straight posture.

name: Bosu Ball Hand Sideplank
steps: Place hand on Bosu, arm straight, facing sideways.
Stack feet and lift hips to side plank.
Hold the side plank position, then switch sides.

name: Cable Incline Bench Straight Leg Kickback
steps: Use an ankle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. Put the bench at incline level. The cable should be set to shoulder height.
Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Flat Curl
steps: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips pushed toward the ceiling.
Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Side Bend
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell overhead.
From this starting position, bend to the side as far as you can while keeping your feet planted and your core engaged.

name: Plate Overhead Press To Tricep Extension
steps: Brace your core and press the weight plate overhead until your arms are fully extended. Keep your shoulders down and back.
While your arms are fully extended, lower the weight behind your head to perform the extension
After completing the extension, lower the weight to your chest, and perform the overhead press. Repeat

name: Cardio Long Jump
steps: Stand feet shoulder-width, knees slightly bent, arms behind you, eyes forward.
Swing arms backward, squat deeply, loading legs for explosive power.
Swing arms, explode forward, extend legs mid-air, land softly on both feet.

name: Kettlebell Gorilla Row
steps: Stand with kettlebell between legs.
Hinge at hips, grab kettlebell, pull to chest and rotate at the torso

name: Kettlebell Bottoms Up Single Arm Overhead Press
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding one kettlebell with the bottom of the kettlebell facing up.
Bring the kettlebell to your shoulders, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, extend your arms upwards so that the kettlebell are overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Plate Car Driver
steps: Inhale and brace your abdominals
Raise the arms vertically while keeping the elbows slightly bent
Once the arms are parallel with the floor, rotate the plate clockwise and counterclockwise.
Lower the plate back to the starting position.

name: Landmine Snatch
steps: Hold the end of the bar in front of you.
Pop your hips, pull your elbows up to the ceiling, and get underneath the bar.

name: Weighted Knee Push Ups
steps: Begin in a push-up position on your knees. Break at the elbow and shoulder joint.
Lower your body, keeping elbows close.
Push back up to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
steps: Stand tall with two dumbbells. Pull your shoulder blades up. Give a one second squeeze at the top.

name: Hip Lift
steps: Lie supine with knees bent, feet hip-width and flat. Hips slightly off the carriage.
Engage core and glutes, press through heels.
Maintain hip position as you press.

name: Bodyweight Stability Ball Crunch
steps: Start by lying flat on your back on a ball with your feet flat on the floor and your knees bent.
Engage your core muscles and flex your spine until you feel your abs contract.

name: Cardio Lateral Quick Feet
steps: Start with a shoulder width stance.
Quickly tap your feet while moving laterally.

name: Bosu Ball Single Leg Balance
steps: Place the supporting leg on the middle of a bosu ball.
Keep the knee of the suspended leg slightly bent.
Try to maintain your balance on the bosu ball.

name: Dumbbell Step Up
steps: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold two dumbbells on your side with a neutral grip.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench and stand up straight, keeping the barbell at your shoulders.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, to return to the starting position.

name: Medicine Ball Wood Chopper
steps: Hold medicine ball with both hands and arms extended.
Swing ball diagonally across body, engaging core.

name: Cable Braced Single Arm Chest Fly
steps: Stand sideways to cable, hinge forward, and hold handle at shoulder height.
Brace free hand against support, then bring working arm across chest in an arc.
Squeeze chest at the end, then slowly return to starting position.

name: Plate Full Lateral Raise
steps: Stand tall holding two plates at your side.
Lateral raise the plates to your side and continue until the plates are pointed at the ceiling.
Let your shoulder joint naturally rotate. At the bottom you should have a neutral or overhand grip. By the time the plates are overhead, your palms should be facing forward.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
steps: Go to your knees and ask someone to hold your ankles.
Put your hands in front of you
With a slight bend in your knees slowly bring your body to the ground (slower is better)
Push up and reset to the starting position.

name: L Sit Chin Up
steps: Grab the bar shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you)
With your body in an "L" position and arms fully extended, pull yourself up until your chin is past the bar.
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat on the ground. Place a barbell across your hips and grasp it with both hands.
Keeping your arms straight, push through your heels to lift your hips off the ground and raise the barbell.
Hold the bridge position for a moment, then slowly lower your hips back to the starting position.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Curl
steps: Stand up straight with a kettlebell in one hand with your forearm facing out.
Raise the kettlebell, bending your arm at the elbow and keeping your forearm vertical until your palm faces the shoulder.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

name: Scissor Kick
steps: Lie on your back, hands under your buttocks or on the ground for support.
Lift legs off the ground, alternate crossing them in a scissor motion.

name: Band Single Arm Lateral Raise
steps: Stand on band and hold handle or loop at your side with slight elbow bend.
Raise arm out to the side until shoulder height, keeping torso still.
Lower slowly under control, maintaining constant tension on the delt.

name: Machine Horizontal Sissy Leg Press
steps: Place your feet at the bottom the platform at shoulder width. Lift your heels up.
Press against the platform and extend your legs fully, without locking your knees.
Lower the weight until your legs are at a 90° angle (but DO NOT allow your butt and lower back to rise off of the pad. This will put your lower back in a rounded position, which is very dangerous.)
Raise the weight back to starting position.

name: Band Standing Good Morning
steps: Stand on band and loop it around upper back, feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at hips while keeping back flat and slight bend in knees.
Squeeze glutes to return to standing, maintaining band tension throughout.

name: Seated Ulnar Nerve Tensioner
steps: Abduct your arm at 90° palm facing down.
Bend your elbow and wrist to bring the palm to face the ceiling while leaning the head towards the opposite shoulder.
Find the position of maximum tension (without pain) and hold.
To increase the stretch, press the palm against the face and try to point the elbow up.

name: Bosu Ball Single Leg Elevated Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on back, place one foot on Bosu, knee bent.
Lift hips, squeezing glutes, one leg extended.
Lower hips back down and switch legs.

name: Back Rowing Preps Open Elbow Seated
steps: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps at shoulder height.
Start with elbows bent, hands near chest, palms facing inward.
Open elbows wide, rotating shoulders externally while keeping chest lifted.
Return with control, maintaining upright posture and steady strap tension.

name: Standing Forward Bend Blocks
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place a block on the ground in front of you.
Hinge forward at your hips and place your hands on the block.
Allow your head to hang heavy and feel a stretch in the back of your legs.
Hold for a few breaths and then slowly roll up to a standing position.

name: Plate Deficit Lunge
steps: Stand on a plate with both feet.
Step back with one foot to the floor and let your back knee get close to or tap the floor.
Push through your front leg until both feet are back on the plate.

name: Cable Decline Bench Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cables should be set above height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

name: Cable Single Arm Incline Bench Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cable should be set fairly low.
Bring the handle across your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulder and elbow simultaneously.

name: Cable Overhead Press
steps: Use a handle attachment with the cable set to the bottom of the machine. Stand upright making sure to maintain a flat back. Your starting position will have your palms facing forward.
Use both your elbows and shoulders to press the weight directly overhead.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Hammer Curl
steps: Stand or sit tall holding dumbbell at your side with palm facing inward.
Curl dumbbell toward shoulder while keeping elbow tight to torso.
Squeeze bicep, then lower slowly to full extension under control.

name: Push Up
steps: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.

name: Chest Stretch Variation Four
steps: Raise your arms to shoulder height, fully extended in front of you.
Slowly bring your arms behind your back still at shoulder height.
Pause for a few seconds and then return to starting position.

name: Shoulder Flexion Wall Stretch
steps: Stand facing a wall.
Raise your arm above the head and place it on the wall, thumb facing back.
Slide the arm up and lean into the wall to increase the stretch.

name: Landmine Single Arm Chest Press
steps: Starting lying on your back perpendicularly to the barbell while holding the end of the bar in your hand that is further away from the landmine attachment. Your elbow should be rest on the ground at a
to
degree angle from your torso, with your wrist stacked over your elbow.
Drive the end of the bar upwards, squeezing your chest at the top of the movement. Lower the bar back down until your elbow gently touches the ground.
Repeat for the desired number of reps on one side before switching sides.

name: Dumbbell Laying Curl
steps: Hold the dumbbells with an underhand grip. Seated on a bench.
Start with the dumbbells pointed toward the ceiling, then lower the dumbbells toward your sides.
Fully extend your elbows, but don't let your upper arm fall behind your torso.

name: Cardio Row Erg Rower
steps: Sit on seat, feet strapped in, grip handle with arms extended.
Push with legs, lean back slightly, pull handle to lower ribs.
Extend arms, lean forward from hips, bend knees to return to start.

name: Treadmill Walk
steps: Get the treadmill up to a comfortable speed where you are doing a walk.

name: Dumbbell Incline Front Raise
steps: Grab two dumbbells while sitting on an incline bench upright with the dumbbells at your side.
Raise the two dumbbells with your elbows being fully extended until the dumbbells are eye level.
Lower the weights in a controlled manner to the starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Row Bilateral
steps: Grab both dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips. Make sure you keep a flat back.
The closer your torso is to parallel with the ground the longer the range of motion will be at your shoulder. The better the results you'll get from the exercise.
Let your arms hang freely, and then pull your elbow joint straight back toward the ceiling.

name: Medicine Ball Wall Ball
steps: Hold medicine ball at chest, facing wall.
Squat down, then throw ball at wall.
Catch and repeat for desired reps.

name: Quads Stretch Variation Two
steps: Place one foot flat on the ground in front of you at a
degree angle. With your other leg, balance upon your knee, placing the tip of your foot against the wall behind you for balance.
Place your hands on your knee in front of you, and lean forward so that your knee extends over your foot.
Pause at the apex of the stretch, and slowly return to starting position. Repeat with your other leg.

name: Kettlebell Hang Squat Clean And Jerk
steps: Hold kettlebell between legs with slight knee bend and flat back.
Pull kettlebell explosively to shoulder, catching it in a squat position.
Stand tall, dip slightly, then drive up to press kettlebell overhead.

name: Dumbbell Decline Guillotine Bench Press
steps: Lie on the decline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out. As you lower the dumbbells, exhale deeply.
Once your elbows reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up
steps: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold one dumbbell on your shoulder with an overhand grip.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench and stand up straight, keeping the barbell at your shoulders.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, to return to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Push Press
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
From this starting position, dip your knees slightly and then quickly extend them as you press the dumbbells upwards.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Incline Skullover
steps: Lay flat on an incline bench with two dumbbells pointed toward the ceiling.
Break at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps, then flex at the shoulder joint bringing your upper arms to the sides of your head.
Bring your elbows back up until they are pointed at the ceiling, then extend your elbows.

name: Smith Machine Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Maintain the natural arch in your back and put the bar on your back. Squeezing your shoulder blades and raise your chest.
Grip the bar across your shoulders and support it on your upper back. Unwrack the smith machine by straightening your legs.
Bend your knees as you lower the weight without altering the form of your back until your hips are below your knees.
Raise the bar back to starting position, lift with your legs and exhale at the top.

name: Bench Dips
steps: Grip the edge of the bench with your hands, Keep your feet together and legs straight.
Lower your body straight down.
Slowly press back up to the starting point.
TIP: Make this harder by raising your feet off the floor and adding weight.

name: TRX Knee Tuck
steps: Place your feet in the TRX stirrups and get in to a hand plank position.
Pull your knees to your chest and flex your abs.

name: Kettlebell Front Rack Lateral Lunge (Double)
steps: Hold kettlebell in front rack.
Step sideways into a lunge position.
Return to start position. Repeat.

name: Machine Standing Calf Raises
steps: Adjust the machine in accordance with your height and place your shoulders underneath the padded lever.
The balls of your feet should be supporting your weight on the calve block, your heels extending off of it.
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.

name: Medicine Ball Squat Reach
steps: Hold medicine ball at chest.
Squat down, reach ball to one side.
Stand up and repeat reach on other side.

name: Pole Overhead Squat
steps: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and hold a pole overhead, using an overhand grip.
Begin the squat by bending at the hips and knees, keeping your core tight and the dumbbells balanced overhead.
Lower your body as far as you can while keeping the dumbbells overhead, then push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, making sure to keep your back straight, chest lifted, and the dumbbells stable overhead throughout the entire movement.

name: Smith Machine Guillotine Bench Press
steps: Lie on the flat bench, grasp the bar at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Slowly lower the bar to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out.
Once you feel a stretch in your chest press the weight back up.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring the dumbbells to your shoulders, with your palms facing inward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, dip your knees slightly and then quickly extend them as you press the dumbbells upwards.
As you press the dumbbells upwards, also push your hips forward to help generate additional power.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bosu Ball Pullover
steps: Lie on ground with head and shoulders supported.
Hold a bosu and lower it back over the head.
Bring the bosu back over the chest to complete one rep.

name: Monkey Pose
steps: Begin in a low lunge with your right foot forward and your left knee on the ground.
Slowly slide your left knee back while extending your right leg forward, keeping both legs straight.
Lower your body down to the ground, using your hands for support if needed.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, then switch sides and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Bench Wrist Curl
steps: Grip the kettlebells with your palm facing upwards with your forearm rested against the bench.
Slowly curl your wrist upwards in a semicircular motion.
Return to starting position and repeat.

name: Landmine Single Arm Overhead Press
steps: Stand in front of the landmine with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Grasp the landmine barbell with one hand, palm facing in, and bring it to shoulder height with your elbow tucked beneath your hand.

Press the barbell overhead by extending your arm fully, pushing the weight upward. Keep your core engaged, your back straight, and your shoulder down throughout the movement. Pause briefly at the top of the movement with your arm fully extended overhead. Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position at shoulder height with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps on one side before switching sides.

name: Bodyweight Lateral Lunge Jump
steps: Start with a shoulder width stance.
Jump laterally and fall into a squat. Tap the ground.
Jump the opposite direction

name: Cable Pallof Press
steps: Use a handle attachment, set the cable at nipple level, walk a few steps away, and face sideways.
Start with both hands on the handle and your fists against your chest.
Press the handle forward until your elbows are fully extended, then pull the handle back to your chest.

name: Supermans
steps: Lie face down on the floor with your arms fully extended in front of you.
Simultaneously raise your arms, legs and chest off of the floor and hold the position.
Slowly lower your arms, legs and chest back to the starting position. Repeat.

name: Back Rowing Preps Triceps Seated
steps: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps at chest height.
Start with elbows bent, upper arms close to sides.
Extend elbows fully, pressing straps back while keeping torso upright.
Bend elbows slowly to return, maintaining control and steady tension.

name: Cable Standing Alternating Internally Rotated Decline Chest Fly
steps: Stand between high cables with arms extended and palms facing downward.
Sweep one handle downward and across your chest with a slightly bent elbow.
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.

name: Bodyweight Hanging Knee Tuck
steps: Grip bar, hang with arms extended, body straight.
Engage core, lift knees towards chest.
Lower legs back down, maintain controlled movement.

name: Dumbbell Laying Incline Lateral Raise
steps: Lay on your side on an incline bench. Brace yourself by holding onto the bench.
While keeping your elbow mostly extended, raise the dumbbell to the side.
The end of the range of motion is when the dumbbell is pointed toward the ceiling.
Make sure you don't flex and extend your elbow.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Incline Chest Press
steps: Adjust the seat pad to match your height.
Press the weight forward until your elbows are nearly extended. Return to the starting position with out letting the weight rest at the bottom until finishing your set.

name: Kettlebell Swing Lunge
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width. Kettlebell at your side.
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Step back with the same leg until the back knee taps the floor.

name: Bodyweight Underhand Inverted Row
steps: Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with an underhand grip.
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.

name: Infinity Loop Standing Hip Mobility
steps: From the standing position raise one knee till the thigh is parallel to the ground.
Bring the knee to your side without rotating the hips.
The knee drives the movement and the ankle lags slightly behind.

name: Cobra Pose
steps: Start prone, hands under shoulders.
Inhale, lift chest, arch back.
Elongate neck, gaze up. Breathe, hold. Release, exhale.

name: Kettlebell Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Grab a stick of some sort or hold onto something stable (rack, bench).
Grab a box that is knee height or slightly lower.
Hold the stick in your right arm, kettlebell in the other and put your right leg on the box.
Begin your squat by breaking at the knees. Get your knee close to the floor or all the way to the floor. Make sure to keep your chest tall.

name: Machine Pullover
steps: Adjust the seating pad for your height.
Place your elbows on the elbow pad. Pull the bar forward until it nearly touches your stomach.

name: Barbell Meadows Row
steps: Position a barbell in a landmine or corner of a room and stand facing sideways with a staggered stance and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the end of the barbell with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower your torso until it is almost parallel to the ground.
Pull the barbell towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together as you row the weight up.
*Named after the late John Meadows

name: Slalom Mountain Climber
steps: Start in a plank position with hands directly under shoulders.
Drive knees toward left elbow.
Go back to starting position, then drive knees to right elbow, mimicking a zigzag slalom motion.

name: Dumbbell Heels Up Narrow Goblet Squat
steps: Stand with your feet on a plate. Your feet should be very close to one another, but not touching.
Begin your squat by pushing your hips back and breaking at the knees. Try to keep your chest tall while squatting.

name: Barbell Deadlift
steps: Stand with your mid-foot under the bar and grip the bar with your hands, about a shoulder width apart.
Bend your knees, then lift the bar by straightening your back. It is important to keep your back straight.
Stand to your full height and hold.
Lower the bar to the floor by bending your knees and keeping your back straight.

name: Barbell Banded Romanian Deadlift
steps: Loop bands under your feet or anchors and around the barbell. Stand tall with soft knees.
Hinge at the hips, keeping the bar close and back straight throughout.
Squeeze glutes, drive hips forward, and return to full standing position.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding 2 dumbbells in each hand.
Keep your back straight and chest lifted, engage your core to maintain balance.
Begin the movement by lifting the dumbbells straight up towards your chin, keeping your elbow close to your body and the weight in line with your shoulder.
Continue to lift the weight until it reaches the chin or neck level, keeping the elbow high and close to the body.

name: Barbell Sumo Pause Deadlift
steps: Set up for a sumo deadlift, grip the barbell.
Lift, pause at knee height.
Hold briefly, then complete the lift; reset and repeat for desired reps.

name: Cable Standing Mid Kickback
steps: Use an ankle attachment. The cable should be set halfway up the crossover machine.
Start with a bent knee position. Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

name: Stability Ball Stir The Pot
steps: Kneel behind a stability ball, place forearms on top, and engage your core muscles.
Lift knees, balance on toes, and slowly move forearms in small controlled circles.
Maintain a stable torso, avoid excessive movement, and reverse direction after several rotations.

name: Barbell Split Squat
steps: Take a large step forward with one leg, and lower your body until your back knee nearly touches the ground. Your front knee should be bent at a 90-degree angle, and your back leg should be straight.
Push through the heel of your front foot to raise your body back to the starting position.

name: Barbell Spoto Press
steps: Start on the bench with your shoulder blades pulled back.
As you initiate the first rep, tuck your elbows slightly until the bar is a few inches off your chest.
Pause just off your chest for 1-3 seconds. Then press explosively.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Supinations Pronations
steps: Sit by a bench or table and lean your arm on it.
Hold a dumbbell/weight/lever on one end.
Rotate the wrist so the palm faces down and up in succession.

name: Kettlebell Farmers Carry
steps: Hold two kettlebells in each hand.
Keep your shoulders blades pulled back and walk for a specified duration.

name: Bosu Serratus Activation Plank
steps: Support your weight with your forearms on the bosu and toes on the floor (plank).
Allow your upper back to sink in between the shoulder blades.
Push your elbows into the ground and slightly forward, and move the shoulder blades away from the spine.

name: Kettlebell Squat Clean And Jerk
steps: Start with kettlebells between legs resting on the floor with knee bend and flat back.
Pull kettlebells explosively to shoulder, catching it in a squat position.
Stand tall, dip slightly, then drive up to press kettlebells overhead.

name: Standing Inversions Hold
steps: Stand up straight with a relatively narrow stance.
Roll your feet out and balance.
Make sure you do not roll out excessively or you are risking re-injury.

name: Plate Weighted Dip
steps: Use a dip belt to attach a plate to yourself. Grip bars with arms straight, shoulders above hands. Keep legs straight or bent.
Lower slowly until elbows are at
degrees.
Push back up to start position, extending arms fully.

name: Landmine Kneeling Overhead Press
steps: Start kneeling in front of the landmine, facing towards it, with your knees hip-width apart and your back straight while holding the end of the bar in both hands in front of your chest.

Push the landmine up overhead by fully extending your arms until the weight is directly over your head. Pause briefly at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the landmine back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

name: Plate Thruster
steps: Start with the plate at chest height. Begin a squat.
Make sure to hit parallel depth. On your way back up, use the momentum you generate with your legs to help push the plate into an overhead position.
Let the plate return to chest height before initiating the next squat.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and place your right hand on the right hip.
Hold a dumbbell with the left hand. Bend at the hips to the side.
Make sure you don't start to lean forward to try and force a longer range of motion.

name: Mini Band External Rotation
steps: Anchor band, elbow at side bent
degrees.
Rotate forearm outward, keeping elbow pinned.
Return slowly to start, controlling resistance.

name: Cable Rope Face Pulls
steps: Facing the pulley, pull the weight towards you while keeping your arms parallel to the ground.
Pull your hands back to both sides of your head and hold the position.
Slowly return weight to starting position. Repeat.

name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend at the waist and place your opposite hand on your knee for support.
From this starting position, extend your arm backwards so that the dumbbell is behind your body.
Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.

name: Forearms Stretch Variation Three
steps: Place your hands together.
Rotate your arms and hands
degrees.
Hold at the peak of the stretch.
Return to starting position.

name: Machine Plate Loaded T Bar Row
steps: Hinge forward while keeping your back flat.
Grab the handles and pull the weight toward your chest.
Make sure to fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep. Also make sure to not use momentum.

name: Cable Standing Single Arm Cross Rear Delt Row
steps: Stand sideways to cable and hold handle across your body at opposite side.
Pull handle outward and back, leading with elbow and keeping arm slightly bent.
Squeeze rear delt at the end, then return slowly with control.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
steps: Hold the dumbbells with a neutral grip (thumbs facing the ceiling).
Slowly lift the dumbbell up to chest height.
Return to starting position and repeat.

name: Bodyweight Elevated Push Up
steps: Start by placing two plates or low boxes on the floor, about shoulder-width apart.
Position yourself in a plank position with your hands on top of the boxes/plates, keeping your arms straight.
Keep your feet together, with your toes resting on the floor.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the floor by bending your arms, until your chest nearly touches the dumbbells.
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms and engaging your chest, triceps and shoulders.

name: Barbell Tricep Guillotine Press
steps: Unrack the barbell. Break at the elbows and begin lowering the barbell.
Lower the barbell to your neck before extending your elbows back to the starting position.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm High Incline Chest Press
steps: Sit on high incline bench holding kettlebell at shoulder height.
Press kettlebell upward and slightly inward until arm fully extends.
Lower slowly to start position, keeping torso stable and controlled.

name: Machine Assisted Pull Up
steps: Adjust weight for assistance. Stand on platform, grip handles above shoulder-width. Knees on pad if available.
Slowly pull up until chin is above the bar. Keep elbows close, core engaged.
Lower back with control. Pause at bottom. Repeat for reps.

name: Cable Bench Chest Fly
steps: Bring a bench over to the cables, set the cables just below shoulder height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

name: Midback Series Circles Inward
steps: Lay flat on carriage with arms toward the ceiling.
Move arms out to a t-pose.
Pull arms to your side, then raise arms back toward ceiling.

name: Cable Bar Rolling Pushdown
steps: Stand facing cable holding bar with palms down, elbows bent, and shoulders flexed.
First extend your shoulders (like performing a pullover), then extend the elbows.

name: Barbell Staggered Deadlift
steps: Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Stand with your back to a bench (or raised surface) and place one of your feet on the bench.
Squat down until your front leg is about parallel to the floor.
Go back to the starting position. After completing the desired amount of reps, switch legs and repeat.

name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the ground with a bench behind you. Have the bar over your legs just above your hips.
Lean back against the bench so that your shoulders are resting upon it, stretch your arms out to either side using the bench as support.
Raise the weight by driving through your feet and extending your hips upwards. Support the weight with your shoulders and feet.
Slowly extend as far as you can, and then slowly return to the starting position.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Decline Chest Press
steps: Adjust the seat pad to match your height.
Press the weight forward until your elbows are nearly extended. Return to the starting position with out letting the weight rest at the bottom until finishing your set.

name: TRX Pushup
steps: Start by setting up the TRX straps to a secure anchor point and adjust the straps so that they hang about waist height when you stand under them.
Stand facing the TRX straps, grab the handles with both hands, and step forward so that your body is in a plank position with your hands directly beneath your shoulders.
Lower your body down by bending your elbows until your chest nearly touches the handles. Keep your core tight and your body in a straight line.
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms as you do so. Make sure to engage your chest, triceps, and core throughout the movement.

name: Inverted Row
steps: Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.

name: Vitruvian Overhead Press
steps: Hold the handle attachments with your fists to the sky and elbows toward the floor.
Press the handles to the ceiling.

name: TRX Rotating Row
steps: Grab the TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point until the strap is taut.
Start with an overhand grip. Pull your elbows back and rotate your grip.
By the time your elbows reach your side, your palms should be facing upwards.

name: Machine Standing Shrug
steps: Grab both handles and stand upright. Make sure you keep a flat back while lifting to the starting position.
Pull your shoulder blades straight up toward the ceiling.

name: Laying Lateral Raise
steps: Lay on your side on a bench or box. Place one hand on the floor and the other hand is holding the dumbbell.
While keeping your elbow mostly extended, raise the dumbbell to the side.
The end of the range of motion is when the dumbbell is pointed toward the ceiling.
Make sure you don't flex and extend your elbow.

name: Bodyweight Diamond Knee Push Ups
steps: Begin in a push-up position with your hands forming a diamond shape under your chest.
Lower your body, keeping elbows close.
Push back up to the starting position.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Hang Clean And Jerk
steps: Hold kettlebell in one hand at thigh level with slight knee bend.
Pull kettlebell explosively to shoulder, catching it in rack position.
Dip slightly, then drive upward to press kettlebell overhead.

name: Cardio Sprint In Place
steps: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, ready to move.
Quickly drive knees up towards chest, alternating legs, pumping arms in rhythm.
Gradually speed up, maintaining high knees and arm movement, breathe steadily.

name: Plate Wood Chopper
steps: Stand with a shoulder width stance. Begin with the plate near one of your quads.
Rotate at your upper spine to engage the obliques.
You can pivot your back foot to keep from generating too much torque at the knee.

name: Cable Kneeling Pallof Press
steps: Kneel sideways to cable and hold handle at chest, elbows tucked.
Brace core and press handle straight forward without rotating torso.
Hold briefly, then return handle to chest under full control.

name: Cable Row Bar Standing Row
steps: Place the cable at shoulder height. Use a row bar.
Pull the handles back using your arms. Push out your chest.
Pull the handles towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.

name: Bodyweight Swing Lunge
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width.
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Step back with the same leg until the back knee taps the floor.

name: Hamstring Bridge With Elevated Legs Box Unilateral
steps: Lie on your back. Place one heel on a box or bench, having a 90° angle at hip and knee.
Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back against the ground).
Push through your heel into the box, lifting your hips up to the point where there is a straight line from your chest to your knees.

name: Machine Reverse Fly
steps: Sit on machine and press your chest into the pad.
Grab the handles with an overhand grip. Keep your elbows mostly extended.
Bring your arms backwards and squeeze your scapula together.

name: Seated Box Jump
steps: Setup two boxes. One to jump on and one to sit.
Go from a seated position and pop your hips forward forcefully.
Jump and land on the box softly.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Step Up Knee Drive
steps: Hold one dumbbell at your side and place opposite foot firmly on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping torso tall and core tight.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

name: Happy Baby
steps: Lie down on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Lift your feet off the floor and bring your knees towards your chest.
Reach inside your knees and hold onto the outside edges of your feet.
Gently pull your knees towards your armpits and rock side to side for a few breaths.

name: TRX Curl
steps: Hold the TRX straps with an underhand grip and lean back and away from the anchor point.
Keep your elbows high as you flex your elbows. Pull your fists toward your forehead.

name: Cable 30 Degree Shrug
steps: Use a handle attachment on both sides of crossover. With cable attachment set all the way to the bottom.
Grab both handles and make sure you are centered in the machine. Let your arms hang freely.
Pull your shoulder blades up and in towards your ears. Let your shoulder blades depress back to the starting position.

name: Barbell Drag Curl
steps: Grab a barbell with an underhand grip.
Pull your elbows straight back and let the bar drag against your upper body (or very close to it).

name: Machine Hip And Glute Kickback
