steps: Stand on the platform and sideways on the machine.
Place the pad at just above hip height. Place the working leg over the pad.
Extend the working leg backwards and flex your glute at the end of each rep.

name: Pilates Back Rowing Seated Row
steps: Sit tall, legs extended, hold straps with arms forward.
Pull handles toward torso, squeezing shoulder blades together.
Keep chest lifted and spine neutral throughout.
Extend arms forward under control.

name: Crow Pose
steps: Begin in a squatting position with your feet together and your knees apart.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you, shoulder-width apart. Keep your arms straight and engage your core.
Slowly shift your weight forward and lift your feet off the ground, coming onto your tiptoes.
Bend your elbows and lean your weight onto your hands, shifting your knees towards your upper arms.
Gently lift one foot off the ground, and then the other, balancing on your hands. Hold the pose for a few breaths before releasing back to the ground.

name: Pilates Teaser Prep
steps: Lie supine, knees bent, arms reaching toward thighs.
Lift head, shoulders, and upper back off carriage.
Reach forward while maintaining core engagement.
Lower slowly back to starting position.

name: Hand Side Plank
steps: Press your hand into the ground and pick up your hip off the ground.
Open your chest and maintain this position for the allotted amount of time.

name: Plate Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Stand or sit with a weight plate in your hands, arms extended straight above your head
Lower the weight plate behind your head by bending at the elbows.
Keep your elbows close to your head and shoulders relaxed.
Push the weight plate back up to starting position, extending your arms fully.

name: Cable Standing Hip Abduction
steps: Use an ankle attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the bottom.
Face sideways with the ankle attachment on your outside leg. Walk a few steps away.
Abduct at the hips and raise your leg out to the side.
Return to the starting position and stop just short of your foot touching back to the ground (to keep tension on the muscle).

name: Single Legged Romanian Deadlifts
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent and raise one leg.
Without changing the bend in your knee, bend at your hips, and lower your torso until it's almost parallel to the floor.
Tense your glutes and then bring yourself back to the starting position.

name: Plate Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a weight plate in front of your chest with both hands.
Keep your back straight, lower your body as if you were sitting back into a chair.
Go as low as you can while keeping your heels flat on the ground, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.

name: Child Pose Arms On Side
steps: Begin in a tabletop position with your hands and knees on the ground.
Sit back onto your heels and place your arms at your sides with your palms facing up.
Rest your forehead on the ground.
Hold for a few breaths and then release.

name: Mini Band Standing Hip Flexion
steps: Loop band around feet or anchor behind you.
Lift one knee upward to hip height.
Lower slowly without leaning backward.

name: Slider Hamstring Curl Eccentric
steps: Bend your knees so your feet are flat on the floor with heels under knees and toes raised.
Place sliders under your heels. Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back against the ground).
Push through your heels into the ground, lifting your hips up to the point where there is a straight line from your chest to your knees.
Extend your legs in a slow, controlled manner, to lower your bum to the ground.
Casually bend knees before repeating.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Thruster
steps: Hold kettlebell at shoulder height with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing kettlebell overhead in one motion.
Lower kettlebell as you descend into next rep smoothly.

name: Bodyweight Pike Shrug
steps: Start in a plank position and raise your hips toward the ceiling.
Slowly lower your body (scapula) while keeping your elbows locked (this is key)
Slowly raise your body back to the start position.

name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Single Arm Overhead Press
steps: Take a half kneeling position while holding one dumbbell.
Drive the dumbbell upwards.

name: Ez Bar Spider Curl
steps: Lay on an incline bench and hold an incline bench with your elbows extended.
From this starting position, curl the bat up towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body and your core engaged.
Slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Behind The Neck Seated Overhead Press
steps: Take a roughly shoulder width grip. There should be a straight line from your elbow to fist (vertical forearms).
Push your head foward and press the weight toward the ceiling by extending at the elbow joint and flexing at the shoulder joint.
Press until your elbows are extended and push your head forward slightly.

name: Cable Bar Staggered Romanian Deadlift
steps: Start with a straight bar attachment set to the bottom of the machine. Squat the weight up into a standing position and walk a few steps back.
Stand with a staggered stance. Push your butt back to initiate the movement and then push your butt forward until you're back in a standing position.
To protect yourself from injury, always maintain a flat back on any exercise.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Hold a dumbbell overhead.
Flex at the elbows until the dumbbell is behind your head.
Then extend your elbows until the dumbbell is back in the starting position.

name: Thread The Needle Hip Over Knees
steps: Start on your hands and knees in a tabletop position.
Slide your right knee up between your hands and place your right foot close to your left wrist.
Take your left leg back and lower it down to the ground, keeping your toes tucked.
Twist your torso to the right and reach your right arm underneath your left arm, threading the needle. Hold for a few breaths, then switch sides.

name: Bodyweight Assisted Chin Up
steps: Grasp the chin-up bar with an underhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Place your feet on the ground, legs bent slightly.
Use your legs to assist as you pull your chin above the bar.

name: Plate Waiters Bow
steps: Place a barbell at about midway up your thigh. Press your quads into the barbell. Hold a plate up to your chest.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Chest Fly
steps: Lie on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, with your arms to the side of your body.
Holding a kettlebell in one hand, keeping your arm fully extended with a slight bend in the elbow and your forearms facing upwards, lift the kettlebell above your chest.
Lower the kettlebell to the starting position and repeat.

name: Cable Single Arm Face Pull
steps: Stand facing cable and hold handle at shoulder height with arm extended.
Pull handle toward upper face while driving elbow outward and back.
Squeeze rear delt at the end, then return slowly with control.

name: Plate Lateral Raise
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and grip two plates in each hand at your sides.
Keeping your arms straight, raise the plates out to your sides until they are in line with your shoulders.
Lower the plates back to your sides with control. Repeat for desired number of reps.

name: Plate Standing Twist
steps: Stand with a plate extended away from your body. Elbows mostly extended.
Rotate at the upper spine while keeping your lumbar spine in a neutral position.
Do not let the plate go behind your body.

name: Barbell High Pull
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width, and keep your back straight.
Drive through your legs, extending your hips, knees, and ankles explosively while pulling the barbell upward.
As the bar rises, pull it close to your body, leading with your elbows until it reaches chest level.

name: Machine Seated Hamstring Curl
steps: Adjust the back pad and ankle pad to suit your height.
Disengage the knee pad and lower it as far as you can.
Flex your knees against resistance, then extend until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.

name: Cable Row Bar Kneeling Crunch
steps: Use a double handle attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Walk a few steps forward then fall into a kneeling position.
Push your hips back and flex your abs, then push hips forward until in the starting position.

name: Cardio Long Jump Shuffle Back
steps: Stand feet shoulder-width, knees slightly bent, arms behind you, eyes forward.
Swing arms backward, squat deeply, loading legs for explosive power.
Swing arms, explode forward, extend legs mid-air, land softly on both feet.
Shuffle back to the starting position.

name: Cable Rope Single Arm Low Lateral Raise
steps: Use a rope attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
You should vertically abduct at the shoulder raising your arms straight out to the side.
Raise until your arms are parallel with the ground and then back to the starting position.

name: Machine Seated Shrug
steps: Have a seat on the machine, and grab each handle.
Pull your shoulder blades straight up toward the ceiling.

name: Cable Decline Bench Chest Fly
steps: Bring a bench over to the cables, set the cables above shoulder height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

name: Barbell Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Be careful getting the bar into place overhead. Push your elbows forward while keeping your elbows tucked in.
Look for what feels like a stretch in your triceps. Extend your elbows until your fists are pointed at the ceiling.

name: Bodyweight Heels Elevated Hip Thrust
steps: Put your shoulder blades on a bench. Both feet on a low box or a plate.
Start with your hips up.
Drop your hips and then push your hips up toward the ceiling.

name: Barbell Front Squat With Straps
steps: Measure your shoulders against the bar to make sure you're even. Wrap a pair of lifting straps around the bar. Hold the ends of the straps. Throw your shoulders under the bar. The bar should be digging into your neck slightly.
Make sure to push your elbows up to the ceiling for the entire rep. To make sure you don't get too pitched forward.
Use the squat stance you would use for a back or goblet squat. Push your hips back to initiate the squat. Break at the knees until you hit parallel depth.
Squat back up to a standing position.

name: Cable Bench Straight Leg Kickback
steps: Use an ankle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cable should be set to hip height.
Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

name: Back Rowing Preps Bicep Curls Seated
steps: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps at shoulder height.
Start with arms straight, palms facing up, shoulders relaxed.
Bend elbows, curling hands toward shoulders without moving torso.
Extend arms slowly, maintaining control and constant tension on straps.

name: TRX Y Raise
steps: Hold the TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point until the straps are taut.
Keep both elbows mostly extended and raise both arms out and upwards.
You should make a Y shape with your arms during the back portion of the exercise.

name: Kettlebell Drag Curl
steps: Grab two kettlebells with an underhand grip.
Pull your elbows straight back and let the kettlebells drag against your upper body (or very close to it).

name: Plate Forward Lunge
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the plate held in front of the torso.
Take a step forward with one foot, bending the front knee to lower the hips into a lunge.
Push through the front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side by stepping forward with the other foot.

name: Cable Kayak Row
steps: Use a bar attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward somewhat.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. Bring one arm to your side.
You can either alternate sides or do one side at a time.

name: Machine Horizontal Leg Press Calf Jump
steps: Start with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Shift your weight onto the balls of your feet and raise stay flat footed. Using your calf muscles, mimic a jumping motion but don't leave the platform.
Explode onto your toes and hold for a second.

name: Cable Seated Bayesian Hammer Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine and sit on the bench. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Use a neutral grip thumb facing up pinky-facing down). Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Chest Press
steps: Lie on bench holding one dumbbell above chest with arm extended.
Lower dumbbell toward chest while keeping torso stable and level.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting.

name: Reverse Crunch Kick Up
steps: Perform a reverse crunch and then kick your legs up toward the ceiling.
Flex at the hips and knees until your hips land back on the bench, then kick your legs back out to the starting position.

name: Bodyweight Single Leg Balance Stable
steps: Hold on to something stable and pull the leg on the opposing side straight up. Hold this position.

name: Ring Standing Pushup
steps: Start by setting up the rings to a secure anchor point and adjust the straps so that they hang about waist height when you stand under them.
Stand facing the rings grab the handles with both hands, and step forward so that your body is in a plank position with your hands directly beneath your shoulders.
Lower your body down by bending your elbows until your chest nearly touches the handles. Keep your core tight and your body in a straight line.
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms as you do so. Make sure to engage your chest, triceps, and core throughout the movement.

name: Seated Lateral Raise
steps: Sit upright on bench or box.
Hold dumbbells at sides
Lift arms to shoulder height.

name: Side Plank Up Down
steps: Start with your elbow and hip on the ground. Either neutral fist or flat hand on the ground.
Begin in a side plank position, and then drop your hips to the floor.
Pull your hips back to the ceiling to finish the rep.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Floor Press
steps: Start flat on your back with a kettlebell extended over you.
Bring your elbow to the floor, rest for a second to remove all the momentum from the rep, then press to a lockout.

name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Hammer Curl
steps: Hold dumbbell at side with palm facing inward, elbow tight to body.
Curl dumbbell upward while maintaining neutral grip throughout.
Lower under control, keeping tension on biceps and forearm.

name: Bosu Ball Split Squat
steps: Stand in front of Bosu, one foot on the center.
Lower into a lunge position, knee at
degrees.
Push off the front foot to return to starting position.

name: Kettlebell Glute Bridge
steps: Laying on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, rest the kettlebell on your pelvis.
Pushing through the legs and keeping the core muscles engaged, raise your pelvis off the floor until your stomach, pelvis and thighs make a straight line.
Slowly lower to the ground to the starting position and repeat.

name: Cable Calve Raise
steps: Use a straight bar or ez bar attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom.
Walk a few steps back.
Pull your heels straight up until you feel a contraction in your calves and then back to original position.

name: Band Pull Around
steps: Stand sideways to anchor and hold band with arm slightly extended.
Pull arm across your body in a smooth arc without rotating torso.
Squeeze chest at end range, then return slowly with control.

name: Bodyweight Reverse Step Up
steps: Start with a box or bench behind you and one of your feet on the box/bench.
The balls of your feet should be planted on the box/bench.
Drive through the ball of your foot extending your knees until you're upright and standing on the box.

name: Medicine Ball Lateral Lunge Slam
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball.
Step laterally, performing a lunge, then slam the ball.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.

name: Stability Ball Push Up
steps: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders. Place your feet on the stability ball.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Hammer Flat Curl
steps: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips pushed toward the ceiling.
Take a neutral grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Barbell Tap Pause Squat
steps: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a barbell across your upper back and shoulders, using an overhand grip.
Sit back and lower your body down until your glutes tap the top of the box, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Push through your heels to extend your hips and stand up, bringing your body back to the starting position.

name: Barbell Behind The Back Shrug
steps: Hold barbell behind your hips with overhand grip, arms straight.
Shrug shoulders straight up toward ears without bending elbows.
Lower slowly, maintaining tension in traps throughout the movement.

name: Bench Lift Off Static
steps: While seated on a bench, place your palms on the bench by your sides
Palm placement should allow room for the fingers to grip the edge of the bench
Try to lift your bodyweight off the bench by pushing the palms into the bench
Lockout your elbows and hold isometrically

name: Landmine Glute Kick Back
steps: Start on your hands and knees perpendicular to the barbell with the end of the barbell resting on the inside of your knee that is closer to the bar.
Keeping your core braced, your back flat, and your moving leg bent at a
degree angle, drive the heel of your working leg up the ceiling while squeezing your glute.
Follow the movement path as you bring your knee back down to the ground beneath your hip, keeping your knee bent to maintain control of the barbell.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

name: Landmine Alternating Single Arm Press
steps: Stand facing the landmine leaning forward slightly with the end of the barbell held in one hand at your shoulder with your elbow positioned beneath your wrist.

While keeping your elbow pointed forward, drive the bar directly overhead, switching hands at the top of the movement. Lower the bar back down to the other side of your body, mirroring the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps, switching hands at the top of each rep.

name: Cable Bar Calve Raise
steps: Use a straight bar or ez bar attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom.
Walk a few steps back.
Pull your heels straight up until you feel a contraction in your calves and then back to original position.

name: Landmine Half Kneeling Single Arm Overhead Press
steps: Start facing the landmine on one knee with your other foot in front of you while holding the barbell in one hand at your shoulder on the same side as the knee that is on the ground.
Drive the bar upwards while keeping your elbow pointed forward until your arm holding the bar is fully extending, then control the bar as your lower it back to the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps, then switch sides.

name: Landmine Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand in front of the landmine with your feet hip-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Grasp the landmine barbell with both hands, palms facing each other, and hold it in front of your thighs.

Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and push your hips back, allowing the landmine to travel down your thighs. Lower the landmine by bending forward at the hips while keeping your back flat, allowing the barbell to move closer to the floor. Continue the movement until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, keeping your legs relatively straight but with a slight bend in the knees.
Reverse the movement by pushing your hips forward and driving through your heels while keeping your back straight.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

name: Running Lying On The Back
steps: Lie supine with feet on bar, legs fully extended.
Alternate lowering one heel while the other stays lifted.
Switch rhythmically, maintaining stable pelvis and quiet upper body.
Continue alternating, emphasizing ankle mobility and control.

name: Kettlebell Long Lever Lateral Raise
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width apart holding a kettlebell with one hand at your side.
Keeping your arm straight, swing the kettlebell up and out, away from your body to around head height, holding on to the kettlebell firmly so it does not change position in your hand.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Barbell Incline Bench Press
steps: Position the bench between
and
degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Seated Overhead Press
steps: Sit on a bench with back support. Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height with your palms forward.
Raise the dumbbells upwards and pause at the contracted position.
Lower the weights back to starting position.

name: Triceps Stretch Variation Two
steps: Hold a band so it is in line with your spine. Hold the top with your right hand and the bottom with your left.
Keeping the top still, pull down on the band.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then repeat with the other arm.

name: Kettlebell Swing (Double)
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebells outside legs
Hinge at hips, swing kettlebells forward, then back.
Thrust hips to swing kettlebells upward, keeping arms straight.

name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Tense your glutes and raise your hips towards the ceiling.
Once you are at the highest point you can manage, hold the position for a few seconds, and then slowly return to the starting position.
Push your hips up, so that your butt is elevated and your back straight.
Lie down with one knee bent and and one with a slight bend.

name: Cable Low Bilateral Lateral Raise
steps: Use a handle attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
You should vertically abduct at the shoulder raising your arms straight out to the side.
Raise until your arms are parallel with the ground and then back to the starting position.

name: Bodyweight Standing Hamstring Curl Isometric
steps: Stand up straight using a balancing aid.
Shift your weight on one leg.
Bend the non-weight bearing leg and hold.
Knees should remain aligned.

name: Barbell Behind The Back 30 Degree Shrug
steps: Hold barbell behind you with arms at a
degree angle with your torso.
Shrug shoulders up and slightly back toward ears, keeping elbows locked.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower under control to full stretch.

name: Laying Leg Raises
steps: Lay on your back with your arms palms down on either side.
Keep your legs together and as straight as possible.
Slowly raise your legs to a 90° angle, pause at this position, or as high as you can reach your legs, and then slowly lower your legs back down.
Duration of these movements should be slow so that you do not utilize momentum, enabling you to get the most out of the exercise.

name: Pilates Scooter
steps: Stand beside reformer, one foot on carriage, one stable on floor.
Press carriage back by extending moving leg.

name: Cable Bar Romanian Deadlift
steps: Start with a straight bar or ez bar attachment set to the bottom of the machine. Squat the weight up into a standing position and walk a few steps back
Push your butt back to initiate the movement and then push your butt forward until you're back in a standing position.
To protect yourself from injury, always maintain a flat back on any exercise.

name: Lawnmower Row
steps: Stand with feet staggered and one hand on a bench/box. Hold a dumbbell in the opposing hand.
Hinge forward at the hips, keeping the back flat, and eyes facing forward. The weight should hang directly below the shoulders.
Start with an overhand grip, as you pull rotate the dumbbell. When your upper arm reaches your side your palm should be facing forward.

name: Ez Bar Drag Curl
steps: Grab an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Pull your elbows straight back and let the bar drag against your upper body (or very close to it).

name: Cable Pull In
steps: Use a handle attachment set all the way to the top of the cable crossover machine.
Walk a few steps away from the cable machine. Face your body sideways.
Face your palm up toward the ceiling. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage.

name: Smith Machine Seated Calf Raise
steps: Start by sitting on a bench or box with the bar resting on your knees. Your feet should be flat on the ground, about hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the barbell for support, and lift your heels off the ground.
Hold this position for a moment, then slowly lower your heels back to the ground.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Preacher Curl
steps: Start with a with a dumbbell in one hand and your elbow resting on the bench.
From this starting position, curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary on the bench.

name: Extended side Angle Pose With Block
steps: Begin in a lunge position with your right foot forward and your left foot back.
Place a block on the outside of your right foot and place your right hand on top of it.
Look down towards your right foot as you reach your left arm towards the front of the room, feeling a stretch in your side body. Hold for a few breaths and then switch sides.

name: Landmine Sit Up
steps: Lay flat on the ground and hold the end of the bar with your arms extended.
Raise your back off the ground until you are sitting at a
degree angle.
Then lower slowly back to the floor.

name: Bodyweight Donkey Calf Raise
steps: Hold on to something for balance.
Hinge forward and maintain that position. Calf raise until you feel a contraction in your calfs.

name: Dumbbell Bent Arm Lateral Raise
steps: Stand tall with a 90 degree bend at your elbows.
Lateral raise your arms straight out to the side until your arms are about parallel with the ground.

name: Dumbbell Weighted Pull Ups
steps: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back to starting position.

name: Lats Stretch Variation Three
steps: Find a wall to lean against, lay your tricep against the wall with your hand behind your back.
Slowly lean into the wall.
Return to starting position, then switch sides.

name: Medicine Ball Slam
steps: Lift medicine ball overhead.
Slam ball down to ground with force.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Reverse Flat Curl
steps: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips pushed toward the ceiling.
Use an overhand grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Dumbbell Silverback Shrug
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding dumbbells with both hands in front just past shoulder width.
Bend forward at the hips with a slight bend in your knees, keeping your back straight.
Engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Pullover
steps: Lie on bench holding one kettlebell above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower kettlebell in an arc behind head until you feel a deep stretch.
Pull kettlebell back over chest using lats and triceps, keeping control.

name: Smith Machine Inverted Row
steps: Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.

name: TRX Skullcrusher
steps: Hold the two TRX straps and lean forward. The straps should be over each shoulder.
Keep your elbows tucked in and then flex and extend at the elbows.

name: TRX Hand Plank
steps: Start by facing away from the TRX straps and placing your feet in the TRX handles with your palms on the ground.
Lift your knees off the ground to begin the set.
Engage your core and maintain this position for the desired amount of time, holding a steady plank.

name: Barbell Step Up Balance
steps: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a barbell across your upper back and shoulders, using an overhand grip.
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box, keeping your left foot off the ground.
Step back down with your right foot, lowering your left foot to the ground.

name: Kettlebell Kneel To Stand Shoulder Flexion Bent Elbow Hold
steps: Stand up straight with the working arm in front of you and bent at the elbow (90°).
Hold an inverted kettlebell in that arm.
Try to kneel and then stand up without allowing the kettlebell to fall over.

name: Side Twist Kneeling
steps: Kneel tall sideways, hands holding straps, arms extended forward.
Engage core, rotate torso away from anchor.
Keep hips square and shoulders stacked.

name: Cable Side Bend
steps: Set the cable at the bottom of the stack. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, grab the handle, lean away from the cable.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

name: Landmine Stationary Twist
steps: Hold the end of the bar. Start with a shoulder width stance.
Bring both arms to one side and keep your elbows mostly extended.
Rotate back and forth and try to resist twisting too much.

name: Mini Band Bent Over Rear Delt Row
steps: Stand on band, hinge forward with neutral spine.
Row elbows out wide, squeezing shoulder blades back.
Lower slowly, maintaining bent-over position.

name: Kettlebell Box Squat
steps: Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart with a kettlebell in a goblet position.
Lower your body into a squat position, sitting back onto the box and pausing for a moment before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.

name: Kettlebell Front Rack Reverse Lunge (Double)
steps: Start with kettlebell in front rack.
Step back into lunge.
Return to start position.

name: Eversions
steps: Sit on a step or low box, preferably with a back support. Extend both legs and wrap the band around the balls of the working foot
Pass the band around the other foot as shown in the video. Hold the end of the band with the opposite arm of the working foot
The ankle should be at 90° and turned inwards (inversion) before you start the movement. Turn the ankle out, without moving the rest of the leg.

name: Dumbbell Rolling Tricep Extension
steps: Lay flat on a bench with two dumbbells pointed toward the ceiling.
Break at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps, then flex at the shoulder joint bringing your upper arms to the sides of your head.
Bring your elbows back up until they are pointed at the ceiling, then extend your elbows.

name: Plate Staggered Deadlift
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a weight plate.
Place one foot slightly behind the other, with the heel of your back foot elevated.
From this starting position, bend at the hips and knees to lower the plate towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Once the plate is below your knees, drive through your heels to stand back up to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Curtsy Deficit Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, dumbbells in both hands, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

name: Abdominals Stretch Variation Two
steps: Stand upright.
Reach with both hands upwards until you can interlock your fingers.
With your hands above your head, lean back until a stretch is felt in the abdominals.

name: Medicine Ball Self Toss
steps: Toss medicine ball up, catch with both hands.
Repeat toss and catch for desired reps.

name: Medicine Ball Wood Chopper Toss
steps: Stand sideways next to a wall.
Swing medicine ball across your body and toss off the wall.
Catch and repeat toss on the other side.

name: Cable Standing Alternating Chest Fly
steps: Stand between cables, hold cable handles above chest, palms facing inward.
Lower one arm outward with slight elbow bend, keeping opposite arm extended.
Bring arm back to center, alternate sides while maintaining controlled movement.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Rear Delt Row
steps: Hinge at hips with back flat, holding kettlebell under shoulder.
Pull elbow out and back at a wide angle, targeting rear delt.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to full stretch.

name: Hanging L Sit
steps: Hang from a bar with arms fully extended.
Lift legs to form an "L" shape.
Hold for allotted amount of time keeping your abs flexed.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Floor Fly
steps: Lie on your back holding one dumbbell above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower arm out wide until elbow lightly touches the floor.
Bring dumbbell back over chest, squeezing pec at the top.

name: Cable Single Arm Rolling Pushdown
steps: Stand facing cable holding handle with palm down, elbow bent, and shoulder flexed.
First extend your shoulder (like performing a pullover), then extend the elbow.

name: Stability Ball Wall Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, placing a stability ball between your lower back and wall.
Slowly squat down by bending knees to
degrees, keeping back straight and core engaged.
Press through heels, straighten legs, and return to standing while maintaining balance and control.

name: Kettlebell Lateral Lunge
steps: Hold kettlebells in front of you.
Step sideways, lunge down and let the kettlebells land between your legs.
Push off, return to start. Repeat.

name: Barbell Laying Triceps Extensions
steps: Lay on a flat bench while holding a barbell with a shoulder-width grip.
Fully extend your elbows until the barbell is directly over your chest.
Begin to flex your elbows and allow the barbell to nearly touch your forehead.
Extend your elbows back to the starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Hang Clean And Press
steps: Hold dumbbell in one hand at thigh level with slight knee bend.
Pull dumbbell upward explosively to shoulder, catching it smoothly.
Press overhead, fully extending arm, then return to start position.

name: Plate Glute Bridge to Pullover
steps: Lay flat on the ground with a plate on your chest.
Push your hips up toward the ceiling and maintain that extended position.
Extend your elbows mostly, break at the shoulder joint while maintaining hip extension and the slight bend in your elbows.
Let the plate tap the floor (or get close) and then pull the plate back into the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Reverse Curl
steps: Lay on an incline bench.
Grab a dumbbell with a pronated (overhand) grip. You can do this exercise thumbless if it's more comfortable on your wrists.
Flex at the elbows until your bicep touches your forearm. Try not to let your elbow flair outward.

name: Cardio Seal Jacks
steps: Stand with feet together, arms in front at chest level, palms touching.
Spread legs wide, simultaneously swing arms out to sides, palms facing forward.
Jump back to starting position, bringing arms together again quickly. Repeat rhythmically.

name: Cable Seated Bilateral High Curl
steps: Sit between high cables with arms extended outward and palms facing upward.
Curl both handles toward your head while keeping your upper arms stationary.
Squeeze your biceps, then slowly straighten your elbows.

name: Medicine Ball Kneeling Wood Chopper
steps: Kneel, holding a medicine ball.
Rotate torso and slam the ball diagonally down and across.
Repeat the movement on the other side.

name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Find a box or bench that is roughly knee height or a few inches lower. (The lower the box is the lower the mobility requirement).
You can either place your toes or the top of your foot on the box. Point your front foot forward or slightly turned outwards and break at the knees and hips simultaneously.
Aim to get your front leg to hit parallel depth (hamstring parallel with the ground) or lower.
The further forward your front foot is, the longer the Range of Motion is at your hips. The further back your front foot is, the longer the ROM at your knees.

name: Cable Reverse Bayesian Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards. Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Larsen Press
steps: Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding one kettlebell above chest.
Lower kettlebell toward chest while keeping core tight and legs raised.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting torso.

name: Dumbbell High Incline Bench Press
steps: Position the bench between 45 and 60 degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the dumbbells (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

name: Kettlebell Shrug (Single)
steps: Standing up straight with feet shoulder width apart.
Holding the kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis, engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together.
Release the shrug and repeat

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Pullover
steps: Lie on bench holding one dumbbell above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower dumbbell in an arc behind head until you feel a deep stretch.
Pull dumbbell back over chest using lats and triceps, keeping movement controlled.

name: Cardio Knee Taps
steps: Stand straight, feet hip-width apart, engage core.
Lift knees alternately, tap with same side hand.
Continue rhythmically, maintain posture, increase speed as able.

name: Dumbbell Russian Twist
steps: Sit on the floor and flex your knees and hips to a 90 degree angle.
Your feet should be hovering off the ground. (If that's too hard start with heels on the floor)
Rotate your upper spine to engage your obliques.

name: Dumbbell Tricep Guillotine Press
steps: Lay flat on a bench.
Push your elbows forward until your biceps touch your forearms. Then extend your elbows until back at the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Guillotine Incline Bench Press
steps: Lie on the incline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out. As you lower the dumbbells, exhale deeply.
Once your elbows reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position

name: Barbell Thruster
steps: Hold the bar in a front rack position.
Push your hips back and sink into a squat.
Push through your heels and squat back up. Use the momentum you generate at the legs to push the bar over head.
Let the bar return to the front rack position before starting the next rep.

name: Dumbbell Row Unilateral
steps: Brace your off arm against something stable (bench, box). Stagger your stance so your leg on the side of your working arm is back.
Try to get your torso to parallel with the ground. That will extend your range of motion.
Let your arm hang freely and then pull your elbow back. Imagine you've got a tennis ball in your armpit and squeeze it each rep.

name: Plate Single Leg Deadlift
steps: Engage your core and straighten your legs to lift the plate off the ground.
Stand on one leg, keeping the other leg off the ground, while holding the plate in front of your body.
Keep your back straight and maintain a neutral head position while looking straight ahead.
Lower the plate back down to the ground while keeping your balance on one leg.

name: Kettlebell Single Leg Hip Thrust
steps: Sitting on the floor with one knee bent with the foot firmly on the floor and one leg extended, lean your back against the bench.
Resting the kettlebell on your pelvis, raise your pelvis until your stomach, pelvis and thighs are in line.
Slowly lower until you are in the starting position and repeat.

name: Gastrocnemius Stretch Bilateral On Box
steps: Stand on the edge of a box, knees extended.
Let your weight push your heels towards the ground.
You should feel your calves being stretched.

name: Bosu Ball Offset Pushup
steps: Place one hand on Bosu, other on the floor.
Lower chest to the ground, keeping the body straight.
Push back up to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Weighted Chin Ups
steps: Grab the bar shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you). Use a dip belt and the let the weight hang between your legs.
With your body hanging and arms fully extended, pull yourself up until your chin is past the bar.
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.

name: Cardio Row Erg Rower Legs Only
steps: Strap your feet in tightly.
Keep your arms extended while flexing and extending at the hips and knees.

name: Pushup Position Shoulder Clock
steps: Wrap a loop band around your wrists and get yourself in a pushup position.
Support your body on one arm, while the other moves out taping the hour positions of the clock.
If you're moving your right arm it should be taping 12, 1, ..., 6.
If you're moving your left arm it should be taping 12, 11, ..., 6.

name: Machine Leg Press
steps: Place your legs on the platform with your feet at shoulder width.
Release the weight and extend your legs fully, without locking your knees.
Lower the weight until your legs are at a 90° angle (but DO NOT allow your butt and lower back to rise off of the pad. This will put your lower back in a rounded position, which is very dangerous.)
Raise the weight back to starting position.

name: Trap Bar Deficit Deadlift
steps: Stand on elevated surface inside trap bar, feet hip-width.
Grip handles, brace core, maintain neutral spine.
Drive through feet, extend hips and knees to stand.
Lower under control, maintaining balance on platform.

name: Barbell Curtsy Deficit Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, barbell on your back, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

name: Barbell Front Raise
steps: Stand tall with an overhand grip on the barbell. Raise your arms until your fists are around eye level.
Return to the start under control. This exercise is prone to using momentum when you begin to fatigue.

name: Cable Seated Rope Face Pull
steps: Sit facing cable and hold rope with palms facing each other, arms extended.
Pull rope toward upper face while flaring elbows outward.
Squeeze rear delts and mid-traps, then slowly return to start.

name: Plate Hip Abduction
steps: Stand tall holding plate against outer thigh or anchored between legs.
Lift leg outward to the side while keeping torso still and toes forward.
Lower slowly under control, maintaining tension on outer hip.

name: Kettlebell Pullover
steps: Rest your upper back on the bench and place soles of your feet firmly on the floor keeping torso and thighs suspended and parallel to the floor.
Hold the kettlebell with both hands above your chest, keeping your arms straight.
Keeping your arms straight, move the kettlebell in the direction of your head until your arms are parallel to the floor.
Return to starting to position and repeat.

name: Cable Standing Bilateral Straight Arm Pull In
steps: Stand between high cables with both arms extended outward.
Pull the handles downward and inward while keeping your elbows nearly straight.
Squeeze your lats, then slowly return to the starting position.

name: Elbow Side Plank
steps: Press your elbow into the floor.
Pick your hips up off the ground and maintain this position for the allotted amount of time.
Make sure you don't let your chest fall forward or backward.

name: Barbell Landmine Row
steps: Position a barbell in a landmine or corner of a room and stand facing it with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the end of the barbell with a neutral grip, keeping your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower your torso until it is almost parallel to the ground.
Pull the barbell towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together as you row the weight up.

name: Smith Machine Upright Row
steps: Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the bar to chin level or slightly higher.
lower the bar and repeat.

name: Plate Pinch Grip Farmer's Carry
steps: Stand tall holding two plates in each hand with a pinch grip.
Walk for the desired distance or time.

name: Ring Chin Up
steps: Grab the rings shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you)
With your body hanging and arms fully extended, pull yourself up until your chin is past the rings.
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.

name: Reclining Pigeon Pose
steps: Lie down on your back with your knees bent and your feet on the ground.
Cross your right ankle over your left knee, creating a figure four shape.
Use your hands to gently pull your left knee towards your chest, feeling a stretch in your right hip.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, then switch sides and repeat.

name: Machine Bent Arm Pec Fly
steps: Adjust seat height so handles align with chest. Put your elbows on the pads.
Slowly bring pads together in front, keeping tension. Focus on squeezing chest muscles.
Return pads to starting position with controlled motion. Keep chest up throughout. Repeat for reps.

name: Dumbbell Pendlay Row
steps: The dumbbells should be placed on the floor.
Hinge forward with a flat back and grab the dumbbells.
Pull both dumbbells back and your elbows toward the ceiling.
Return the dumbbells back to the floor softly on each rep.

name: Cable Standing Alternating Chest Press
steps: Stand facing away from the cables with handles beside your chest.
Press one handle forward until your arm is fully extended.
Return under control, then press with the opposite arm.

name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie down with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Push your hips up so that your butt is elevated and your back straight.
Tense your glutes and raise your hips towards the ceiling.
Once you are at the highest point you can manage, hold the position for a few seconds, and then slowly return to the starting position

name: Dumbbell Seated Hammer Curl
steps: Sit tall holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing inward.
Curl dumbbells toward shoulders while maintaining neutral grip throughout.
Squeeze biceps, then lower slowly to starting position.

name: Medicine Ball Clean And Press Slam
steps: Hold the medicine ball with an overhand grip.
Lift the ball explosively, clean it to shoulder height.
Press the ball overhead, then slam it to the ground.

name: Machine Reverse Hyperextension
steps: Lay on the pad and grab the handles.
Slip your legs into the belt loop.
Push your legs back until they are horizontal with the ground.
Lower back to the starting position.

name: Traps mid back Stretch Variation One
steps: Stand up with your feet shoulder width apart. Place one arm across the front of your chest at shoulder height, press the forearm of your other arm above the elbow, hooking the stretching arm with your hand.
Press the arm until it is straight and rotate your upper torso to engage the stretch even deeper.
Repeat with your other arm.

name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Incline Curl
steps: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor.
Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Twisting Curl
steps: Hold dumbbell with palm facing inward and arm extended fully.
Curl upward while rotating palm to face shoulder at the top.
Squeeze bicep, then lower dumbbell, rotating back to start.

name: Bodyweight Superman Pull
steps: Lie face down with arms extended straight in front of you.
Lift arms, chest, and legs off floor while squeezing glutes.
Pull elbows toward ribs, squeeze lats, then extend arms again.

name: Stability Ball Side Crunch
steps: Lie sideways on a stability ball, feet anchored, hands behind head, core engaged.
Crunch sideways by contracting obliques, bringing your upper body toward your hip.

name: Footwork Lower And Lift
steps: Lie supine, balls of feet on bar, heels lifted.
Press bar away, fully extending legs with control.
Lower heels under bar, then lift heels as high as possible.
Bend knees to return, maintaining steady tension and ankle control.

name: Kettlebell Deadlift (Single)
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Return to standing position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Press
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder, with your palm facing forward and your elbow bent.
From this starting position, extend your arm upwards so that the dumbbell is overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Landmine Single Arm Push Press
steps: Stand in front of the landmine with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Grasp the landmine barbell with one hand, palm facing in, and bring it to shoulder height with your elbow tucked beneath your hand.

Dip your body slightly then drive up through the ground to generate momentum as your extend your arm fully upwards. Pause briefly at the top of the rep, then lower the weight back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps on one side before switching sides.

name: Cable Rope Mid Lateral Raise
steps: Place the cable at the same height as your fist when your arms are at your side and stand with the cable crossing your body.
While keeping your elbow mostly extended, lift your arm until it's parallel with the floor.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Grip Bench Press
steps: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar with a reverse grip.
Lower the dumbbells to your lower chest.
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

name: Landmine Russian Twist
steps: Start sitting on the ground facing the landmine attachment, holding the end of the bar in both hands slightly in front of and above your chest while holding your feet off the ground and knees bent.

Bending your elbows as little as possible and keeping your core tight and feet elevated, lower the end of the bar with control to the ground on one side of your body, then contract your obliques to return the bar to the center. Repeat on the other side.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

name: Slider Hamstring Curl Single Leg
steps: Lie on your back keeping both knees bent.
Have a slider under the heel of the working leg.
Extend and bend the working lag applying gentle downwards pressure.

name: Footwork High Half Toe
steps: Lie supine, balls of feet on bar, heels lifted high.
Press bar away, extending legs while maintaining lifted heels.
Keep pelvis neutral, ribs down, and core engaged.
Bend knees to return smoothly, maintaining ankle stability and control.

name: Kettlebell Kneeling Bottoms Up Overhead Press
steps: Start by taking a kneeling position and holding a kettlebell in each hand with the bottom of the kettlebell facing up.
Bring the kettlebells to your shoulders, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, extend your arms upwards so that the kettlebells are overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Dumbbell Kneeling Single Arm Row
steps: Place one hand and one knee on a bench. Make sure you keep a flat back.
Pull the dumbbell toward the ceiling.
Make sure to avoid any jerking or rotating.

name: TRX Pec Fly
steps: Start by adjusting the TRX straps to chest height. Stand facing the TRX with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the TRX handles with both hands, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
Lean forward, keeping your arms extended and your core engaged. Your body should form a slight diagonal line from your ankles to your head.
Slowly bring your arms towards each other, in front of your chest, while keeping your core engaged and your body in a stable position.

name: Kettlebell Upright Row
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

name: Kettlebell Seated Overhead Press
steps: There should be a straight line from your elbow to fist (vertical forearms).
Sit tall and try not to arch your spine as you're pressing.
Press until your elbows are extended and push your head forward slightly.

name: Cable Rope Skullcrusher
steps: Use a rope attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Face away from the machine with your elbows up and the attachment just behind your head.
Extend at the elbows until you feel a contraction in your triceps and then flex at the elbow back to the starting position.

name: Control Front Plank Position
steps: Place hands on the shoulder rests on feet on the footbar.
Engage core, glutes tight, body forming a straight line.
Press arms forward, protract shoulders slightly, keep neck neutral.
Hold position with steady breathing and full-body tension.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive
steps: Hold kettlebell in front rack position and place opposite foot on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up while keeping chest tall and stable.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

name: Kettlebell Front Rack Step Up
steps: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold kettlebells at your shoulders.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.

name: Machine Seated Cable Row
steps: Sit with your back straight on the machine and grip the handles.
Pull the handles back using your arms. Your legs and torso should be at a 90° angle. Push out your chest.
Pull the handles towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Curtsy Lunge
steps: Hold kettlebell in one hand.
Step back, left leg behind right.
Return to start position. Repeat.

name: Mini Band Mountain Climber
steps: Loop band around feet, start in high plank.
Drive one knee toward chest against resistance.
Alternate legs quickly while keeping hips stable.

name: Machine Pulldown
steps: Grip the bar with the palms facing forward, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance wider than shoulder width.
As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar, bring your torso back around
degrees while sticking your chest out.
Pull the bar down to about chin level or a little lower in a smooth movement whilst squeezing the shoulder blades together.
After a second of squeezing, slowly raise the bar back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended.

name: Bodyweight Thoracic Spine Rotation
steps: Start on all fours then bring your chest to the ground. Place one hand on the ground in front of you. The other hand behind your head/ear.
On the side of the hand that is behind your head, rotate until your elbow is pointed at the ceiling and then hold this position.

name: Machine Back Extension
steps: Sit on the machine and place your upper back on the rolling pad.
Extend your hips and lower back. Make sure not to hyperextend your spine.

name: Plate Curl To Overhead Press
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the torso, palms facing forward.
Curl the plate up to the front of the shoulder while keeping the elbows close to the body.
Rotate the palms to face forward and press the plate overhead, locking out the arms.
Lower the plate back to the starting position, keeping control of it, and repeat for desired reps.

name: Kettlebell Single Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, lifting one foot off the floor behind you. Hold the kettlebell in the same arm as the lifted leg.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you extend your lifted leg behind you, keeping your back straight - holding out your arm to the side for balance.
Return to the upright position and repeat.

name: Cardio Forward Scissor
steps: Do a light hop and split your stance.
Land lightly on your toes, and then bring the opposing leg forward.

name: Barbell Reverse Grip Bench Press
steps: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar with a reverse grip.
Lower the bar to your lower chest
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

name: Cardio Step Out Jacks
steps: Stand tall, feet together, arms by sides, ready to move.
Step right foot out, simultaneously raise arms above head.
Step right foot in, lower arms, repeat left, maintain rhythm.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Seal Row
steps: Lay on the chest after adjusting the height off the bar holding hooks to match your arm length.
Remove the bar from the hooks, then initiate the set.
Pull the bar straight back, then lower to the start position. Fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep.

name: Decline Push Up
steps: Use a bench to elevate your feet.
Put your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Slowly lower your body until your chest almost touches the ground
Raise your body until you almost lock your elbows.

name: Alphabet
steps: Sit on a box or bench
Keep one foot off the ground by pulling onto your knee, or by crossing one leg over the opposite knee.
Try to form the letters of the Alphabet with your foot.

name: Forearms Stretch Variation Four
steps: Raise your arm to shoulder height at
degrees to your body.
Press lightly on your hand and push towards you.
Rotate the arm across your body.
Switch sides and repeat.

name: Trap Bar Pause Deadlift
steps: Set up inside trap bar with strong brace and neutral spine.
Lift bar slightly, pause just below knees.
Hold tension, then continue to full lockout.
Lower bar slowly back to floor.

name: Kickbacks
steps: Get down on all fours and position your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Kick back with one leg and squeeze your glutes.
Slowly return to starting position by bending your knee and lowering your leg.
Switch Legs. Repeat.

name: Cable Hammer Bayesian Curl
steps: Stand facing away from the cables and grab two handle attachments.
Take a neutral grip, flex your elbows, and extend.

name: Abdominals Stretch Variation Three
steps: Stand upright.
After completing the desired amount of reps with the left arm, switch to the right arm and lean to the left.
Reach up with your left arm and then lean slowly to the right. Lean until a stretch is felt in the obliques.

name: Kettlebell Single Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Laying on the floor with one knee bent with the foot firmly on the floor and one leg extended, rest the kettlebell on your pelvis.
Pushing through the bent leg and keeping the core muscles engaged, raise your pelvis and the extended leg off the floor until your stomach, pelvis and thighs make a straight line.
Slowly lower to the ground to the starting position and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
steps: Hold the weight tucked into your upper chest area, keeping your elbows in. Your feet should be slightly wider than your shoulders.
Sink down into the squat, keeping your elbows inside the track of your knees.
Push through your heels while keeping your chest up and return to the starting position.

name: Shoulder Girdle Stability Circles
steps: Stand facing a wall. Pin a gym ball between your palm and the wall (elbow straight).
Push your arm into the ball without leaning into it.
While applying pressure, form the sign of the cross (up/down/left/right) and circles.

name: Sideways Scissor Kick
steps: Lift both legs off the ground.
Bring both legs outward, then cross both legs over one another.
Alternating which leg goes on top.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Extension
steps: Grab two dumbbells with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across your knees.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.

name: Dumbbell Seated Reverse Curl
steps: Sit tall holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing downward.
Curl dumbbells toward your shoulders, keeping wrists stable and elbows tucked.
Lower slowly to full extension, maintaining control throughout.

name: Medicine Ball Pushup
steps: Place hands on medicine ball, in push-up position.
Perform push-up, maintaining proper form.

name: Dumbbell Hand Side Plank
steps: Start by lying on your side with your feet stacked on top of each other and a dumbbell on your hip.
Place your bottom hand on the ground beneath your shoulder and engage your core to raise your hips off the ground.
From this starting position, hold the side plank position for the desired amount of time, making sure to keep your body straight and your hips level.

name: Band Seated Inversions
steps: Sit on a step or low box, preferably with a back support. Extend both legs and cross the working leg over the non working leg.
Wrap the band around the balls of the working foot. Pass the band around the other foot as shown in the video.
Hold the end of the band with the same arm as the working foot. The ankle should be at 90° and turned outwards (eversion) before you start the movement
Turn the ankle in, without moving the rest of the leg.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Side Step Up
steps: Begin by standing beside a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a dumbbell with a goblet grip.
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box.
Step back down with your right foot.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Flat Curl
steps: Lay off the side of a bench with the back of your working arm pressed into the side of the bench. Keep your hips all the way up.
Fully extend your elbow and feel a stretch through your bicep, then curl.
Stop before the dumbbell is pointed at the ceiling to keep tension on your biceps.

name: Cable Kneeling Low To High Wood Chopper
steps: Kneel sideways to cable and grasp handle near hip level with both hands.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally upward across body toward opposite shoulder.
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.

name: Bodyweight Butterfly Stretch
steps: Sit on your butt with your knees bent and feet touching each other.
Grab your feet and lean forward until you feel a stretch in your groin.

name: TRX Pike
steps: Place your feet in the stirrups and get in to a plank position.
Pull your hips straight up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips until you're back in a plank position.

name: Cable Single Arm Neutral Grip Row
steps: Place the cable at shoulder height. Use a handle attachment. Face your palm toward the midline of your body.
Pull the handle back using your arms. Push out your chest.
Pull the handle towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.

name: Wall Sit
steps: Press your back against a wall, feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat position, thighs parallel to the floor, knees above ankles.
Hold the position, maintaining tension in your core and legs.

name: Cable Standing Incline Chest Press
steps: Stand facing away from low cables with handles beside your chest.
Press both handles forward and upward until your arms are extended.
Squeeze your chest, then return the handles under control.

name: Standing Doming
steps: From the standing position press the big toe into the ground till you feel the inside part of your foot raise off the ground
The arch of your foot should now look more pronounced.
Do not roll your foot out to lift the inside part of your foot.

name: Cable Alternating Bench Press
steps: Lie on bench, hold handles beside chest, elbows bent.
Press one handle upward until arm extends, opposite arm remains stationary.
Lower slowly, alternate arms while keeping shoulders stable.

name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Rear Delt Fly
steps: Sit with hinged over position, dumbbells in hands, arms slightly bent, internally rotate shoulders.
Raise dumbbells out to sides, squeeze rear delts.
Lower weights, repeat for reps.

name: Dumbbell Decline Squeeze Press
steps: Lay flat on a decline bench with two dumbbells pressed to one another.
Break at the elbows and keep your elbows tucked as you bring the dumbbells to your chest.
Continue to press the dumbbells into one another throughout the rep.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, press back toward the ceiling.

name: Barbell Heels Up Front Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and feet on a plate. Place the bar in a front rack position.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position, keeping your heels raised off the ground.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position.

name: Seated Shoulder Abduction
steps: Stand or sit with your arm by your side, palm facing forward.
Reach your hand out to the side and over your head without bending the elbow
The thumb leads the movement.

name: Hamstrings Stretch Variation Two
steps: Stand with one foot in front of the other.
Bend your rear leg as much as you can, keeping the front leg straight.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then return to starting position.

name: Good Mornings
steps: Stand with your feet a little past shoulder width apart with a slight bend at your knee. Place your hands behind the back of your head.
Keeping your back straight, rotate your hips to bring your shoulders down towards the floor. Stop when your chest is parallel with the floor.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
steps: With dumbbells in either hand, bend your knees with your feet slightly bowed out. Arch your back above your knees, and start with the weights touching in front of your chest.
With bent elbows, raise your arms up to shoulder level, pausing at the at the end of the motion.
Slowly lower your arms back to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand with a shoulder width stance. Push your butt back while leaving your knees MOSTLY extended.
You should feel a stretch in your hamstrings. When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward to complete the rep.
Do not push your hips all the way forward. This will hyperextend your spine. Just go to a normal standing position.

name: Bodyweight Hanging L Sit
steps: Grip bar, hang with arms extended, body straight.
Engage core, lift knees towards chest.
Hold that position for the specified amount of time.

name: Cable Seated Bayesian Reverse Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine and sit on the bench. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards. Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Reverse Incline Curl
steps: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor.
Take an overhand grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Bosu Ball Pike Shrug
steps: Place toes on Bosu, hands on the floor.
Pike hips up, shrug shoulders, engage core.

name: Dumbbell Six Way Lateral Raise
steps: Perform a front raise, then bring dumbbells out to your side, then raise the dumbbells over head.

name: Machine Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Adjust the pad to suit your height.
Grab the v bar (or other attachment) and extend your elbows until they are almost fully extended.
Flex your elbows and look to feel a stretch at the bottom of each rep.

name: Ez Bar Upright Row
steps: Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the bar to chin level or slightly higher.

name: Toe Tap
steps: Stand in front of a low box.
Bring one foot to the edge of the box and alternate as quickly as possible.
Only lightly tap your feet to the box.

name: Arms Pulling Straps Airplane Prone On The Box
steps: Lie prone on the box, chest just off edge, arms holding straps.
Start with arms down, palms facing in, shoulders set away from ears.
Lift arms out to a T, squeezing shoulder blades, keeping neck long.
Lower with control, maintain neutral spine, repeat for smooth controlled reps.

name: Cable Pull Through
steps: This exercise works best with a rope attachment but can be done with anything. The attachment should be set to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine, straddle the cable itself, and grab the attachment. Walk a few steps away.
Break at the hips while maintaining a flat back and mostly extended knees.
Push hips forward until you are back in a standing position.

name: Lower back Stretch Variation Four
steps: Lay flat against the ground with your knees at an angle and your feet flat against the floor.
Grab your legs just below the knees, and pull your legs towards your chest.
Pause at the apex of the stretch, then return to the starting position.

name: Plate Rear Delt Fly
steps: Keep your back straight and bend forward slightly at the waist.
With arms extended, raise the weights out to your sides until they are in line with your shoulders.
Pause briefly and then lower the weights back to the starting position.

name: Bodyweight Reverse Lunge
steps: Take a big step backwards with your left leg, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground and your right knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push through your right heel to return to standing, bringing your left leg back to starting position.
Repeat the movement on the other side, stepping backwards with your right leg and lowering your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground and your left knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.

name: Mini Band Walking Side To Side
steps: Loop band above knees, slight squat stance.
Step laterally, keeping constant outward knee pressure.
Continue walking side to side under control.

name: Cable Decline Alternating Bench Press
steps: Lie on bench, with cables above shoulder height, hold handles beside chest, elbows bent.
Press one handle downward until arm extends, opposite arm remains stationary.
Lower slowly, alternate arms while keeping shoulders stable.

name: Plate Reverse Lunge Twist
steps: Step back with your right foot into a lunge position, both knees bent at
degrees.
Twist your torso to the right, keeping the plate close to your chest.
Push through your front foot to return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.

name: Medicine Ball Chest Press Slam
steps: Hold medicine ball at chest, feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend arms forward, slamming ball to the ground.
Catch the ball on the rebound and repeat for reps.

name: Seated Median Nerve Tensioner
steps: Abduct your arm at 90°, elbow straight and palm facing up.
Extend your wrist (point the fingers downwards).
Tilt the head to the opposite side making sure you do not bend the elbow.
Find the position of maximum tension (without pain) and hold.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Incline Curl
steps: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor.
Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Smith Machine Sumo Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stance width can vary with a sumo DL. Some prefer toes near the plates. Others prefer a more narrow stance to get more drive off the floor.
Make sure your arms are inside your legs. The bar should be just over your mid-foot. Flatten your back and unrack the bar
Leave your knees mostly extended and flex and extend your hips.

name: Band Goblet Squat
steps: Stand with a shoulder width grip. Both feet should be on the band with the band looped over both hands.
Push your butt back and also break at the knees.
Try to hit parallel depth (bottom of your leg should be parallel with the ground). If you can't tell your squat depth, then try squatting in front of a mirror and watch your form.

name: Dumbbell Head On Bench Rear Delt Fly
steps: With dumbbells in either hand, bend your knees with your feet slightly bowed out. Arch your back above your knees, place your head on the top of an incline bench, and start with the weights touching in front of your chest.
With bent elbows, raise your arms up to shoulder level, pausing at the at the end of the motion.
Slowly lower your arms back to starting position.

name: Smith Machine Close Grip Bench Press
steps: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With a narrow grip on the bar, straighten your arms
Lower the bar to your lower-mid chest
Slowly raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

name: Midback Series 3
steps: Novice
Sit or lie supported, spine long, arms positioned in a v-pose.
Initiate movement by drawing shoulder blades together and down.
Move arms down to your sides, keeping neck relaxed and ribs down.
Maintain control throughout, emphasizing mid-back engagement over arm dominance.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Row
steps: Sit on the machine, feet flat, and grab the handles.
Pull handles towards your lower abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep elbows close to your body.
Slowly return to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking elbows. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Reverse Curl
steps: Sit tall holding one dumbbell at your side with palm facing downward.
Curl dumbbell toward shoulder, keeping wrist stable and elbow tucked.
Lower slowly to full extension while maintaining control.

name: Feet Pulling Straps Hamstring Curls Prone On The Long Box
steps: Lie prone on long box, hips supported, straps around feet.
Start with legs extended, core engaged, pelvis neutral.
Bend knees, curling heels toward glutes using hamstrings.
Extend legs slowly, maintaining control and constant strap tension.

name: Pilates Single Arm Back Rowing Seated Row
steps: Sit tall, hold one strap, arm extended forward.
Pull handle toward torso, squeezing shoulder blade.
Keep torso stable without rotation.
Extend arm forward under control.

name: Bosu Ball Single Leg Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on Bosu, lean back, one foot on the floor.
Drive hips upward, squeezing glutes, one leg extended.
Lower hips back down and switch legs.

name: Depth Jump
steps: Stand on top of a box. Step off of the box and land on the floor.
Land as softly as possible. Squat as you land to minimise impact on your joints.
Go straight into another hop after you've landed. This will help you learn to absorb impact.

name: Band Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand on your band with both feet.
Hinge forward at the hips while keeping a flat back.
Hinge until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Push your hips back forward until you are in a standing position.

name: Reverse Crunch
steps: Sit in a v position.
Pull legs and torso together.
Extend back into the starting position.

name: Machine Assisted Narrow Pull Up
steps: Adjust weight for assistance. Stand on platform, grip handles above shoulder-width. Knees on pad if available.
Slowly pull up until chin is above the bar. Keep elbows close, core engaged.
Lower back with control. Pause at bottom. Repeat for reps.

name: Stretcher
steps: Place your foot on the leg pad for leverage and grab the attachment.
Start with your arms extended and your head between your arms.
Begin to pull. As you pull, lean backwards until the attachment touches your chest.

name: Cable Bilateral High Cable Curl
steps: Stand between high cables with arms extended outward and palms facing upward.
Curl both handles toward your head while keeping your upper arms stationary.
Squeeze your biceps, then slowly straighten your elbows.

name: Smith Machine Split Squat
steps: Take a large step forward with one leg until your shoulders are under the smith machine
lower your body until your back knee nearly touches the ground. Your front knee should be bent at a 90-degree angle, and your back leg should be straight.
Push through the heel of your front foot to raise your body back to the starting position.

name: Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands Beginner
steps: Begin in a low lunge position with your right foot forward and your left knee on the ground.
Bring your hands together in a prayer position at your heart.
Exhale and twist your torso to the right, placing your left elbow on the outside of your right knee.
Hold for several breaths and then repeat on the other side.

name: Child Pose Elbows On Block
steps: Place two blocks on the floor, shoulder-width apart.
Kneel in front of the blocks, and lower your torso down so that your elbows are resting on the blocks, and your forehead is resting on the floor.
Relax your arms, shoulders, and neck, and breathe deeply.
Hold for a few breaths, then release.

name: Wild Thing Pose
steps: Start in a downward facing dog position.
Shift your weight onto your left hand and foot, and lift your right leg towards the ceiling.
Slowly bend your right knee and shift your weight onto your right hand as you open up your chest towards the ceiling.
Look towards your right hand and hold the pose for a few breaths before switching sides.

name: Revolved Head To Knee
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your right knee and bring your heel towards your perineum.
Place your left hand on the outside of your right knee and twist your body to the right.
Reach your right hand towards your left foot and look up towards the ceiling. Hold the pose for a few breaths before switching sides.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Reverse Lunge
steps: Hold kettlebell in front rack position.
Step backward, lunge. Bring your back knee to the floor.
Extend your knee back into the starting position.

name: Kettlebell Incline Guillotine Bench Press
steps: Lie on bench, hold kettlebell with both hands over chest.
Lower kettlebells, elbows flared.
Press kettlebells upward, fully extending arms. Repeat.

name: TRX Mountain Climber
steps: Start in a plank position with the TRX straps adjusted to mid-calf length. Place your feet in the TRX stirrups.
Keep your abs engaged, and bring one knee towards your chest while keeping the other leg extended behind you.
