Switch legs, bringing the opposite knee towards your chest while keeping your abs engaged and your back straight.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
steps: Grab a dumbbell and hold with both hands. Point your dumbbell at the ceiling.
Flex at the shoulder joint while keeping your elbows mostly extended.
Flex until you feel a stretch in your lats then bring the dumbbell back to the ceiling.

name: Urdhva Dhanurasana Wheel Pose
steps: Lie down on your back with your feet hip-distance apart and your knees bent.
Place your hands on the floor beside your head, fingertips pointing towards your shoulders.
Push your feet and hands into the floor, lift your hips up and straighten your arms.
Lift your chest towards the ceiling and hold the pose for a few breaths before lowering back down.

name: Dumbbell Knee Lawnmower Row
steps: Stand with feet staggered and one hand on your knee. Hold a dumbbell in the opposing hand.
Hinge forward at the hips, keeping the back flat, and eyes facing forward. The weight should hang directly below the shoulders.
Start with an overhand grip, as you pull rotate the dumbbell. When your upper arm reaches your side your palm should be facing forward.

name: Standing Mini-Band Hip Flexion
steps: Wrap a loop band around your feet.
Drive a knee upwards till your thigh is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment and then return to the starting position.
Try to maintain balance and a good posture when raising the knee.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Curl
steps: Hold a dumbbell with an underhand grip. Seated on an incline bench.
Slowly lift the dumbbell up to chest height
Return to starting position and repeat.

name: Plate Overhead Carry
steps: Start by standing upright with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold a single weight plate overhead with both hands, keeping your arms extended straight above your head.
Begin walking forward, taking slow and steady steps while maintaining a straight line. Your focus should be on maintaining balance and control of the weight plate overhead.

As you walk, continue to keep your arms extended and the weight plate overhead. Try to maintain good posture and avoid leaning forward or backward, as this could result in losing control of the weight plate.
Continue walking for a set distance or for a certain amount of time, keeping your focus on proper form and technique. When finished, return to the starting position and repeat as desired.

name: Plate Squat Hold Reach
steps: Hold the plate with both hands at chest height.
Keeping your core tight and your chest up, squat down as low as you can go while keeping your feet flat on the ground.
Hold the squat position and reach the plate forward, keeping your arms straight and your back straight.
Return the plate to your chest while you hold the squat position and repeat reaching the plate in front of you

name: Big Toe Dorsiflexion
steps: Sit on a bench with your bare foot on the ground.
Raise your big toe as far as it can go, without moving the rest of the toes.

name: Barbell Close Grip Bench Press
steps: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With a narrow grip on the bar, straighten your arms
Lower the bar to your lower-mid chest
Slowly raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

name: Kettlebell Single Leg Single Arm Calf Raise
steps: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, lift the opposing foot off the floor.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Row
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, shifting one foot behind you. Hold the kettlebell in the same hand as the leg shifted backwards.
Bend forwards at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knee, keeping your back straight.
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

name: Seated Twist
steps: Begin seated with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your right knee and place your foot on the floor next to your left thigh.
Inhale and reach your left arm up towards the ceiling.
Exhale and twist to the right, placing your left elbow on the outside of your right knee. Hold for a few breaths and then repeat on the other side.

name: Kettlebell Front Raise
steps: Stand up straight with feet shoulder width apart, holding the kettlebell in front of your pelvis.
Keeping arms straight, raise the kettlebell slightly higher than head level.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Pullover Eccentrics
steps: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell over your shoulder, straight arm.
Slowly lower your arm towards the ground (overhead position).
Pause in the stretched position.
Bend your elbow to return to the starting position.

name: Treadmill Jog
steps: Get the treadmill up to a comfortable speed where you are doing a light jog.

name: Bodyweight Concentration Curl
steps: Place your elbow on one knee and your hand underneath the other leg. Keep the leg that's over your hand extended.
Curl the working arm and use your leg as the resistance.

name: Band Bayesian Reverse Curl
steps: Attach band to a low anchor point. . Point your palms toward your thighs.
Flex your elbow until you feel your biceps contract. Then fully extend elbows.

name: Cardio Band Reverse Fly Jacks
steps: Grab the band with a double overhand grip. Bring both feet outward while performing a little hop.
As you hop, pull the band apart.

name: Landmine Lateral Raise
steps: Stand perpendicularly to the barbell, holding the end of the bar at your outer hip with your inner hand and your palm facing your body.
While keeping your core braced and your arm straight, lift the barbell diagonally up and towards the direction of the landmine attachment, then return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps before switching sides.

name: Reverse Expansion Salute Kneeling
steps: Kneel tall facing straps, elbows bent, palms facing forward.
Keep elbows lifted and shoulders relaxed.
Press arms upward on a diagonal, extending elbows fully.
Bend elbows to return with control, maintaining vertical torso.

name: Dumbbell Swing Lunge
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width. Dumbbells at your side.
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Step back with the same leg until the back knee taps the floor.

name: Kettlebell Front Rack Forward Lunge (Double)
steps: Start with kettlebells in front rack.
Step forward into lunge.
Return to starting position.

name: Kettlebell Wood Chopper
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart and hold the kettle bell with both hands against your hip.
Keeping your arms straight, swing the kettlebell upwards and across your body towards your shoulder, raising the kettlebell to head height rotating your hips as you do so.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Chest Stretch Variation Three
steps: Place your arms behind your back and clasp your hands together.
Slowly extend your elbows until they are locked then lift them away from you.
Pause in this position for a few seconds and then return them to starting position.

name: Barbell Decline Close Grip Bench Press
steps: Lay flat on the bench with your feet in the pads. With a narrow grip on the bar, straighten your arms
Lower the bar to your lower-mid chest
Slowly raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

name: Machine Assisted Parallel Bar Dips
steps: Grip bars with arms straight, shoulders above hands. Place knees on pad.
Lower slowly until elbows are at 90 degrees.
Push back up to start position, extending arms fully.

name: Machine Roll Outs
steps: Hold the Ab Roller with both hands and kneel on the floor with your feet up and crossed.
Slowly roll the ab roller straight forward, stretching your body into a straight position.
After a pause at the stretched position, start pulling yourself back to the starting position. This should be a slow and controlled movement.

name: Headstand
steps: Begin on your hands and knees with your wrists under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Place your forearms on the floor and interlace your fingers.
Place the crown of your head on the floor and tuck your toes under.
Walk your feet towards your head and lift your hips up.
Straighten your legs and find your balance. Hold for several breaths and then release.

name: Cardio Skater
steps: Stand, balance on right foot, left foot behind, slightly bent knees.
Jump to left, landing on left foot, right foot behind, swinging arms.
Continue leaping side-to-side, maintaining balance and speed, like a speed skater.

name: Cable Kneeling Oblique Crunch
steps: Kneel sideways to cable and hold rope behind head, elbows pointed out.
Crunch torso toward hip on cable side, keeping hips stable.
Slowly return to upright, maintaining constant tension on obliques.

name: Dumbbell Skullcrusher
steps: Lay flat on the floor or a bench with your fists extended to the ceiling and a neutral grip.
Break at the elbows until your fists are by your temples. Then extend your elbows and flex your triceps at the top.

name: Internally Rotated Seated Rear Delt Fly
steps: Sit with your chest in your lap, dumbbells in hands, arms bent, internally rotate shoulders.
Raise dumbbells out to sides, squeeze rear delts.
Lower weights, repeat for reps.

name: Quads Stretch Variation Three
steps: Lay flat on your belly, with both hands reach back and grab the tops of your feet.
Keeping your upper legs flat on the ground, pull both of your feet towards your buttocks.
Pause at the apex of the stretch, then return to starting position.

name: Cable Standing Single Arm Incline Chest Press
steps: Stand sideways to cable with handle set low, holding it at chest height.
Press handle upward and forward at a slight diagonal, keeping torso stable.
Squeeze chest at the top, then return slowly to starting position.

name: Barbell Banded Back Squat
steps: Loop resistance bands under your feet and around the barbell. Stand shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core, push hips back, and lower until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels, extend hips and knees, and return to standing tall.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

name: Cardio Band Press Jacks
steps: Stand with the band looped under both feet and the other end of the band in both hands in an overhead press position.
Do a light hop and bring both feet outward while pressing the band overhead.

name: Seated Side Bend Pose
steps: Sit comfortably on the floor with your legs crossed.
Inhale and raise your right arm above your head.
As you exhale, bend your body to the left side and rest your left hand on the ground.
Look up towards the ceiling and hold the pose for a few breaths. Then switch sides and repeat the pose on the other side.

name: Dumbbell Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Grab a stick of some sort or hold onto something stable (rack, bench).
Grab a box that is knee height or slightly lower.
Hold the stick in your right arm, dumbbell in the other and put your right leg on the box.
Begin your squat by breaking at the knees. Get your knee close to the floor or all the way to the floor. Make sure to keep your chest tall.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Clean And Press
steps: Begin with the kettlebell between your legs.
Hinge at your hips, and lift to shoulder, then press overhead.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Stand tall with a single dumbbell extended overhead.
Flex at the elbow letting the dumbbell travel behind your body.
Try not to let your elbow flare outward.

name: Bodyweight Single Leg Heels Elevated Hip Thrust
steps: Start by lying on a bench with your foot on a plate or low box.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Mini Band Walking Mountain Climber
steps: Loop band around feet, start in high plank.
Step one foot forward under torso.
Alternate steps continuously, keeping hips stable.

name: Cable Wrist Extension
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Start with your elbow at a
degree angle with your palm facing down. Flex and extend at the wrist.

name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Overhead Press
steps: Take a half kneeling position while holding two dumbbells.
Drive the dumbbells upwards.

name: Smith Machine Overhand Row
steps: Start hinged forward with a flat back. Make sure your elbows are fully extended.
Pull the bar to your sternum.

name: Kettlebell Clean And Jerk
steps: Swing kettlebell between legs, then pull it up to rack position.
Dip slightly, drive through legs, and press kettlebell overhead.
Lower back to rack, then swing down for next repetition.

name: Landmine Squat
steps: Hold the end of the bar in a goblet position.
Push your hips back and break at the knees.
Reach at least parallel with the ground before pushing through your heels back to the starting position.

name: Cable Seated Bayesian Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Sit on a bench facing away from the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Plate Internally Rotated Rear Delt Fly
steps: With plates in either hand, bend your knees with your feet slightly bowed out. Hinge forward with a flat back.
Maintain an overhand grip and internally rotated shoulders.
Raise your arms backward toward the ceiling while maintaining a light band in your elbows.

name: Dorsal Flexion Hold
steps: From the standing position, raise your toes and balance on your heels for the given duration.
Maintain a good upper body form.

name: Dumbbell Seated Zottman Curl
steps: Sit tall holding dumbbells at sides with palms facing forward.
Curl dumbbells up, then rotate palms downward at the top.
Lower slowly with palms down, controlling the entire descent.

name: Band Half Kneeling Single Arm Pulldown
steps: Kneel facing anchor with band overhead, holding the end of the band in one hand.
Keep torso tall and pull elbow down toward your hip.
Squeeze lat at the bottom, then return arm slowly to starting position.

name: Bodyweight Deficit Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start.

name: Machine Crunch
steps: Place your feet under the foot pads and grab the handles with your hands.
Flex your spine and bring your upper and lower body together.

name: Bosu Ball Toe Tap
steps: Stand on Bosu, lift one foot, tap it on the Bosu.
Alternate tapping feet while maintaining balance.
Keep the movement controlled and steady.

name: Smith Machine Staggered Deadlift
steps: Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.

name: Dumbbell Offset Squat
steps: Hold a dumbbell over one shoulder.
Initiate the squat by pushing your hips back.
Avoid doing any twisting. Try to keep your shoulders even.

name: Cable Incline Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Lie on a bench, holding cables lower than shoulder height with palms facing your feet.
Sweep both handles together above your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause briefly, then lower your arms under control.

name: Kettlebell Floor Press
steps: Start flat on your back with the kettlebells extended over you.
Bring your elbows to the floor, rest for a second to remove all the momentum from the rep, then press to a lockout.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Low Row
steps: Press your chest into the chest pad and grab the horizontal handles with an overhand grip.
Pull the handles toward you, make sure your elbows stay flared out.

name: Plate Alternating Deadstop Row
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Hold each plate to the side of you.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the plates to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
One at a time, lift the plate up. Return the plate to the floor and do the other side.

name: Band Upright Row
steps: Stand with one or both feet on one end of a band. Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the band to chin level or slightly higher.

name: Cable Bilateral Cross Tricep Extension
steps: Stand between crossed high cables, holding the opposite handle in each hand.
Extend both arms downward while keeping your elbows beside your torso.
Squeeze your triceps, then slowly return to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Decline Alternating Single Arm Press
steps: Lay on a decline bench with both arms extended in front of you.
Break at one of your arms first bringing that arm to your side while keeping the other arm extended.
Press the dumbbell back to the ceiling. Fully extend that arm before initiating on the other side.

name: Dumbbell Side Step Up
steps: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with a dumbbell in your hands. Your feet should be slightly pointed outward, and your shoulders should be down and relaxed.
Place a step or box beside you, and step up onto it with one foot. Your other foot should remain on the ground.
Push off your grounded foot, raising your body up onto the step.
Step back down with the same foot, returning to the starting position.

name: Cable Belt Calf Raise
steps: Put on a dip belt and attach the cable carabiner to the chain/strap.
Take a few steps back and stand tall. Raise up onto the balls of your feet and hold for a
count.

name: Seated Wrist Flexor Stretch
steps: Bring one arm in front of you palm facing up, elbow straight and shoulder relaxed.
With your other hand hold onto the palm and force it into passive extension.
This will stretch your wrist flexors.

name: Mini Band Fire Hydrant
steps: Loop band above knees, start on hands and knees.
Lift one knee outward, keeping hips level.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Cable Upright Row
steps: Use a handle attachment with the cable set to the bottom of the machine.
Pull your elbows straight up toward the ceiling until the attachment is just below your chin then extend until your elbows are fully extended.

name: Barbell Pause Box Squat
steps: Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell resting on your upper back.
Lower your body into a squat position, sitting back onto the box and pausing for a moment before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.

name: Mini Band Laying Glute Bridge Abduction
steps: Loop band above knees, lie on back knees bent.
Lift hips into bridge, hold top position.
Pulse knees outward against band, controlling tension.

name: Kettlebell Hang Clean And Press
steps: Hold kettlebells just above knees with slight bend in hips and knees.
Explosively pull kettlebells to shoulders, catching it in a partial squat.
Stand tall and press kettlebells overhead until arms are fully extended.

name: Medicine Ball Reverse Lunge
steps: Hold medicine ball at chest.
Step back into lunge position.
Return to starting position. Repeat on other leg.

name: Band Skullcrusher
steps: Anchor a band to a stable point.
Face away and begin with your elbows bent and fists by your temples.
Extend your elbows until your triceps contract.

name: Cable Y Raise
steps: Stand over crossed low cables, holding the opposite handle in each hand.
Raise your arms upward and outward, forming a Y shape.
Pause near overhead, then slowly lower the handles.

name: Barbell Conventional Pause Deadlift
steps: Set up for a standard deadlift, grip the barbell.
Lift, pause at knee height.
Hold briefly, then complete the lift; reset and repeat for desired reps.

name: Bodyweight Standing Hamstring Curl
steps: Stand up straight using a balancing aid.
Shift your weight on one leg.
Bend and extend the non-weight bearing leg.
Knees should remain aligned.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Shoulder Extension
steps: Hold kettlebell at your sides with straight arms and palms neutral.
Move arm backward until you feel lats and rear delts engage.
Lower slowly to starting position under full control.

name: Downward Dog Toe To Heel
steps: Begin in a downward-facing dog position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your feet hip-width apart.
Lift your right foot off the mat and place your right toes on top of your left heel.
Press your palms and fingers firmly into the mat and lift your hips up towards the ceiling, deepening the stretch in your hamstrings and calves.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, and then release by slowly walking your hands back out to a downward-facing dog position.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Good Morning
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your chest.
Bend forward at the hips keeping your back and knees straight and the kettlebell close to your chest.
Return to standing position and thrust your pelvis forward.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
steps: Stand tall with your feet on the ground. You can put the the balls of your feet on top of a plate to extend the range of motion.
Imagine you have a string attached to your heels and pull your heels up toward the ceiling.

name: Cable Bent Over Single Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Face away from cable, hinge at hips, and grasp handle behind head.
Keep upper arm still and extend elbow until arm is straight.
Squeeze tricep at the top, then slowly return to starting position.

name: Barbell Front Squat Olympic
steps: Measure your hands by the markings on the bar to make sure you're even. Then throw your elbows underneath the bar.
The bar should be set so high on your shoulders it digs into your neck a bit. Make sure to push your elbows up to the ceiling for the entire rep. To make sure you don't get too pitched forward.
Use the squat stance you would use for a back or goblet squat. Push your hips back to initiate the squat. Break at the knees until you hit parallel depth.
Squat back up to a standing position.

name: Cable Single Arm Internally Rotated High Reverse Fly
steps: Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arms. Internally rotate the shoulders.
From there, your shoulder should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Squat
steps: Place two dumbbells on your shoulders and push your elbows upward.
Push your hips back and break at the knees.
Hit parallel depth and then drive through your heels back to the starting position.

name: Parallel Bar Dips
steps: Grip bars with arms straight, shoulders above hands. Keep legs straight or bent.
Lower slowly until elbows are at
degrees.
Push back up to start position, extending arms fully.

name: Plate Overhead Shrug
steps: Stand tall with a weight plate overhead.
Elevated and depress your scapula.
Avoid leaning forward or backwards to keep pressure off of your lumbar spine.

name: Cable Bilateral Cross Upright Row
steps: Stand between crossed low cables, holding the opposite handle in each hand.
Pull both handles upward, leading with your elbows.
Stop near chest height, then lower the handles slowly.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Hammer Incline Curl
steps: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips down.
Take a neutral grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Cable Incline Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Lie on a bench, holding cables below shoulder height with palms facing your feet.
Sweep both handles together above your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause briefly, then lower your arms under control.

name: Kettlebell Hang Clean And Jerk
steps: Hold kettlebells just above knees with slight bend in hips and knees.
Explosively pull kettlebells to shoulders, catching it in a partial squat.
Stand tall and press kettlebells overhead until arms are fully extended.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Swing
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell between legs, grip with one hand, hinge at hips.
Swing kettlebell forcefully forward, using hip thrust, arm straight.
Swing kettlebell back between legs, repeat for desired reps.

name: Lats Stretch Variation Two
steps: Stand up right and raise your hand to a full stretch above your head.
Slowly lean across your body and trace the opposite hand down your leg.
Hold at the bottom of the stretch, return to starting position and then switch sides.

name: Elbow Plank Mountain Climber
steps: Begin in an elbow plank position with your core engaged.
Bring your right knee towards your right elbow.
Return to plank, then switch legs quickly. Repeat.

name: Cardio Three Step Heismans
steps: Start with a shoulder width stance.
Stay on your toes, step right, tap your left toe to the ground, plant your right foot and raise your left leg.
Then repeat in the opposite direction.

name: Barbell Skullcrusher
steps: Take a shoulder width grip. Break at the elbows. Try to keep your elbows tucked in. Don't let them flare out.
Stop the bar a few inches from your forehead and extend your elbows back up.

name: Cable Chest Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cables should be set to shoulder height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Walk a few steps forward. Then press the weight forward.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

name: Cable Standing Bilateral Pull In
steps: Stand between high cables, holding the handles in each hand.
Pull both elbows downward and inward toward your sides.
Squeeze your lats, then slowly extend your arms outward.

name: Cable Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Lay on bench with cables at shoulder level.
Sweep both handles in front of your chest while keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Squeeze your chest, then lower the handles under control.

name: Cable Standing Straight Leg Glute Kickback
steps: Use an ankle attachment. The cable should be set to the bottom of the crossover machine.
Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

name: Barbell Heels Elevated Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the ground with a bench behind you. Place both feet on a plate or low box. Have the barbell over your legs just above your hips.
Lean back against the bench so that your shoulders are resting upon it, stretch your arms out to either side using the bench as support.
Raise the weight by driving through your feet and extending your hips upwards. Support the weight with your shoulders and feet.
Slowly extend as far as you can, and then slowly return to the starting position.

name: Cable Standing High To Low Wood Chopper
steps: Stand sideways to cable and grasp handle with both hands overhead.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally down toward opposite hip.
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.

name: Mini Band Laying Hip Flexion
steps: Loop band around feet, lie flat on back.
Lift one leg upward, keeping knee straight.
Lower slowly and alternate sides under control.

name: Cardio Criss Cross Jacks
steps: Perform a jumping jack while crossing the feet.

name: Medicine Ball Overhead Squat
steps: Hold medicine ball overhead.
Squat down, keeping back straight.
Stand back up. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Forward Lunges
steps: Step forward with one leg.
Lower your body until your rear knee nearly touches the ground.
Ensure you remain upright, and your front knee stay above the front foot.
Push off the floor with your front foot until you return to the starting position. Switch legs.

name: Half Kneeling Hip Hinge
steps: Place one knee on a bench.
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Dumbbell Bench Wrist Curl
steps: Grip the dumbbell with your palm facing upwards with your forearm rested against the bench.
Slowly curl your wrist upwards in a semicircular motion.
Return to starting position and repeat.

name: Vitruvian Arnold Press
steps: Stand tall with your palms facing yourself.
As you press, rotate your arms.

name: TRX I Raise
steps: Stand facing the TRX straps and hold onto the handles with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight and hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keeping your core engaged, slowly raise your arms forward until they are overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.

name: Ring Curl
steps: Stand holding gymnastic rings with your arms extended in front of you, palms facing up.
Curl rings towards shoulders, squeezing biceps.
Slowly lower rings back to starting position, keeping control. Repeat.

name: Stationary Bike
steps: Hold the handles and maintain a neutral spine.
Pedal at a moderate pace and try to minimise rocking back and forth.

name: Supported Matsyasana Pose
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs stretched out in front of you.
Place a yoga block behind you, horizontally, at the base of your spine.
Slowly recline over the block, supporting yourself with your forearms, until your back is resting on the block.
Relax your arms at your sides, palms facing up, and breathe deeply.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the ground with a bench behind you. Have the barbell over your legs just above your hips.
Lean back against the bench so that your shoulders are resting upon it, stretch your arms out to either side using the bench as support.
Raise the weight by driving through your feet and extending your hips upwards. Support the weight with your shoulders and feet.
Slowly extend as far as you can, and then slowly return to the starting position.

name: Mini Band Pull Apart
steps: Hold band at shoulder height, arms straight.
Pull hands apart, squeezing shoulder blades together.
Return slowly, maintaining tension throughout.

name: Bodyweight Ninety Ninety Hip Stretch
steps: Sit with one leg in front of you flat on the ground.
While the other leg is to your side, also flat on the ground with your foot pointed backwards.
Hold this position for the prescribed amount of time then change sides.

name: Bodyweight Box Assisted Dips
steps: Grip the edge of the boxes with your hands, Keep your feet together and legs straight.
Lower your body straight down.
Slowly press back up to the starting point.
TIP: Make this harder by raising your feet off the floor and adding weight.

name: Weighted Pull Ups
steps: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended. Weight hanging between your legs.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back to starting position.

name: Bosu Ball Plank Glute Kickback
steps: Start in a plank position with Bosu under feet.
Lift one leg back, squeezing glutes.
Lower the leg back down and switch sides.

name: Bodyweight Incline Knee Push Up
steps: Start by placing two boxes (or one) on the floor, about shoulder-width apart.
Position yourself in a plank position with your hands on top of the box, keeping your arms straight.
Put your knees on the floor.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the floor by bending your arms, until your chest nearly touches the box.
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms and engaging your chest, triceps and shoulders.

name: Band Shoulder Y Raise
steps: Hold one end of a band with your arm to the side and behind your body.
Hold the other end in front of your body (overhand grip).
Move your arm away from your body and upward while externally rotating your shoulder.
Finish with your arm over your head and thumb up

name: Barbell Stiff Leg Deadlifts
steps: Stand with a barbell at your shins with your feet shoulder width apart.
Bend forward at your hips and keep your knees as fully extended as possible.
Grab the barbell and then extend your hips while maintaining a straight back.
From the standing position, lower the weight in a controlled manner.
You can either lower the weight to the floor or before you touch the floor, depending on your mobility.

name: Ez Bar Reverse Spider Curl
steps: Lay on an incline bench and hold the EZ bar with your elbows extended.
From this starting position, curl the bar up towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body and your core engaged.
Slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Barbell Suitcase Carry
steps: Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart with the bar on the ground at your side.
Lift the bar to your side and walk for the allotted amount of time or distance.
Set the bar down and switch sides.

name: Barbell Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive
steps: Hold barbell in front rack position and place one foot on the platform.
Drive through the front heel to step up, keeping chest tall and core braced.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

name: Dumbbell Decline Neutral Bench Press
steps: Lie on the decline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

name: Table Top Pose Variation 1
steps: Beginner
Start in a tabletop position on your hands and knees with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
Turn your hands so that your fingers are pointing towards the sides of your mat and the tops of your hands are on the floor.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold the pose for several breaths or as long as is comfortable.

name: Band Bayesian Hammer Curl
steps: Attach band to a low anchor point. Use a neutral grip.
Flex your elbow until you feel your biceps contract. Then fully extend elbows.

name: Cable Low Single Arm Lateral Raise
steps: Use a handle attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
You should vertically abduct at the shoulder raising your arm straight out to the side.
Raise until your arm is parallel with the ground and then back to the starting position.

name: Thoracic Flexion And Extensions
steps: Bring yourself on all 4's. Push the ground away from you, rounding back and shoulders as much as possible.
To enhance the spine flexion suck the belly button in and tuck the tailbone (coccyx) under. Hold this position for a brief moment
Now do the exact opposite, try to bend the spine backwards. Go back and forth on these positions

name: Dumbbell Feet Down Russian Twist
steps: Sit with feet on floor, lean back slightly, holding dumbbell at chest.
Rotate torso and move dumbbell toward one side without letting feet lift.
Twist to opposite side, keeping core tight and movement controlled.

name: Cable Push Pull
steps: Stand between cables, holding one handle near your chest and one forward.
Press one arm forward while pulling the opposite elbow backward.
Reverse the movement under control, then switch your stance and arms.

name: Bodyweight Assisted Mixed Grip Pullup
steps: Grasp the chin-up bar with a mixed grip, shoulder-width apart.
Place your feet on the ground, legs bent slightly.
Use your legs to assist as you pull your chin above the bar.

name: Machine Pendulum Squat
steps: Position yourself in the pendulum squat machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Place feet shoulder-width apart on the platform. Keep your back straight, and slowly lower into a squat position.
Press through your heels to return to the starting position, keeping your core engaged. Repeat for desired reps and sets.

name: Dumbbell Crunch
steps: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet flat on the floor and your knees bent.
Hold a dumbbell over your clavicle.
Engage your core muscles and lift your torso off the floor until your shoulders are a few inches off the ground.
Lower yourself back down to the starting position, but avoid resting completely on the floor between reps.

name: Machine 45 Degree Calf Raise
steps: Adjust the machine in accordance with your height and sit.
The balls of your feet should be supporting your weight on the calve block, your heels extended off of it.
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Curl
steps: Sit tall holding dumbbell at your sides with palm facing forward.
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder, keeping elbow tight to torso.
Squeeze bicep, then lower slowly to full extension.

name: Bodyweight Plank Arm Lift
steps: Start in a plank position.
Raise your arm out in front of you.
Return to the starting position, then raise the opposing arm.
Make sure to keep your hips stable. If you're unable to, try performing this exercise from the knees.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Chest Press
steps: Lie on bench holding one kettlebell above chest with arm extended.
Lower kettlebell toward chest while keeping torso stable.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting.

name: Cable Kneeling Pallof Press To Wood Chopper
steps: Kneel sideways to cable and press handle straight forward, keeping torso stable.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally across body into a wood chopper motion.
Return to center and bring handle back to chest under control.

name: Machine Horizontal Leg Press
steps: Place your legs on the platform with your feet at shoulder width.
Release the weight and extend your legs fully, without locking your knees.
Lower the weight until your legs are at a 90° angle (but DO NOT allow your butt and lower back to rise off of the pad. This will put your lower back in a rounded position, which is very dangerous.)
Raise the weight back to starting position.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Step Up Balance
steps: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a kettlebell in one hand
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box, keeping your left foot off the ground.
Step back down with your right foot, lowering your left foot to the ground.

name: Cable Bar Standing Crunch
steps: Use a bar attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Face away from the cable tower and walk a few steps forward.
Push your hips back, and flex your abs.
Return to the starting standing position and repeat.

name: Band Squat Hold Row
steps: Anchor the band to a stable point.
Take a half squat position and hold there.
Perform a row while holding the squat position.

name: Triceps Stretch Variation One
steps: Raise your left arm above your head, and bend at the elbow so your hand is resting at the top of your back.
Use the opposite hand to gently apply pressure to the elbow.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then repeat with the other arm.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Pulldown
steps: Grip the handles with the palms facing down.
Sit on the machine and press your knees into the knee pad.
Pull the handles until your upper arm is even with your torso, or just behind your torso.
Extend until your elbows are fully extended before initiating the next rep.

name: Incline Push Up
steps: Stand facing bench or sturdy elevated platform.
Place hands on edge of bench or platform, slightly wider than shoulder width.
Slowly lower your body until your chest almost touches the bench.
Push body up until arms are extended.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
steps: Grab two dumbbells while standing upright with the dumbbells at your side.
Raise the two dumbbells with your elbows being fully extended until the dumbbells are eye level.
Lower the weights in a controlled manner to the starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Wood Chopper
steps: Stand with a shoulder width stance. Begin with the dumbbell near one of your quads.
Rotate at your upper spine to engage the obliques.
You can pivot your back foot to keep from generating too much torque at the knee.

name: Kettlebell Walking Shoulder Flexion Bent Elbow Hold
steps: Stand up straight with the working arm in front of you and bent at the elbow (90°).
Hold an inverted kettlebell in that arm. Walk around holding the kettlebell in that position.
The goal is to maintain the position of the kettlebell without it falling over.

name: Kettlebell Hollow Hold
steps: Grab a kettlebell.
Lie on your back, lift legs & shoulders off floor.
Hold kettlebell above your head, engage core, and maintain position.

name: Mini Band Plank Glute Kickback
steps: Loop band around feet, hold high plank.
Extend one leg back, squeezing glute at top.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Low Incline Bench Press
steps: Adjust the seat pad to match your height.
Press the weight forward until your elbows are nearly extended. Return to the starting position with out letting the weight rest at the bottom until finishing your set.

name: Bodyweight Step Up Knee Drive
steps: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height.
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box, bring your off leg all the way through until your leg is parallel with the ground.
Step back down with your right foot, lowering your left foot to the ground.

name: Dumbbell Drag Curl
steps: Hold dumbbells at sides with palms forward and elbows tight to body.
Curl dumbbells by dragging them along torso, moving elbows behind you.
Squeeze biceps at top, then lower slowly to start position.

name: Cable Single Arm Lat Prayer
steps: Use handle attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward. Your ear should be even with your arms.
Initiate the movement with your shoulder and not your elbow. As you flex at the shoulder joint push your hips forward until your hips meet the attachment.

name: Shoulder External Internal Rotation
steps: Externally and internally rotate the shoulder to mobilise the joint on the specific movement.

name: Core Stability 1 Crosslateral Limb Raise 4Pt Position
steps: Bring yourself to the 4 point position (on all fours)
90° angles at hips and shoulder and neutral spine
Raise opposite limbs till they are parallel to the ground
Hold for a split second and bring back to starting position

name: Bosu Ball Feet Elevated Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on back, place feet on Bosu, knees bent.
Lift hips and squeeze glutes.
Lower hips back down to complete one rep.

name: Landmine Overhead Press
steps: Stand facing the landmine, holding the end of the bar in both hands with your palms facing each other.
Extend your arms upward, pressing the end of the bar up overhead. Pause at the top of the movement, then lower the bar with control back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

name: Bodyweight Overhand Inverted Row
steps: Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.

name: Smith Machine Sissy Squat
steps: Stand facing away from the machine, positioning your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart to provide a stable base, and then reach behind you to firmly grip the bar with both hands, maintaining an overhand grip.
Initiate the movement by leaning backward, allowing your upper body to incline while simultaneously bending your knees. As you descend, maintain control
drive through your quadriceps while pushing your hips forward, gradually straightening your knees. Maintain a slow, controlled pace

name: Cable Split Squat
steps: You can use a straight or EZ bar on this exercise. Cable should be set all to the bottom.
Grab the attachment and walk back a few steps. Take a split stance. One leg in front and one behind.
Break at the knees and hips to initiate the split squat. Make sure your back knee touches the floor.
Squat back up into a standing position.

name: Back Rowing Preps Roll Down With Obliques
steps: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps at chest height.
Rotate torso slightly, engaging obliques as you begin rolling back.
Maintain rotation and bend elbows, keeping shoulders relaxed and spine controlled.
Roll back up with control, returning to center without losing tension.

name: Cable High Reverse Fly
steps: Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arm.
From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

name: Landmine Split Jerk
steps: Hold the bar over one shoulder. Stand with a shoulder width stance.
Dip at the hips and knees, generate some momentum and press the bar.
As you press, split your stance. Bring the leg of the working arm back and the other forward.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Deficit Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, dumbbells in front rack position, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start

name: Plate Russian Twist
steps: Start by sitting on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground
Engage your core muscles by pulling your belly button toward your spine.
Slowly twist your upper body to the right, keeping your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold for a second and then twist to the left, holding for another second.

name: Windshield Wiper
steps: Lie on back, arms out, legs together.
Lift legs to
degrees.
Rotate legs side to side, keeping shoulders grounded.

name: Laying Alternating Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your back, arms by sides, legs straight.
Lift one leg to a 45-degree angle.
Lower leg, lift opposite leg; alternate smoothly.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Holding the dumbbell in a goblet squat place your foot on a bench or box.
Break at the hips and knees. Try to go to the point where your hamstring is parallel with the ground. Or until your back knee taps the floor.
Make sure to keep your back flat and your elbows directly under your fists.

name: Dumbbell Hang Clean And Press
steps: Hold dumbbells at thighs with slight knee bend and flat back.
Pull dumbbells to shoulders explosively, catching them in partial squat.
Stand tall and press overhead until arms are fully extended.

name: TRX Ab Rollout
steps: Grasp the TRX handles with both hands, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your abs engaged, roll forward onto your toes, and extend your arms in front of you.
Slowly lower your body down to the ground, keeping your arms straight and your abs engaged.
When your head gets between your arms, pause for a moment and then use your abs to pull your body back up to the starting position.

name: Bodyweight Curtsy Step Down
steps: Stand tall on platform and cross free leg diagonally behind you.
Lower body by bending standing knee, keeping hips square.
Drive through standing heel to return upright with control.

name: Barbell Landmine Sissy Squat
steps: Hold the bar in a goblet position.
Stand tall, push your knees forward until your calves touch your hamstrings.
Make sure to keep your hips extended.

name: TRX Forearm Plank
steps: Lie face down on the ground and place your forearms on the ground directly under your shoulders.
With your feet in the stirrups, kick both feet into the TRX straps and hold the handles above your head.
Tighten your abs, glutes, and legs to form a straight line from your head to your feet.

name: Cable Wood Chopper
steps: Set the cable at about nipple level. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

name: Cable Alternating Decline Bench Chest Fly
steps: Lay on bench with cables above shoulder level.
Start with both arms extended out.
Bring one arm forward and downward, while keeping the other arm in the same position.
Alternate arms until you complete the allotted amount of reps.

name: Criss Cross Bow Tie Pose
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.
Cross your right arm over your left arm, bringing your palms together in front of your chest.
Lower your arms down so that your palms face down towards the ground, and your right elbow is resting on top of your left elbow.
Hold for a few breaths, then switch sides.

name: Biceps Stretch Variation Three
steps: Bend your arm at the elbow, raising your hand to your shoulder.
Using your other hand, stretch the arm down to its full extent.

name: Cable Standing Single Arm Internally Rotated Incline Chest Fly
steps: Stand sideways to cable with handle set low, palm rotated inward before lifting.
Bring arm upward and across chest in an arc, keeping elbow slightly bent.
Squeeze upper chest at the top, then return slowly while maintaining internal rotation.

name: Plate Staggered Pinch Grip Deadlift
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding two plates with a pinch grip.
Place one foot slightly behind the other, with the heel of your back foot elevated.
From this starting position, bend at the hips and knees to lower the plates towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.

name: Traps Stretch Variation One
steps: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart.
Place your left hand on your head and gently pull your head down towards your left shoulder. Then return to centre point.
Repeat, using your right hand pulling towards your right shoulder.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Step Up
steps: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold one dumbbell on your side with a neutral grip.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench and stand up straight, keeping the barbell at your shoulders.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, to return to the starting position.

name: Cardio Karaoke
steps: Stand upright, feet together, facing forward, ready to move laterally.
Move right foot behind left, then step left foot to the side.
Alternate crossing and stepping, increase speed, maintain rhythm and balance.

name: Medicine Ball Half Kneeling Wood Chopper
steps: Kneel with one knee down, holding a medicine ball.
Rotate torso and until the medicine ball is pointed the opposite direction.
Repeat the movement on the other side.

name: Dumbbell Somersault Squat
steps: Start in a deep squat holding a dumbbell between your thighs.
Extend your knees until mostly extended without extending the hips.

name: Landmine Kneeling Twist
steps: Kneel down facing the landmine with your knees hip-width apart and your back straight. Grasp the landmine barbell with both hands, interlacing your fingers and holding it above and slightly in front of your body.

Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, twist your torso to one side, rotating your arms and the landmine along with it. Pause briefly at the end of the twist, feeling the contraction in your oblique muscles.
Slowly rotate back to the starting position, then twist to the opposite side, repeating the same motion.
Repeat both sides of the rotation for the desired number of reps.

name: Cable Pec Fly
steps: Set the cable pin at shoulder height or just above.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Walk a few steps forward. Then press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

name: Kettlebell Half Kneeling Romanian Deadlift
steps: Place one knee on a bench and hold a kettlebell.
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Cable Standing Single Arm Chest Fly
steps: Stand sideways to cable and hold handle at chest height with slight arm bend.
Bring arm across chest in a smooth arc without rotating your torso.
Squeeze chest at end range, then return slowly to starting position.

name: Barbell Snatch
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, barbell over midfoot. Grip the bar wide with an overhand grip, chest up, and back straight.
Lift the bar by driving through your legs, keeping it close to your body. Extend your hips and knees while maintaining a straight back.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles while shrugging your shoulders. Pull yourself under the bar as it moves upward.
Drop into a deep squat while locking the bar overhead. Stabilize, then stand up fully to complete the lift.

name: Bodyweight Feet Plank Jack
steps: Start in high plank, hands under shoulders, body straight.
Jump feet out wide while bracing core and keeping hips level.
Jump feet back together, maintaining plank alignment throughout.

name: Two Arms Cow Face Pose
steps: Begin in a comfortable seated position on your mat, with your legs crossed and your spine straight.
Extend your right arm up toward the ceiling and bend it at the elbow, bringing your right hand behind your head.
Reach your left arm behind your back and bend it at the elbow, bringing your left hand up between your shoulder blades.
Clasp your hands behind your back, trying to touch your fingertips together. If you can't quite reach, you can use a strap or towel to bridge the gap between your hands.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Press
steps: Start by laying on a bench with two dumbbells.
Position the dumbbell above your chest with your elbow bent and shoulder level.
Slowly lower the dumbbell towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and your core engaged while the other dumbbell remains pointed toward the ceiling.
Once the dumbbell reaches your side, pause for a moment and then press the weight back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to your other arm.

name: Barbell Roll Outs
steps: Hold the Barbell with both hands and kneel on the floor with your feet up
Slowly roll the Barbell straight forward, stretching your body into a straight position.
After a pause at the stretched position, start pulling yourself back to the starting position. This should be a slow and controlled movement.

name: Ring Standing Chest Fly
steps: Start by adjusting the rings straps to chest height. Stand facing the rings with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rings' handles with both hands, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
Lean forward, keeping your arms extended and your core engaged. Your body should form a slight diagonal line from your ankles to your head.
Slowly bring your arms towards each other, in front of your chest, while keeping your core engaged and your body in a stable position.

name: Wide Legged Forward Fall
steps: Start standing at the top of your mat with your feet wide apart.
Interlace your fingers behind your back and inhale to expand your chest.
Exhale and fold forward from your hips, bringing your hands up and over your head towards the ground.
Hold for a few breaths and then release the hands and come back up to standing.

name: Horizontal Hack Squat
steps: Position yourself in the hack squat machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Place feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Press through your heels to the starting position, keeping your core engaged. Repeat for desired reps and sets.

name: Long Lever Plank
steps: Start in a hand plank position and walk your hands further out until your ears are between your biceps.
Hold in this position for the allotted amount of time.
Make sure you keep a flat back for the whole set.

name: Barbell Reverse Deadlift
steps: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with your toes pointed slightly outward.
Place a barbell on the floor behind you, with the weight plates on either side.
Bend down and grab the barbell with an overhand grip, your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your shoulders down as you grip the bar.
Stand up straight, lifting the barbell off the ground and pulling it toward your hips. Keep your elbows close to your body and your shoulders down as you do this.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Tricep Guilotine Press
steps: Lie on bench holding kettlebell above upper chest with palm facing in.
Lower kettlebell toward neck or upper chest by bending elbow forward.
Extend arm fully, squeezing triceps at the top while keeping shoulder stable.

name: Mini Band Single Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand on band with one foot, hinge at hips.
Keep back flat, opposite leg extended behind.
Drive hips forward to return upright.

name: Machine Overhand Row
steps: Sit on the machine, feet flat, and grab the handles with palms facing down, keeping your back straight.
Pull handles towards your lower abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep elbows close to your body.
Slowly return to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking elbows. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Bodyweight Pike Press
steps: Start in a plank position. Push your hips up toward the ceiling.
Lower your head towards the floor by bending your elbows
Push through your hands and return to the starting pike position.
Repeat

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive
steps: Hold one dumbbell in front rack position and place opposite foot on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up while keeping chest tall and core tight.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

name: In And Out Jump Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Start by doing a regular squat, then engage your core and jump up explosively.
Narrow your stance while in the air, and land softly. Go directly into another rep.

name: Stability Ball Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor, place upper back on a stability ball, feet flat, knees bent.
Drive hips upward by squeezing glutes, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower hips slowly without touching the floor, maintaining core engagement, then repeat.

name: Cable High Single Arm Rear Delt Fly
steps: Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arm.
From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

name: Barbell Kickstand Squat
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, one foot slightly behind. Bar on your back.
Lower into a squat, keeping weight on front heel.
Return to standing, engaging glutes and core.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
steps: Hold the weight tucked into your upper chest area, keeping your elbows in. Your feet should be slightly wider than shoulder width.
Sink down into the squat, keeping your elbows inside the track of your knees.
Push through your heels while keeping your chest up and return to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Incline Skullcrusher
steps: Set bench to incline and hold dumbbells above chest with palms facing in.
Bend elbows to lower dumbbells toward forehead under control.
Extend arms fully, squeezing triceps at the top.

name: Dumbbell Seated Shrug
steps: Sit on a bench with dumbbells in both hands, palms facing your body, back straight.
Elevate your shoulders and hold the contracted position at the apex of the motion.
Slowly lower your shoulders back to starting position.

name: Bodyweight Pop Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Start by doing a regular squat, tap the floor, then engage your core and jump up explosively.
Bring your feet mostly together, tap your toes back to the floor, then bring your feet back their original width.

name: Cable Single Arm Bench Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cable should be set to shoulder height.
Bring the handle to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulder and elbow simultaneously.

name: Kettlebell Incline Bench Press
steps: Position the bench between
and
degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground.
Lower the kettlebells to your mid chest
Raise the kettlebells (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Curl
steps: Hold the dumbbells with a neutral grip (thumbs facing the ceiling). Seated on an incline bench.
Slowly lift the dumbbell up to chest height.
Return to starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Curtsy Lunge
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Step your left foot behind and to the right of your right foot, crossing it behind your right leg.
Bend your knees and lower your hips down and back, as if you were about to sit in a chair.
Push through your right heel to straighten your right leg and return to the starting position.

name: Plate Situp
steps: Start by lying on your back on a mat with your legs bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a weight plate over your head with both hands, making sure to keep your arms straight.
Engage your core and use your abdominal muscles to sit up, keeping the weight plate towards the ceiling.

name: Cardio Diamond Hop
steps: With both feet, leap forward then back, then to the left, then to the right.
Repeat.

name: TRX Single Arm row
steps: Hold the TRX strap with one hand.
Lean back until the strap is taut. Fully extend your elbow.
Pull your elbow behind the body. Make sure to avoid twisting. Try to keep your shoulders even.

name: Landmine Alternating Lunge To Chest Press
steps: Stand facing the landmine with feet hip-width apart and holding the end of the landmine barbell with both hands, keeping elbows bent and close to your body.
Step backward with the right foot, lunge down, and press the landmine away from your chest.
Push through the left heel to return to the starting position while pulling the landmine back to your chest.
Repeat on the opposite side, alternating for the desired number of reps.

name: Landmine Seated Overhead Press
steps: Sit on the ground facing the landmine with your legs spread. Hold the end of the bar in both hands in front of your chest with your palms facing each other.

While keeping your torso tall and core brace, drive the end of the bar upward until your arms are fully extended. Lean forward slightly for full range of motion in the shoulder joints. Lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps.

name: Plank IYTW
steps: Start in a plank position. Hold one dumbbell.
Raise the dumbbell straight out in front of you (I), at a 45 degree angle (Y), out to the side (T), and then bend at the elbow while raising (W).
Going through IYTW counts as one rep.
Make sure to keep your hips stable. If you're unable to, try performing this exercise from the knees.

name: Plate Pinch Grip Deadlift
steps: Stand facing the plate with your feet shoulder-width apart and the plate positioned between your feet.
Bend down and grasp the plate from the top edges with both hands, making sure your thumbs and fingers are evenly spaced.
Keep your back straight, chest up and core engaged, and stand up with the plate, keeping it close to your body.
Lower the plate back down to the ground, keeping control and maintaining good posture.

name: Cable Seated Bar Face Pull
steps: Sit facing cable machine and grasp bar with shoulder-width overhand grip.
Pull bar toward upper face while driving elbows outward and back.
Squeeze rear delts at the end, then return bar slowly with control.

name: Cable Kneeling Alternating Straight Arm Pull In
steps: Kneel between high cables, holding the handle with your outside arms extended.
Face your palms downward. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage. Alternate sides with each rep.

name: Box Dips
steps: Hold your body with arms locked above the equipment
Lower your body slowly while leaning forward, flare out your elbows
Raise your body above the bars until your arms are locked.

name: Kettlebell Swing
steps: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell between your legs, with your knees slightly bent.
Keeping your back straight, swing the kettlebell upwards until the kettlebell is level with your chest and carefully lower.
Repeat

name: Landmine Lunge To Overhead Press
steps: Stand facing the landmine attachment while holding the end of the bar with one hand at your shoulder on the same side with your elbow tucked to your body underneath your wrist.

Step back with the leg on the same side that you are holding the bar on and with control lower yourself down into a lunge position while keeping your core engaged and torso tall, then drive through your front heel as you step back to the starting position.
Once your feet are back in the starting position, drive the bar up overhead until your arm is fully extended, then lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeated for the desired number of reps, then switch sides.

name: Bosu Ball Pushup
steps: Place hands on Bosu, shoulder-width apart.
Lower chest to the ground, keeping the body straight.
Push back up to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Step Up
steps: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a dumbbell with a goblet grip.
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box.
Step back down with your right foot.

name: Plate Glute Bridge to Chest Press
steps: Lay flat on the ground with a plate on your chest.
Push your hips up toward the ceiling and maintain that extended position.
With your hips up, press the plate toward the ceiling.

name: Band Squat Hold Single Arm Row
steps: Anchor the band to a stable point and take a half squat position.
Hold the band loop in one hand and pull your elbow straight back.

name: Dumbbell Situp
steps: Lay flat on the ground with your spine neutral. Extend you arms so your fists are pointed at the ceiling.
Sit-up by flexing your abs. Continue to reach for the ceiling for the entire rep.

name: Backward Arm Circle
steps: Hold your arms out to your sides.
Rotate your arms backwards in small circles.

name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Lay on a bench with two dumbbells extended in front of you in an overhand grip.
You should have a slight bend in your elbows and maintain that bend. Your shoulder joint should do all the movement.
Bring the dumbbells out to your side. Stop the dumbbells before going behind your body.
Bring the dumbbells back together at the top.

name: Mini-Band Clamshell
steps: Loop band above knees, lie on side knees bent.
Keep feet together, lift top knee upward.
Lower slowly without rotating hips backward.

name: Mini Band Single Leg Raise
steps: Loop band around ankles, stand tall holding support.
Lift one leg forward with straight knee.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Narrow Pulldown
steps: Use the Straight Bar attachment.
Hold the attachment as you sit on the machine and put your legs under the leg pads.
Pull the bar to your clavicle, then raise back up until your arm are extended.

name: Barbell Calf Jump
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Shift your weight onto the balls of your feet and raise stay flat footed. Using your calf muscles, mimic a jumping motion but don't leave the floor.
Explode onto your tip toes and hold for a second.
Bring your heels back to the floor then initiate the next rep.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Lateral Raise
steps: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides with slight bend in elbows.
Raise arm outward until arms are parallel with the ground.
Lower under control, maintaining constant tension on delts.

name: Plate Squat Hold
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, with a weight plate held in both hands at chest height.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight and your weight in your heels.
Go down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, then pause for a moment.
Hold the squat position for the desired amount of time, keeping the weight plate steady and your core engaged.

name: Hundred Straight Legs
steps: Lie supine, legs tabletop or extended, arms reaching long by sides.
Lift head and shoulders, engage core, gaze toward thighs.
Pump arms vigorously, inhaling five counts, exhaling five counts.
Maintain stable torso and strong abdominals for one hundred counts.

name: Bodyweight Spinal Jefferson Curl
steps: Stand tall with arms hanging toward floor and knees slightly bent.
Slowly roll down spine, one vertebra at a time, reaching toward toes.
Reverse the motion, stacking spine back up to standing tall.

name: Ring Skullcrusher
steps: Attach the ring straps to a high point. Stand on your tip toes.
Your arms should be extended in front of you.
Break at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps. Then extend your elbows back to the start.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Incline Bench Press
steps: Lie on an incline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

name: Cable Decline Single Arm Bench Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cable should be set above shoulder height.
Bring one handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Calf Raise
steps: Stand tall with your feet on the ground. You can put the the balls of your feet on top of a plate to extend the range of motion.
Imagine you have a string attached to your heels and pull your heels up toward the ceiling.

name: Ring Rear Delt Fly
steps: Stand facing rings and grab the handles.
Step forward so that your body is in a plank position, with your arms straight and your body in a straight line from your head to your heels.
Keeping your arms straight, slowly lift your arms out to the side, keeping them at the same height as your shoulders. Your body should form a "T" shape.

name: Landmine Goblet Lateral Lunge
steps: Start facing the barbell while holding the end of the bar close to your chest in the goblet position with your elbows tucked in close to your body.

Step directly out to the side with both toes pointing forward. Keep your weight on the heel of the leg you step out with as you sink down over that foot while your other leg remains straight for balance.
Drive through the heel over which you have centered your body as you step back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch Kneeling Lunge 3
steps: Bring yourself to kneeling lunge position. Keep a 90° angle at knees.
Back foot should be elevated (the higher the elevation the more the hip flexor/upper quad will stretch).
Slide the front knee forward while gently leaning back.
Squeeze the glute on the side of the leg that's to the front to avoid lower back complaints.

name: Medicine Ball Hollow Hold
steps: Lie on your back, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Lift your shoulders and legs off the ground, engaging core.
Hold the position while maintaining stability.

name: Tip Toe Walking
steps: Point your toes into the floor.
Slowly walk forwards and backward
Keep your heels in the air as long as possible while walking.
It may be beneficial to do this last at the end of your workout.

name: Kettlebell Chest Press (Single)
steps: Laying on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, hold the kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Fully extend your arms, raising the kettlebell until your elbows are locked.
Lower the kettlebell to the starting position and repeat.

name: Ring Standing Archer Pushup
steps: Position rings shoulder-width apart, grasp handles, extend legs behind.
Lower chest to rings, bend one elbow, while extending your other arm out to the side. Push yourself back to the start.
Then switch arms and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Curl
steps: Grab the dumbbells with a pronated (overhand) grip. You can do this exercise thumbless if it's more comfortable on your wrists.
Flex at the elbows until your biceps touch your forearms. Try not to let your elbows flair outward.

name: Barbell Silverback Shrug
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the Barbell with both hands in front just past shoulder width.
Bend forward at the hips with a slight bend in your knees, keeping your back straight.
Engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together.
Release the shrug.

name: Band Floor Press
steps: Lie on your back holding band loops with elbows resting on the floor.
Press arms straight up until elbows extend without locking.
Lower elbows back to floor under control, keeping tension throughout.

name: Cable Bar Curl
steps: Use a bar attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Dumbbell Seated Full Lateral Raise
steps: Sit tall holding dumbbells at sides with slight bend in elbows.
Raise arms outward until arms go overhead.
Lower under control, maintaining constant tension on delts.

name: Barbell Wrist Extension
steps: Grab a barbell with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across a bench.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.

name: Dumbbell Laying Reverse Fly Internally Rotated
steps: With dumbbells in either hand and an overhand grip, lay on an incline bench that is roughly 15 - 30 degrees high.
With bent elbows, raise your arms up to shoulder level, pausing at the at the end of the motion.
Slowly lower your arms back to starting position.

name: Curve Treadmill
steps: Get the treadmill up to a comfortable speed where you are doing a walk.

name: Band Pushup
steps: Loop the band around your mid-back. The ends of the bands should be around your hands between your thumb and pointer finger.
This exercise can be done from the knees or the toes depending on experience level.
Begin by breaking at the elbows until your upper arm is by your side. Then extend at the elbows back into the top position.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Zottman Curl
steps: Sit tall holding dumbbell at your side with palm facing forward.
Curl dumbbell up, then rotate palm downward at the top.
Lower slowly with palm down, controlling the entire descent.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Skullcrusher
steps: Lie on flat bench holding one dumbbell above shoulder, palm facing in.
Bend elbow to lower dumbbell beside head without moving upper arm.
Extend arm fully, contracting triceps at the top.

name: Cable Supinating Row
steps: Place the cable at shoulder height.
Start with an overhand grip. As you pull your elbow back, rotate your palm until it faces upward.

name: TRX Calf Raise
steps: Hold the TRX straps under your arms and the handles in your armpits.
Lean forward against the straps.
Keep your body straight and initiate the calf raise by raising your heels off the ground.

name: Vertical Leg Press
steps: Lay on the pad and place your feet on the foot plate.
Lift the plate up and disengage the holding hook.
Lower the weight. Stop before your lower back rounds off the pad.
Press the weight back to the starting position.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Step Up Knee Drive
steps: Hold one kettlebell at your side and place opposite foot on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping torso tall and core tight.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

name: Mini Band Scissor Kick
steps: Loop band around ankles, lie on back.
Lift legs slightly off floor, core braced.
Alternate legs in controlled scissor motion.

name: Kettlebell Windmill
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart. Hold the kettlebell in one hand and extend your arm above your head.
Keeping your legs straight and the kettlebell above your head, lower the relaxed arm towards the ground, twisting your body towards the side of the raised arm.
Return to the starting potion, tilt your pelvis forward and repeat.

name: TRX Squat
steps: Hold the two TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point.
Flex at the hips and knees in to a squat position.
You can use your arms and the straps to assist you back into the starting position.

name: Kettlebell Front Rack Curtsy Lunge (Double)
steps: Hold kettlebells in front rack.
Step back and lunge diagonally.

name: Cable Single Arm Pushdown
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way at the top of the machine.
Make sure to keep your upper arm glued at your side. Extend your elbow until you feel your tricep contract.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Hang Clean And Press
steps: Hold kettlebell just above knee with slight bend in hips and knees.
Explosively pull kettlebell to shoulder, catching it in a partial squat.
Stand tall and press kettlebell overhead until arm is fully extended.

name: Hamstring Bridge Isometric Open Angle
steps: Lie on your back with knees slightly bent and heels dug in.
Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back on the ground).
Press the heels into the ground to raise your hips off it.
Hold the position for the specified duration.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Seated Overhead Press
steps: Sit on an upright bench , grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
