Slowly lower the dumbbells to your shoulder joint, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

name: Landmine Curtsy Lunge
steps: Stand facing the barbell while holding the end of the bar at your side with one hand.
With the leg on the same side of your body as the barbell, lunge backward and across your body at a
degree angle while keeping your weight on your front heel to lower your back knee gently to the ground.
Drive through your front heel as you step back to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

name: Half Neck Rolls
steps: Sit cross-legged on the floor and interlace your fingers behind your head.
Drop your chin to your chest and roll your head to the right, bringing your right ear towards your right shoulder.
Slowly roll your head back to center, then over to the left so that your left ear is close to your left shoulder.
Repeat the movement from side to side, keeping your shoulders relaxed and breathing deeply.

name: Barbell Curtsy Lunge
steps: Place the barbell on your back
Step your foot back and around while simultaneously bringing the weight down.
Return to start and repeat on other leg.

name: Band Rear Delt Fly
steps: Start by standing between the two anchored bands with your feet shoulder-width apart and the bands positioned at a high point.
Grasp the ends of each band with your hands, keeping your palms facing each other.

Keeping your arms slightly bent and your back straight, slowly pull the bands away from your body until your arms are extended straight out to the sides. Hold for a second, then slowly release back to the starting position. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Band Tricep Kickback
steps: Anchor the band to a stable point.
Hinge forward. Extend and flex at the elbow.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
steps: Start by standing with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place the dumbbells on the ground between your feet.
From this starting position, bend your knees and lower your body down into a squat.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Machine Sissy Squat
steps: Place the sissy squat pad just behind the knees and the front pad all the way up against your ankles.
Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Sit straight back into a squat. Then push your calves into the back of the pad and extend your knees back to the original position.

name: Mini Band Alternating Bent Arm Lateral Raise
steps: Loop band around elbows, arms bent
degrees at sides.
Raise one elbow outward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly and alternate, keeping tension on band.

name: Bodyweight Alternating Jump Lunge
steps: Start in a standing position.
Lunge forward, switch legs mid-air.
Land and repeat.

name: Soleus Stretch
steps: Stand close to a wall on a narrow, staggered stance (toes of the back leg should be at the same level as the heel of the front leg).
Keep your weight on the back leg as you bend your knees.
Hold the position for the prescribed duration.

name: Bodyweight Russian Twist
steps: Hover your heels just off the ground.
Stick your chest out and maintain a flat back. Make all the movement happen at your mid and upper spine.
Point your chest to the left, then rotate at the spine until your chest is pointed right.

name: Rotator Cuff Mobilisation Lacrosse Ball
steps: Lie on the floor and place a massage ball under your rotator cuff.
Support your elbow with your opposite arm.
Roll into the ball to increase pressure and away from it to reduce.

name: Dumbbell Stability Ball Wall Squat
steps: Place a stability ball against a wall at about hip height.
Hold two dumbbells in each hand.
Break at the hips and knees until you hit parallel or just below, then squat back up.

name: Cardio Jumping Jacks
steps: Stand with feet together, arms at your sides, ready to jump.
Jump while spreading legs and raising arms overhead.
Return to starting position with legs together and arms at your sides. Repeat.

name: Walk Your Downward Dog
steps: Begin in a downward-facing dog position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your feet hip-width apart.
Walk your feet towards your hands, bending your knees as needed to allow your heels to touch the mat.
Press your palms and fingers into the mat and lift your hips up towards the ceiling to deepen the stretch in your hamstrings and calves.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, and then release by slowly walking your hands back out to a downward-facing dog position.

name: Dumbbell Renegade Row
steps: Start by getting into a plank position with a dumbbell in each hand. Your feet should be shoulder-width apart and your hands should be placed on the dumbbells, with your palms facing each other.
From this starting position, row one dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and your core engaged.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position, and repeat on the other side.
Make sure to keep your body straight and your hips level throughout the movement.

name: Machine Underhand Row
steps: Sit on the machine, feet flat, and grab the handles with palms facing up, keeping your back straight.
Pull handles towards your lower abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep elbows close to your body.
Slowly return to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking elbows. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Band High Curl
steps: Anchor a band to a high point.
Start with your feet staggered and your elbows high.
Flex your elbows while keeping your arms high. Curl the band to your forehead.

name: Smith Machine Side Bend
steps: Stand beside the bar.
Keep your hips and shoulders facing forward, bend to one side slowly
Return to the upright position.
Switch hands and repeat.

name: Bodyweight Knee Tricep Extension
steps: Begin in kneeling position. Hands shoulder width apart. Break at the elbows while letting your elbows fall to the floor.
Extend your elbows until you are back in the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Twisting Curl
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring the dumbbells to your sides, with your palms facing inward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders while rotating your wrists so that your palms face your shoulders at the top of the movement.

name: Rotator Cuff External Rotations 2
steps: Stand on one end of a theraband with one foot and hold the loose end with your opposite hand.
Bring your elbow forward by 45° (at shouder) but maintain a 90° angle at elbow
Externally rotate against the resistance.

name: Band Pull Apart
steps: Grab the band with a shoulder width grip. Point your arms straight in front of you.
Retract your shoulder blades and shoulder joint until the band taps your chest.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Clean And Jerk
steps: Hold kettlebell between legs with one hand, hinge slightly at hips.
Pull kettlebell upward to shoulder, catching it in rack position.
Dip at knees, then drive upward to press kettlebell overhead.

name: Mini Band Plank Hand Step Out
steps: Loop band around wrists, hold high plank.
Step one hand outward against band tension.
Return and alternate, keeping hips level.

name: Barbell Jefferson Deadlift
steps: Stand centered over the barbell, feet shoulder-width apart.
Grip the bar with both hands, one in front, one behind.
Lift by driving through your heels, keeping your back straight, then lower slowly.

name: Yogi Arm Clock
steps: Stand facing a wall with your arms extended and your palms pressing into the wall at shoulder height.
Slowly begin to walk your feet away from the wall, keeping your arms straight and your hands pressing into the wall.
Walk until your arms are fully extended and your body is at a 45-degree angle to the ground.
Repeat From High to Low Angles starting above the shoulder, and ending below the chest.

name: Elliptical
steps: Step onto the pedals, grip the handles, and start moving your feet in a natural stride.
Adjust resistance and incline for desired intensity while maintaining a steady, controlled motion.
Keep your posture upright, engage your core, and maintain a consistent pace for an effective workout.

name: Serratus Activation Plank
steps: Support your weight on your forearms and toes (plank).
Allow your upper back to sink in between the shoulder blades.
Push your elbows into the ground and slightly forward, and move the shoulder blades away from the spine.

name: Kettlebell Rear Delt Row (Double)
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, kettlebell in each hand, hinge at hips.
Pull kettlebells while flaring your elbows, squeezing shoulder blades. Keep back flat.

name: Band Straight Leg Hip Flexions
steps: Attach a band to a fixed point.
Wrap the loose end of the band around your ankle.
Face away from the attachment point.
Raise your working leg against the resistance.

name: Cable Rope Lat Prayer
steps: Use a rope attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward. Your ears should be between your arms.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. As you flex at the shoulder joint push your hips forward until your hips meet the attachment.

name: Dumbbell Decline Chest Fly
steps: Lay flat on a decline bench press with the dumbbells pointed toward the ceiling.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbows. Bring the dumbbells out to the side, stopping the dumbbells before they pass your torso.
Bring the dumbbells together to finish the rep.

name: Machine Seated Plate Loaded Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at the bench and rest the back of your arms on the preacher bench.
Grab the handles. Curl the weight up until your elbows are fully flexed.
Lower until the point just before the weight rests at the bottom.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Full Lateral Raise
steps: Sit tall holding one dumbbell at your side with slight bend in elbows.
Raise arm outward until arms go overhead.
Lower under control, maintaining constant tension on delts.

name: Mini Band Overhead Fly
steps: Loop bands around wrists,, arms extended overhead.
Pull arms outward in arc motion.
Return slowly, controlling tension throughout movement.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch Kneeling Lunge 1
steps: Bring yourself to kneeling lunge position. Keep a 90° angle at knees.
Slide the front knee forward while gently leaning back.
Squeeze the glute on the side of the leg that's to the front to avoid lower back complaints.

name: Mini Band Standing Glute Kickback
steps: Loop band around ankles, stand tall holding support.
Extend one leg backward, squeezing glute.
Return slowly without arching lower back.

name: Bodyweight Clapping Push Up
steps: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest, explode up, clap hands.
Land softly, repeat for reps.

name: Band Horizontal Shrug
steps: Anchor the band at shoulder height. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Retract your shoulder blades straight back in schools. Then protract to the starting position.

name: Bodyweight Standing Inverted Row
steps: Grab a door frame or a rack and place your feet near the frame.
Start with your elbows extended, row your body towards your hands.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.

name: Treadmill Sprint
steps: Get the treadmill up to a speed where you are doing a sprint.

name: Dumbbell Curl
steps: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand at arm's length.
Raise one dumbbell and twist your forearm until it is vertical and your palm faces the shoulder.
Lower to original position and repeat with opposite arm.

name: Cable High Single Arm Hammer Bayesian Curl
steps: Stand facing away from high cable, hold handle with palm facing inward.
Step forward to create tension and let arm extend fully behind you.
Curl handle toward shoulder, keeping palm neutral, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Reverse Flat Curl
steps: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips pushed toward the ceiling.
Take an overhand grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Reverse Expansion Bicep Curls Kneeling
steps: Kneel tall, arms long, palms forward.
Set shoulders down, engage core and glutes.
Bend elbows, curling hands toward shoulders without leaning back.
Extend arms slowly, maintaining upright posture and strap tension.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
steps: Take a roughly shoulder width grip. There should be a straight line from your elbow to fist (vertical forearms).
Pull your chin back and press the weight toward the ceiling by extending at the elbow joint and flexing at the shoulder joint.
Press until your elbows are extended and push your head forward slightly.
Return to the start position with control. Pulling your chin back to allow the bar to pass your face safely.

name: Landmine Lunge
steps: Stand in front of the landmine with your feet hip-width apart and your back straight. Grasp the landmine barbell with one hand, holding it at at your side with your palm facing in towards your leg.

Take a step backward with your foot on the same side that you're holding the barbell, lowering your body into a lunge position. Bend both knees to lower your body down until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, or as low as your flexibility allows. Keep your torso upright, your chest lifted, and your core engaged throughout the movement.
Push through the heel of your front foot to return to the starting position. Repeat for desired number of reps before switching sides.

name: Bodyweight Plank Jack
steps: Start in a plank position, hands under shoulders, body straight.
Jump feet wide, then back together, like a jumping jack.
Keep core tight, maintain plank form, repeat for desired time or reps.

name: Bow Pose
steps: Lie on your stomach with your arms at your sides.
Bend your knees and bring your heels towards your buttocks.
Reach back with your hands and grab your ankles.
Inhale and lift your chest off the ground, pulling your legs up and back with your hands.
Keep your gaze forward and hold the pose for a few breaths before releasing back to the ground.

name: Front Rowing Preps Straight Forward Seated
steps: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps at chest height.
Start with elbows extended, hands close to ribs, shoulders relaxed.
Extend arms straight forward, maintaining upright posture and core engagement.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Skullcrusher
steps: Set bench to incline and hold dumbbell above chest with palmsfacing in.
Bend elbow to lower dumbbell toward forehead under control.
Extend arm fully, squeezing tricep at the top.

name: Floor Incline Leg Raise
steps: Sit on the floor and lean back into your palms or on your elbows.
Raise a straight leg a few centimeters off the ground and hold the position for the specified duration.

name: Weighted Hand Plank
steps: Start in a kneeling position with your hands planted on the ground.
Place a weight plate on your back or have a friend do it for you.
Pick your knees up off the ground. Hold in this position with a flat back.

name: Plate Superman Hold
steps: Hold a plate in both hands.
Pull your arms and legs off the ground while and hold that position.

name: Cable Standing Alternating Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Stand between cables with arms extended outward and palms facing downward.
Sweep one handle across your chest while maintaining a slight elbow bend.
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.

name: Kettlebell Walking Farmers March
steps: Standing straight with kettlebells, start walking towards a set point. Pulling your knee up toward the ceiling.
Make sure to keep your chest tall and shoulder blades pulled back.
Try to keep your stride distance roughly the same.

name: Barbell Single Leg Deadlift
steps: Start by pushing your hips straight back and extending your non-working leg behind you. It is ok to touch your other foot back to the ground each rep.
Leave your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstring. When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Pause Squat
steps: Place two dumbbells on your shoulders and make sure you force your elbows upward.
Push your hips back and break at the knees.
When you reach parallel (hamstrings parallel with the ground) pause for 1-3 seconds. Then push through your heels back to the starting position.

name: Traps Stretch Variation Two
steps: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart.
Keeping your chest facing forward, turn your head
degrees to the left. Then return to centre point.
Repeat, turning your head in the other direction.

name: Barbell Floor Press
steps: Un-rack the bar and break at the elbows and shoulders.
Bring your elbows to the floor, rest for a second to remove all the momentum from the rep, then press to a lockout.

name: Leg Lowers
steps: Lie on your back. Raise your legs but bend your knees
Keep a 90° angle at hips and knees. Lower your toes to the ground without bending your knees
Make sure you maintain a flat lower back against the ground throughout the movement.

name: L Sit Pull Up
steps: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended. Pull your legs up until you're in an "L" position.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back to starting position.

name: Kettlebell Front Rack Deficit Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, kettlebells in front rack position, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start.

name: Dumbbell Standing Bayesian Lateral Raise
steps: Stand tall on lean slightly forward.
Lateral raise your arms straight out to the side until your arms are about parallel with the ground.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Pendlay Row
steps: Stand with feet hip-width, hinge forward until torso is nearly parallel to floor.
Grab dumbbell from floor with straight arm, keeping back flat and core braced.
Pull elbow straight up to ribs, then lower dumbbell fully back to the floor each rep.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Front Military Press
steps: Adjust seat to a comfortable height.
Load the pegs with an appropriate amount of weight.
Press the weight until your elbows are nearly extended, then lower the weight until just before the weight comes back to a rest.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Arnold Press
steps: Start by sitting on an incline bench and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder, with your palm facing you and your elbow bent.
From this starting position, extend your arm upwards so that the dumbbell is directly above your head.
As you extend your arm, rotate your palm to face away from your body.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Kneeling Hamstring Curl
steps: Lay down on the machine, placing your working leg beneath the padded lever. Position your leg so that the padded lever is below your calve muscle.
Support yourself by grabbing the side handles of the machine, and slowly raise the weight with your legs.
Pause at the apex of the motion, then slowly return to starting position.

name: Kettlebell Tate Press
steps: Lie flat on your back. Keeping your arm straight, hold the kettlebell above your chest with your palm facing away from your body.
Bend your arm, touching the kettlebell to the top of the shoulder opposite to the arm being worked.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Bodyweight Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge
steps: Start by lying on your back with your knees bent and feet in a staggered position on the box.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips off the floor, making sure to keep your feet and knees pointing forward.

name: Landmine Calf Raise
steps: Stand facing the barbell, holding the end of the barbell close to your chest in both hands with your elbows tucked in to your sides.
Drive though the balls of your feet to raise your heels off the ground, squeezing your calves, with a focus on making sure your ankles do not turn out or in.
Lower your heels back down to the ground and repeat for the desired number of reps.

name: Dumbbell Incline Chest Flys
steps: Lay flat on the bench and place your feet on the ground.
Begin the exercise with the dumbbells held together above your chest, elbows slightly bent.
Simultaneously lower the weights to either side.
Pause when the weights are parallel to the bench, then raise your arms to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Decline Skullcrusher
steps: Start by lying on a decline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the dumbbells above your chest with your arms extended and your palms facing each other. This is the starting position.
Slowly lower the dumbbells towards your forehead by bending your elbows. Keep your upper arms stationary and only move your forearms.
Once the dumbbells are close to your forehead, reverse the motion by extending your elbows and returning to the starting position.

name: Arms Pulling Straps Plow Prone On The Box
steps: Lie prone on the box, chest just off edge, arms holding straps overhead.
Start with arms long, palms down, shoulders depressed and neck neutral.
Pull arms down toward hips, squeezing lats while keeping torso stable.
Return slowly to start, maintaining control and continuous tension on straps.

name: Kettlebell Standing Tricep Extension
steps: Stand with legs shoulder width apart.
Hold the kettlebell in both hands behind your head.
Straighten arms bringing kettlebell above your head.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Chest Press
steps: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

name: Trap Bar Romanian Deadlift
steps: Hold trap bar, stand tall with slight knee bend.
Hinge hips back, lowering bar along thighs.
Keep back neutral and tension in hamstrings.
Drive hips forward to return upright.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Lateral Raise
steps: Sit tall with one dumbbell at your side, palm facing inward.
Lift arm outward until shoulder height, keeping elbow slightly bent.
Lower smoothly and repeat, keeping torso still.

name: Shoulders Stretch Variation Three
steps: Place the top of your hand into the small of your back, your arm at a
degree angle.
Hold your elbow with the other arm, and slowly pull the arm forward until you feel your shoulder engaged in the stretch. Pause at the apex of the stretch and return to the starting position.
Return to starting position, and repeat with your other arm.

name: Curtsy Lunge
steps: Step your left foot diagonally behind your right leg, crossing it behind your body. Bend your knees and lower your hips until your left thigh is parallel to the floor and your right knee is hovering just above the ground.
Push through your right foot to straighten your legs and return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your other leg.

name: Dumbbell Incline Twisting Curl
steps: Sit on incline bench holding dumbbells at sides, palms facing inward.
Curl one dumbbell while twisting palm toward shoulder.
Lower slowly, then repeat with opposite arm.

name: Landmine Hollow Hold
steps: Start by lying flat on your back with your legs extended towards the landmine attachment and your arms overhead, holding the landmine barbell with both hands while engaging your core muscles by pressing your lower back into the ground and drawing your belly button in towards your spine.
Lift your legs off the ground, keeping them together and straight, and simultaneously raise your upper body off the ground, reaching the landmine barbell away from your face.
Hold this position for the desired duration, then carefully lower the barbell to the ground.

name: Cable Single Leg Deadlift
steps: Start with a straight bar or easy bar attachment. Squat the weight up into a standing position and walk a few steps back.
Push your butt back to initiate the movement while lifting one of your legs. Then push your butt forward until you're back in a standing position.
Compete your given amount of reps, then switch to opposite leg.
To protect yourself from injury, always maintain a flat back.

name: Glutes Stretch Variation Three
steps: Lay flat and bring your left leg to
degrees.
Hold your left leg with both hands and slowly rotate your hips to the right hand side.
Hold at the peak of the stretch, then slowly return to starting position.
Switch sides and repeat.

name: Band Hip Abduction
steps: Attach the band around your ankle. Stand with feet hip-width apart, feet facing forward, and hands on hips.
Lift your right leg away from your body to the side, keeping your knee straight. This is your starting position.

Maintaining proper form, move your right leg as far to the side as you can, keeping your left leg planted firmly on the ground. Hold for a second and then return your right leg to the starting position.

name: Core Stability 5 Crosslateral Limb Raise Into Knee Elbow Tuck Push Up Position
steps: Bring yourself to a strict push-up position
Raise opposite limbs till they are parallel to the ground
Hold for a split second and then try to bring your elbow to your opposite knee by driving both towards the centre of the body.
Spine might curve slightly but you should not shift your hips during the movement.

name: Barbell Pause Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell resting on your upper back.
Lower your body into a squat position, pausing for a moment at the bottom of the movement before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Incline Chest Press
steps: Sit on incline bench holding kettlebell at shoulder with elbow bent.
Press kettlebell upward and slightly inward until arm fully extends.
Lower slowly to starting position, keeping torso stable and controlled.

name: Kettlebell Silverback Shrug (Single)
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Holding the kettlebell in both hands engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together. Release the shrug.

name: Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise
steps: Start by sitting on a bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand placed on each leg.
From this starting position, raise your heels as high as you can by pushing up through your toes.
Slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Spider Curl
steps: Lay on an incline or preacher curl bench.
Let your arms hang freely off the edge of the bench.
Fully flex your elbow and fully extend your elbow on each rep.

name: Pyramid Pose
steps: Begin in Tadasana (Mountain Pose).
Step your left foot back about 3-4 feet and place your heel down, keeping your toes pointing forward.
Inhale and lengthen your spine, then exhale and fold forward from your hips, bringing your hands to the floor on either side of your right foot.
Hold for several breaths, then switch sides and repeat.

name: Trap Bar Split Squat
steps: Take a large step forward with one leg, and lower your body until your back knee nearly touches the ground. Your front knee should be bent at a 90-degree angle, and your back leg should be straight.
Push through the heel of your front foot to raise your body back to the starting position.

name: Leg Raised Push Up
steps: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight, raise one leg off the ground, and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.

name: Machine Leg Extension
steps: Sit on the machine with your back against the cushion and adjust the machine you are using so that your knees are at a
degree angle at the starting position.
Raise the weight by extending your knees outward, then lower your leg to the starting position. Both movements should be done in a slow, controlled motion.

name: Hamstrings Stretch Variation Four
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs out in front of you.
Reach forward to try and touch your toes. Reach as far forward as you can go.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then return to starting position.

name: Machine Glute Kickback
steps: Grab the handles, place one knee on the pad, and the foot of the working leg on the foot plate.
Push your working leg back until you feel your glute contract, then return to the starting position without resting the weights.

name: Band Pallof Press To Wood Chopper
steps: Stand sideways to band, hold handle at chest, and brace your core.
Press arms straight forward, resisting rotation.
Rotate torso and pull band across body in a wood chopper motion, then return.

name: Chair Pose
steps: Stand straight with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Inhale and raise your arms straight up over your head.
Exhale and bend your knees, lowering your hips as if you were sitting in a chair.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, then inhale and stand up straight.

name: Rotator Cuff External Rotations 3
steps: Abduct your arm at 90° (raise your arm to the side).
Keep a 90° angle at elbow, forearm parallel to the ground.
Externally rotate against resistance.

name: Glutes Stretch Variation Two
steps: Sit on the ground and lay one leg flat and the other over the top.
Hold your leg with the same side arm and slowly rotate your hips and back.
Hold at the peak of the stretch, then slowly return to starting position.
Switch sides and repeat.

name: Traps Stretch Variation Three
steps: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart.
Nod your head forward, bringing your chin to your chest.
You will feel the stretch across your neck.

name: Smith Machine Underhand Row
steps: Begin by standing in front of a bar with your feet about hip-width apart.
Bend at the hips and knees to grab the bar with a supinated (underhand) grip, positioning the bar about an inch away from your shins.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, use your back muscles to lift the bar straight up towards your chest.
As the bar reaches your chest, pause briefly, and then lower the bar back to the starting position.

name: Cable Archer Row
steps: Place the cable at shoulder height.
On the same side as the working arm, step back and rotate outwards.
Pull your elbow back while flaring your elbow out.

name: Pyramid Prayer
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place your hands on a table, chair, or any elevated surface in front of you.
Walk your feet back until your torso is parallel to the ground, and your elbows are resting on the surface.
Relax your head and neck, and breathe deeply.
Hold for a few breaths, then release.

name: Mini Band Clamshell Raise
steps: Loop band above knees, lie on side knees bent.
Keep feet together, lift top knee upward, push bottom knee into ground, and push your hips forward.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Deficit Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, dumbbell in a goblet position, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start.

name: Gate Pose Variation Arm Extended on Side
steps: Start on your knees and extend your right leg out to the side.
Raise your right arm above your head and reach towards the left side of the room.
Gently bend your body to the left side and rest your left hand on your left thigh.
Look up towards your right hand and hold the pose for a few breaths before switching sides.

name: Cable Kneeling High To Low Wood Chopper
steps: Kneel sideways to cable and grasp handle with both hands overhead.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally down toward opposite hip.
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.

name: Kettlebell Walkover Pushup
steps: Starting in a press up position with feet wide and one hand resting on the kettlebell, complete a full press up, lowering your chest towards the ground while keeping your body straight and returning to the starting position.
Swap hands on the kettlebell, placing the hand originally on the kettlebell underneath your shoulder, complete another press up.
Repeat.

name: Cable Lat Prayer
steps: You can use any attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward. Your ears should be between your arms.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. As you flex at the shoulder joint push your hips forward until your hips meet the attachment.

name: Crescent Moon Pose Quad Stretch
steps: Begin in Crescent Moon Pose with your right foot forward and a block nearby.
Place the block at the highest height under your left hand.
Reach your left arm behind you and take hold of your left foot or ankle.

Gently pull your foot towards your buttocks while pressing your left hand into the block to deepen the stretch in your left quad. Hold for a few breaths before releasing and repeating on the other side.

name: Pull Ups
steps: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Step Up Knee Drive
steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides and place one foot firmly on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping torso tall and balanced.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

name: Barbell Sumo Deadlift
steps: Stance width can vary with a sumo DL. Some prefer toes near the plates. Others prefer a more narrow stance to get more drive off the floor.
Make sure your arms are inside your legs. The bar should be just over your mid-foot. Flatten your back and push your heels into the floor.
Try to extend your knees and hips simultaneously.

name: Seated Radial Nerve Tensioner
steps: Bend your elbow bringing your thumb to the centre of your chest.
Extend your elbow to the side with the palm facing back, and wrist flexed
As your extending the arm, lean your head towards the opposite shoulder
Once you reach maximum tension (without pain) hold the position

name: Ring Standing Roll Out
steps: Grasp the rings, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your abs engaged, roll forward onto your toes, and extend your arms in front of you.
Slowly lower your body down toward the ground, keeping your arms straight and your abs engaged.
When your head gets between your arms, pause for a moment and then use your abs to pull your body back up to the starting position.

name: Barbell Snatch Grip High Pull
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, gripping the barbell with a wide (snatch-width) grip. Keep your back straight, chest up, and bar close to your body.
Drive through your legs, extending your hips, knees, and ankles while pulling the barbell up explosively.
Shrug your shoulders forcefully and pull the bar as high as possible, keeping elbows above the bar.
Lower the bar back to the starting position in a controlled manner and reset for the next rep.

name: Cable Twisting Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Start with a neutral grip. Flex at the elbow. While flexing twist your palm. When you hit the top of the movement your palm should be facing upward.

name: Standing Shoulder Abduction
steps: Stand up straight holding a dowel. The stretching arms palm should face forward
Push the dowel to the side with the opposite arm.
This in turn will raise the stretching arm over the head.

name: Jump Squats
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Start by doing a regular squat, then engage your core and jump up explosively.
When you land, lower your body back into the squat position.

name: Band Row
steps: Stand on your band with both feet.
Hinge forward at the hips while keeping a flat back.
Let your arms hang freely, then pull your elbows straight back toward the ceiling.

name: TRX Hammer Curl
steps: Grab the TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point.
Maintain a neutral grip. Flex your elbows and pull your fists to either sides of your temples.

name: Medicine Ball Rainbow Slam
steps: Lift medicine ball overhead.
Slam ball down to one side.
Catch and repeat slam to the other side.

name: Barbell Side Step Up
steps: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with a barbell on your shoulders. Your feet should be slightly pointed outward, and your shoulders should be down and relaxed.
Place a step or box beside you, and step up onto it with one foot. Your other foot should remain on the ground.
Push off your grounded foot, raising your body up onto the step.
Step back down with the same foot, returning to the starting position.

name: Half Lotus
steps: Sit on a yoga mat with legs straight in front of you.
Bend the right knee and place the right foot on top of the left thigh. Allow the right knee to fall towards the floor.
Bring the left foot onto the right thigh. Keep the spine straight and rest hands on the knees.
Hold for several breaths and then release.

name: Barbell Larsen Bench Press
steps: Start in a bench press position with your legs elevated. Try to keep your knees with a slight bend in them.
Unrack the bar then initiate the rep.
Bring the bar to your torso and tap your ribcage before pressing back to the ceiling.

name: Cable Quadruped Hip Abduction
steps: Use an ankle attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the bottom.
Take a quadruped position with the cable going across your planted leg.
Abduct at the hips and raise your leg out to the side.
Return to the starting position and stop just short of the cables touching back down (to keep tension on the muscle).

name: Cable Braced Wrist Extension
steps: Stand facing cable, brace forearm on support with palm down holding handle.
Lower wrist slowly to feel stretch in top of forearm.
Extend wrist upward, contracting forearm extensors fully.

name: Smith Machine Assisted Pullup
steps: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended. Leave your feet on the floor.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar. Use your legs top assist you up.
Lower your body back to starting position.

name: Landmine Kneeling Alternating Overhead Press
steps: Start in a kneeling position facing the barbell with one hand holding the end of the barbell at your shoulder with your elbow tucked beneath your wrist.
Keeping your elbow pointing forward, drive the barbell up overhead until your arm is fully extended and switch the bar to your other hand at the top of the movement.
Control the descent of the bar to your other shoulder and repeat movement for desired reps, switching hands at the top of each rep.

name: Medicine Ball Chest Press Partner Toss
steps: Stand tall, partner tosses medicine ball to chest.
Catch ball and press it back to partner. Repeat.

name: Cable Hamstring Curl
steps: Use an ankle attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Stand upright or try bending slightly forward.
Flex at the knee and pull your ankle straight back.

name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Single Arm Floor Fly
steps: Lie on your back holding one dumbbell above chest with palm turned downward.
Lower arm out wide while keeping internal rotation and slight elbow bend.
Bring dumbbell back over chest, squeezing pec at the top.

name: Dumbbell Kickstand Squat
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, one foot slightly behind. Hold dumbbell in a goblet position.
Lower into a squat, keeping weight on front heel.
Return to standing, engaging glutes and core.

name: Bodyweight Swingthrough Lunge
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width.
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Step back with the same leg until the back knee taps the floor.

name: Mini Band Bent Over Row
steps: Stand on band, hinge forward with flat back.
Lower under control, maintaining core tension.

name: Barbell Heels Up Back Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your heels on a plate or low step.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position.

name: Stability Ball V Up Pass
steps: Lie on your back, holding a stability ball between your feet, arms extended overhead.
Engage your core, lift your legs and arms, passing the ball from feet to hands.
Lower arms and legs back down, then repeat, passing the ball back to feet.

name: Ez Bar Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Be careful getting the bar into place overhead. Push your elbows forward while keeping your elbows tucked in.
Look for what feels like a stretch in your triceps. Extend your elbows until your fists are pointed at the ceiling.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Push Press
steps: Hold kettlebell at shoulder height, feet shoulder-width apart.
Dip slightly at knees, then drive upward, pressing kettlebell overhead.
Lock out arm briefly, then lower kettlebell under control.

name: Barbell Guillotine High Incline Bench Press
steps: Set bench to high incline and grip bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower bar slowly toward upper chest or neck with elbows flared.
Press bar upward until arms fully extend without locking elbows.

name: Kettlebell Spinal Jefferson Curl
steps: Stand tall holding kettlebells in front with feet hip-width apart.
Slowly roll down through spine one vertebra at a time, reaching toward toes.
Reverse the motion, rolling up through spine until standing tall again.

name: Cardio Shuttle Sprint
steps: Set up two cones at a specified distance.
Stay low and sprint quickly to the second cone.
Hinge forward and tap the cone, then turn and sprint to the original cone.
Repeat for the desired time or reps.

name: Dumbbell Floor Fly
steps: Lie on your back holding dumbbells above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower arms out wide until elbows lightly touch the floor.
Bring dumbbells back together over chest, squeezing pecs at the top.

name: Bosu Ball Burpee
steps: Stand on Bosu with feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop into squat position and place hands on Bosu.
Jump feet back into plank, perform a pushup, then jump back to squat.

name: Bodyweight Alternating Reverse Lunges
steps: Stand with feet together.
Step back with right foot.
Return to starting position, then lunge with left foot.

name: Kettlebell Concentration Curl
steps: Sitting on a chair with your legs apart, rest your arm against your thigh and hold the kettlebell with your arm extended towards the floor.
Bending your arm at the elbow, lift the kettlebell until your palm faces your shoulder.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Hammer Incline Curl
steps: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor.
Take a neutral grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Downward Dog With Fingers Facing Feet
steps: Begin in the same starting position as the previous exercise, with your hands and knees on the ground.
Spread your fingers wide and turn your hands so that your fingers are facing towards your feet.
Tuck your toes under and lift your knees off the ground, straightening your legs as much as possible.
Press your hips up and back, bringing your body into an inverted "V" shape.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulder blades spread apart, and try to press your heels down towards the ground.
Hold the pose for several breaths, then release and return to your starting position.

name: Pyramid Pose Calf Blocks
steps: Start standing with a flat and vertical block on the matt
Bend forward, placing hand on vertical block, and front of foot on the flat block.
Press the bottom of your foot towards the ground, and repeat on each side.

name: TRX Rear Delt Fly
steps: Stand facing away from the TRX straps and grab the handles with both hands.
Step forward so that your body is in a plank position, with your arms straight and your body in a straight line from your head to your heels.
Keeping your arms straight, slowly lift your arms out to the side, keeping them at the same height as your shoulders. Your body should form a "T" shape.

name: Bodyweight Alternating Forward Lunge
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position. Then switch legs.

name: Kettlebell Row (Single)
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

name: Back Rowing Preps Roll Down With Bicep Curl Seated
steps: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps, elbows straight.
Roll spine down sequentially while bending elbows into a bicep curl.
Pause briefly, keeping shoulders relaxed and core engaged.
Reverse the roll up, extending arms forward with controlled tension.

name: Single Arm Overhead Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in your right hand, extending it overhead.
Inhale and begin to squat down, keeping the dumbbell overhead and your back straight.
Go down as far as you can while still maintaining control, then exhale and return to standing position, keeping the dumbbell overhead. Repeat for desired reps and then switch to the other arm.

name: Pushup to Renegade Row
steps: Start in a high plank position with a pair of dumbbells positioned under your shoulders. Your hands should grip the dumbbells, palms facing each other.
Keep your core engaged and your back straight as you row one dumbbell up towards your hip, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position and repeat on the other side.

name: Kettlebell Alternating Reverse Lunge
steps: Hold two kettlebells by your side.
Take a big step backwards with your left leg, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground and your right knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push back up and switch legs, alternating each rep.

name: Kettlebell Reverse Curl
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hold kettlebell with palms facing down.
Lift kettlebell toward shoulders, squeezing biceps, then lower with control.

name: Bosu Ball Forearm Plank
steps: Place forearms on Bosu, elbows under shoulders.
Extend legs, keeping body straight.
Hold the plank position, engaging core.

name: Puppy Pose
steps: Begin in a tabletop position with your hands and knees on the ground.
Walk your hands forward as you lower your chest towards the ground.
Keep your hips over your knees and extend your arms out in front of you.
Hold for a few breaths and then release.

name: Landmine Single Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Setup a landmine with your back on a box.
Lay the end of the bar over your hip.
Push your hips toward the ceiling until you feel a contraction, then bring your hips back toward the floor.

name: Band Hip Adduction
steps: Attach a band to a stable anchor point, such as a door handle or post.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your ankles.
Keeping your feet together, move your legs out to the sides and then back to the midline of your body. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Machine Neutral Row
steps: Sit on the machine, feet flat, and grab the handles with palms facing each other, keeping your back straight.
Pull handles towards your lower abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep elbows close to your body.
Slowly return to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking elbows. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Dumbbell Suitcase Crunch
steps: Lay flat on the ground with a dumbbell. Point the soles of your shoes at the ceiling as well as the dumbbell.
Reach for your feet with the dumbbell before bringing your spine back to the floor.

name: Barbell Figure Four Hip Thrust
steps: Put your shoulder blades on a bench and cross one leg over the other.
Start with your hips up.
Drop your hips and then push your hips up toward the ceiling.

name: Cable Standing Decline Chest Press
steps: Stand facing away from high cables with handles beside your chest.
Press both handles forward and downward until your arms are extended.
Squeeze your chest, then return the handles under control.

name: Smith Machine Leg Press
steps: Place your legs on the bar with your feet at shoulder width.
Release the weight and extend your legs fully, without locking your knees.
Lower the weight until your legs are at a 90° angle (but DO NOT allow your butt and lower back to rise off of the floor. This will put your lower back in a rounded position, which is very dangerous.)
Raise the weight back to starting position.

name: Machine Chest Supported T Bar Row
steps: Lay on the chest pad and grab the handles. Lift the bar out of the holding hook.
Pull the bar to your chest and then fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep.

name: Band Kneeling Pulldown
steps: Kneel facing anchor with band overhead and arms extended.
Pull elbows down toward ribs while keeping chest tall.
Squeeze lats at the bottom, then return slowly to full stretch.

name: Band Bayesian Curl
steps: Attach band to a low anchor point. Point your palms straight forward.
Flex your elbow until you feel your biceps contract. Then fully extend elbows.

name: Dumbbell Hollow Hold
steps: Lay flat on the ground with a dumbbell overhead.
Pull your upper back and legs off the ground. Make a banana shape with your body.
The dumbbell should be held in your hands and your ears should be between your biceps.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Row Knee
steps: Start by placing your elbow on one knee.
Hold a dumbbell in your other hand, with your palm facing inwards towards your body.
From this starting position, row the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and your core engaged.

name: Dumbbell Curl
steps: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand at arm's length.
Raise one dumbbell and twist your forearm until it is vertical and your palm faces the shoulder.
Lower to original position and repeat with opposite arm

name: Plate Squat Reach
steps: Stand holding a weight plate at chest height with both hands.
Lower into a squat, extending the plate in front of you at chest height
As you stand back up, pull the plate back into your chest.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Rear Delt Fly
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Bring one arm behind you and rest this arm on your back. With the other arm, hold the kettlebell at arms length close to the floor.
Swing the kettlebell out and up towards the side of your body and then return to centre. Repeat.

name: Lord Of The Dance
steps: Begin by standing tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Shift your weight onto your left foot and bring your right heel towards your glute.
Reach your right arm back and grab onto the inside of your right foot or ankle.
Inhale and lift your right foot away from your glute while extending your left arm forward. Hold for 5-10 breaths before switching sides.

name: Plate Good Morning Anterior
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, the plate held in front of you, and the knees slightly bent.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping the back straight, until the torso is parallel to the floor.
Push through the hips to return to the starting position.

name: Side Lunges
steps: Take a slow, lateral step to the right.
Extend the left knee, and drive your weight into your right side.
Flex your knee and lower your body.
Push back to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Alternating Overhead Press
steps: Start with two dumbbells near your shoulders with a neutral grip.
Press one of the dumbbells toward the ceiling while keeping the other in position.
Let the first dumbbell return to its starting position before pressing the other.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Tricep Guilotine Press
steps: Lie on bench holding dumbbell above upper chest with palm facing in.
Lower dumbbell toward neck or upper chest by bending elbow forward.
Extend arm fully, squeezing triceps at the top while keeping shoulder stable.

name: Dumbbell Staggered Waiters Bow
steps: Set up a bar at mid way up your quad. Place the working leg against the bar.
Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.

name: Barbell Step Up
steps: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a barbell across your upper back and shoulders, using an overhand grip.
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box.
Step back down with your right foot.

name: Barbell Quad Stomp
steps: Have the barbell in a high bar position and place your foot on a plate or a low box.
Put all of your weight on your front foot and lean forward.
Lower until your calves touch your hamstrings and then extend back up.

name: Mini Band Side To Side
steps: Loop band above knees, slight athletic stance.
Step laterally, keeping knees pushed outward.
Continue stepping side to side under control.

name: Plow Back Rowing Preps
steps: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps forward.
Begin with arms long, shoulders relaxed and chest open.
Pull arms down and back in a plow motion, engaging lats.
Return to start with control, maintaining upright posture and tension.

name: Landmine Thruster
steps: Hold the bar with a goblet position.
Push your hips back and sink into a squat.
Push through your heels and squat back up. Use the momentum you generate at the legs to push the bar over head.
Let the bar return to the goblet position before starting the next rep.

name: Smith Machine Drag Curl
steps: Grab the bar with an underhand grip.
Pull your elbows straight back and let the bar drag against your upper body (or very close to it).

name: Dumbbell Seated Curl
steps: Sit tall holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing forward.
Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders, keeping elbows tight to torso.
Squeeze biceps, then lower slowly to full extension.

name: Cable Rope Upright Row
steps: Use a rope attachment with the cable set to the bottom of the machine.
Pull your elbows straight up toward the ceiling until the attachment is just below your chin then extend until your elbows are fully extended.

name: Barbell Front Squat Bodybuilding
steps: Measure your shoulders against the bar to make sure you're even. Throw your shoulders under the bar. The bar should be digging into your neck slightly.
Make sure to push your elbows up to the ceiling for the entire rep. To make sure you don't get too pitched forward.
Use the squat stance you would use for a back or goblet squat. Push your hips back to initiate the squat. Break at the knees until you hit parallel depth.
Squat back up to a standing position.

name: Barbell Block Conventional Deadlift
steps: Stand with your mid-foot under the bar, plates should be on blocks, and grip the bar with your hands, about a shoulder width apart.
Bend your knees, then lift the bar by straightening your back. It is important to keep your back straight.
Stand to your full height and hold.
Lower the bar to the floor by bending your knees and keeping your back straight.

name: Band Face Pull
steps: Anchor the band at eye level. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Use an overhand grip with both hands. Pull the band to the bridge of your nose flaring your elbows out.

name: Dumbbell Superman
steps: Lay flat on the ground on your stomach with your arms extended overhead. Hold a dumbbell with a neutral grip.
Lift your legs and chest off the ground simultaneously and hold for a 1 count at the top.
Relax your lower back and lower your legs and chest back to the floor.

name: Landmine Rotational Lift To Press
steps: Stand perpendicularly to the barbell with the end of the bar in front of your feet. Squat down and hold the end of the bar with your hand closer to the landmine attachment with your palm facing your body.

Drive your feet into the ground to start the motion. As your legs fully extend, pull the bar upwards with your hand and start to rotate your torso in towards the landmine attachment. As you do so, bring your other hand up to the bar and switch your grip. Press through the bar to extend your arm all the way upright, pivoting your back foot to allow for more trunk rotation.
Perform the movement in reverse to return to the starting position. Repeat for desired number of reps before switching sides.

name: Bosu Ball Forearm Sideplank
steps: Lie on one side, forearm on Bosu, elbow under shoulder.
Lift hips to create a side plank.
Hold the side plank position, then switch sides.

name: Barbell Long Landmine Row
steps: Position a barbell in a landmine or corner of a room and stand facing it with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the end of the barbell with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower your torso until it is almost parallel to the ground.
Pull the barbell towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together as you row the weight up.

name: TRX Curtsy Lunge
steps: Stand facing away from the anchor point, holding onto the TRX handles with both hands.
Step your left foot behind your right, crossing it behind your right leg, and lower yourself into a curtsy lunge.
Push through your right foot to return to the starting position and repeat the movement with the other leg.

name: Machine Hip Abduction
steps: Adjust machine settings to fit your height. Sit with back flat against pad, legs together.
Slowly press legs apart against resistance. Pause at peak.
Slowly return legs to starting position. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Dumbbell Incline Reverse Curl
steps: Lay on an incline bench.
Grab the dumbbells with a pronated (overhand) grip. You can do this exercise thumbless if it's more comfortable on your wrists.
Flex at the elbows until your biceps touch your forearms. Try not to let your elbows flair outward.

name: Bodyweight Pulse Squat
steps: Hold a dumbbell in goblet position.
Squat down to parallel depth and then halfway back up.
Stay in this short range of motion for the duration of the set.

name: Chin Ups
steps: Grab the bar shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you)
With your body hanging and arms fully extended, pull yourself up until your chin is past the bar.
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.

name: Plate Overhead Squat
steps: Hold a weight plate at arm's length overhead, with your arms fully extended. The plate should be directly above your head and your elbows should be locked.
Begin to bend your knees, lowering your body as far as you can while keeping the weight plate overhead. Make sure to keep your back straight and your chest lifted.
Once your thighs are parallel to the ground or as low as you can go, pause for a moment.
Push through your heels to return to a standing position, keeping the weight plate overhead the entire time.

name: TRX Split Squat
steps: Hold the two TRX straps and step away until the straps are taut. Take a split stance.
Bring your back knee to the floor and gently tap the floor.
Use your arms and the TRX to help assist you getting back into the starting position.

name: Eagle Arms Chin Into Chest
steps: Sit cross-legged on the floor and bring your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Cross your right arm over your left, bending both elbows so that your forearms are parallel to the floor.
Lift your elbows towards the ceiling and bring your hands together, then drop your chin towards your chest.
Hold for a few breaths, then release your arms and repeat on the other side.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Pendlay Row
steps: Stand with feet hip-width, hinge forward until torso is nearly parallel to floor.
Pick kettlebell from ground with straight arm, keeping back flat and core braced.
Pull elbow straight up to ribs, then lower kettlebell fully back to floor each rep.

name: Warrior Two
steps: Start in mountain pose, standing with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Step your left foot back about 3-4 feet and turn it slightly inward, while keeping your right foot facing forward.
Inhale and raise your arms to shoulder height, parallel to the ground, with your palms facing down.
Exhale and bend your right knee, bringing it directly over your ankle while keeping your left leg straight.
Look over your right hand and hold the pose for a few breaths, then inhale and return to mountain pose. Repeat on the other side.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Hammer Curl
steps: Sit tall holding one dumbbell at your side with palm facing inward.
Curl dumbbell toward shoulder while keeping elbow tight to your torso.
Squeeze bicep, then lower slowly to full extension.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder External Rotation
steps: Sit on a bench with one foot on the bench.
Place the elbow on the inside of your elbow and use it for leverage.
Point your fist toward the wall andthen toward the ceiling. Rotating a total of 90 degrees.

name: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Curl
steps: Hold the dumbbells with a neutral grip (thumbs facing the ceiling). Seated on an incline bench.
Slowly lift the dumbbell up to chest height
Return to starting position and repeat.

name: Barbell Pronated Row
steps: Grab the barbell with an overhand grip. Hinge forward while keeping your back flat until your torso is about parallel with the ground.
Let your arms hang freely.
Pull the bar to your torso while tucking your elbows in slightly.
Extend your elbows fully before initiating the next rep.

name: Barbell Banded Split Squat
steps: Loop band under front foot and around barbell resting on your upper back.
Lower back knee toward the floor while keeping front knee over ankle.
Push through front heel and drive up to starting position under control.

name: Reverse Prayer
steps: Start seated or standing with your arms at your sides.
Bring your hands behind your back and interlace your fingers with your palms facing up.
Inhale and draw your shoulder blades together, lifting your chest.
Exhale and gently press your hands down towards the floor as you continue to lift your chest.

name: Cable Single Arm Underhand Grip Row
steps: Place the cable at shoulder height. Use a handle attachment. Face your palm upward.
Pull the handle back using your arms. Push out your chest.
Pull the handle towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.

name: Quads Stretch Variation Four
steps: Lay flat on your belly. Extend one arm out in front of you, placing your palm on the floor. With your other arm, grab the top of your foot.
Keeping your upper leg flat on the floor, pull your foot towards your buttocks to engage the stretch.
Pause for a few seconds, and then repeat the stretch with your other leg.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Shoulder Extension
steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides with straight arms and palms neutral.
Move arm backward until you feel lats and rear delts engage.
Lower slowly to starting position under full control.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
steps: Stand up straight with dumbbells at either side, palms facing your hips.
Raise your arms on either side with a slight bend in your elbow until they are parallel with the floor. Pause at the top of the motion.
Slowly return your arms down to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Heels Up Goblet Squat
steps: Take a half kneeling stance. The dumbbell should start over your knee that is up.
Rotate at the spine and point the dumbbell to the opposing side.

name: Dumbbell Box Squat
steps: Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart with a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Lower your body into a squat position, sitting back onto the box and pausing for a moment before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.

name: Oblique Jackknife
steps: Lie on your side, legs straight, hand behind head.
Lift both legs and upper body simultaneously.
Squeeze obliques, then lower back down. Repeat on both sides.

name: Bosu Ball Row
steps: Hold bosu and hinge forward.
Pull bosu towards chest, squeezing shoulder blades.

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at preacher bench, hold dumbbells in each hand with arm extended, palm facing up.
Curl dumbbells towards shoulder, keeping upper arm stationary and elbows in.
Lower dumbbell slowly back to start.

name: Band Wood Chopper
steps: Anchor band at shoulder height. Stand sideways, feet shoulder-width, slight knee bend.
Grip band with both hands, arms extended.
Pull across body, rotating torso.

name: Diamond Push Ups
steps: Position your index fingers and thumbs so they are touching, forming a diamond shape
Use a standard push up position
Lower your chest towards your hands, keep your elbows close to your body
Stop just before your chest touches the floor, then push back up to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Weighted Dip
steps: Use a dip belt to attach a dumbbell to yourself. Grip bars with arms straight, shoulders above hands. Keep legs straight or bent.
Lower slowly until elbows are at
degrees.
Push back up to start position, extending arms fully.

name: Kettlebell Shoulder Extension
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart bending forward at the hips as far as comfortable. Place off-hand on the same side thigh for stability.
Hold the kettlebell in one hand, straight armed and pointing towards the floor.
Keeping your arm straight, swing the kettlebell behind you as far as comfortable.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: TRX Reverse Curl
steps: Stand facing the TRX straps and grasp the handles with both hands, palms facing away from your body.
Walk back until the straps are taut, keeping your arms straight.
Slowly curl your hands towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body.

name: Easy Pose Neck Stretch
steps: Begin by sitting cross-legged on the floor.
Slowly drop your chin towards your chest, feeling a stretch in the back of your neck.
Inhale and lift your head up, then exhale and drop your right ear towards your right shoulder.
Hold for a few breaths, then switch sides and repeat the stretch.

name: Dumbbell Bayesian Lateral Raise
steps: Lay on an incline bench and let your arms freely.
Lateral raise your arms straight out to the side until your arms are about parallel with the ground.

name: Weighted Forearm Plank
steps: Get into a kneeling position with both forearms pressed into the ground.
Place a weight plate on your back (or have a partner do it for you).
Hold the plank for the allotted amount of time.

name: Cable Bilateral Cross Skullcrusher
steps: Standing between crossed cables, holding opposite handles above your shoulders.
Extend your elbows fully, keeping your upper arms stationary.

name: Kettlebell Staggered Deadlift (Single)
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, shifting one foot behind you. Hold the kettlebell in both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees and keep your back straight.
Return to the upright position and repeat.

name: Medicine Ball Single Leg Deadlift
steps: Hold medicine ball while standing on one leg.
Hinge forward on one leg, extending other leg behind.
Return to starting position. Repeat on other leg.

name: Dumbbell Service Exercise
steps: Stand up straight and hold a dumbbell in one arm. Perform a bicep curl across your body
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder and rotate palm and elbow out.
Point the elbow towards the ceiling while the dumbbell remains just over the shoulder.
Extend your elbow to raise the dumbbell over your head. Start lowering your arm to your side as you turn the palm to face down

name: Cable Standing Glute Kickback
steps: Use an ankle attachment. The cable should be set to the bottom of the crossover machine.
Break at the knee, push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

name: Cable Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Lie on a bench, holding cables at shoulder height with palms facing your feet.
Sweep both handles together above your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause briefly, then lower your arms under control.

name: Dumbbell Zottman Curl
steps: Hold dumbbells at sides, palms facing forward, elbows tight to body.
Curl both dumbbells up, then rotate palms downward at the top.
Lower slowly with palms facing the floor, controlling the descent.

name: Barbell Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge
steps: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a box, the barbell placed over your hips. Place one foot about 6-9 inches in front of the other.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the box.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Seated Tibialis Raise
steps: Sit on a box or bench, place your heels on a step or plate.
Raise your toes straight toward the ceiling.

name: Rower Knee Tuck
steps: Place your feet on the rower seat and get in to a hand plank position.
Pull your knees to your chest and flex your abs.

name: Dumbbell Standing Tibialis Raise
steps: Place your heels on a step or plate, and hold dumbbells to your side.
Raise your toes straight toward the ceiling.
Hold at the top for extra benefit. Slowly return to the starting position.

name: Supine Twist Lying
steps: Lie down on your back with your arms stretched out to your sides.
Bend your right knee and bring it towards your chest.
Slowly twist your body to the left side, bringing your right knee across your body towards the ground on the left side.
Look towards your right hand and hold the pose for a few breaths before switching sides.

name: Jump Rope
steps: Hold handles, elbows close, and jump with both feet together.
Rotate wrists to swing the rope over your head.
Jump as it reaches your feet, keeping a steady rhythm.

name: Barbell Single Leg Heels Elevated Hip Thrust
steps: Start by lying on a bench with your foot on a plate or low box and a barbell on your hips.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Barbell Wrist Curl
steps: Grab a straight bar with a supinated (underhand) grip.
Kneel down next to a flat bench and place your forearms on the bench with your wrists just off the bench.
Let the barbell pull down on your wrists until they are extended.
Curl the barbell until your wrists are fully flexed.
Lower in a controlled manner and repeat.

name: Barbell Decline Bench Press
steps: Lay flat on a decline bench with your feet in the pads. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

name: Barbell Reverse Lunge
steps: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with a barbell on your shoulders. Your feet should be slightly pointed outward, and your shoulders should be down and relaxed.
Step backward with one foot, lowering your body until your front thigh is parallel to the ground and your back knee is hovering just above the ground.
Push off your back foot, returning to the starting position.

name: Shoulders Stretch Variation Two
steps: Start with your arms at either side. Begin by pushing your shoulders forward and in towards your chest.
Continue the circular motion with your shoulders, pinching up towards your ears, and then extending your chest outwards while you finish the motion.
Repeat as necessary.

name: Cable Kneeling Alternating Pull In
steps: Kneel in between high cables, holding the handles.
Face forward with palms facing upward.
Pull your elbow in toward your rib cage, extend your elbow, then pull with the other arm.

name: Treadmill Side Shuffle
steps: Face sideways on the treadmill.
Take a quarter squat position with a wide stance.
Shuffle sideways for a specified amount of time, then switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Good Morning
steps: Hold the dumbbell in a goblet position. With your elbows directly under your fists.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees MOSTLY extended. You should feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Dumbbell Spinal Jefferson Curl
steps: Stand tall holding dumbbells in front of thighs with straight arms.
Slowly roll down through spine, reaching dumbbells toward feet.
Reverse motion, rolling back up one vertebra at a time.

name: Dumbbell Elevated Pushup
steps: Start by placing two dumbbells on the floor, about shoulder-width apart.
Position yourself in a plank position with your hands on top of the dumbbells, keeping your arms straight.
Keep your feet together, with your toes resting on the floor.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the floor by bending your arms, until your chest nearly touches the dumbbells.
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms and engaging your chest, triceps and shoulders.

name: Barbell High Incline Bench Press
steps: Position the bench between
and
degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

name: Stability Ball Hamstring Curl
steps: Lie on your back, heels on a stability ball, arms flat, and core engaged.
Lift hips, curl the ball toward you using your hamstrings, keeping control and balance.
Extend legs back to start while keeping hips lifted, then repeat for desired reps.

name: Band Standing Chest Press
steps: Loop the band around your back. The two end loops in each of your hands.
Extend your shoulder joint and elbow across your body until your arm is fully extended.

name: Kettlebell Row
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hold a kettlebell in each hand.
Hinge at hips, keep back straight, and pull both kettlebells to hips.

name: Cable Standing Alternating Incline Chest Fly
steps: Stand between low cables with your arms extended outward.
Sweep one handle upward and across your chest with a slightly bent elbow.
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.

name: Midback Series 2
steps: Novice
Sit or lie supported, spine long, arms positioned in a t-pose.
Initiate movement by drawing shoulder blades together and down.
Move arms down to your sides, keeping neck relaxed and ribs down.
Maintain control throughout, emphasizing mid-back engagement over arm dominance.

name: Cable High Bayesian Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set to about elbow height.
Face away from the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Bodyweight Single Leg Squat
steps: Stand on one leg, extend the other forward for balance.
Lower into a squat, keeping your chest up and core tight.
Press through your heel to stand back up, repeat.

name: Abdominals Stretch Variation One
steps: Lay on your stomach on the floor with your forearms flat on the ground.
Extend your elbows and push your upper body upwards.
Push your upper body upwards until you feel a stretch in your abs, then return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Hip Thrust
steps: Sitting on the floor with your knees bent and feet planted firmly on the floor, lean your back against the bench.
Resting the kettlebell on your pelvis, raise your pelvis until your stomach, pelvis and thighs are in line.
Slowly lower until you are in the starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Swing
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in both hands.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips to swing the dumbbell between your legs.
From this starting position, explosively extend your hips and swing the dumbbell up to chest height.
Allow the momentum of the swing to carry the dumbbell back down between your legs, and then repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Y Press
steps: Stand tall, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Press the dumbbells outward into a y shape.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Floor Fly
steps: Lie on your back holding one kettlebell above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower arm out wide until elbow lightly touches the floor.
Bring kettlebell back over chest, squeezing pec at the top.

name: Barbell Behind The Neck Press
steps: Grip bar slightly wider than shoulders and rest it across upper traps.
Brace core, press bar upward until arms are fully extended overhead.
Lower bar slowly behind head under control and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Tibialis Raise
steps: Sit on a bench with a kettlebell draped over your mid-foot.
Let the kettlebell pull your foot downward.
Raise your foot straight up and squeeze the front shin.

name: Landmine Oblique Twist
steps: Stand facing the landmine, with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Grasp the landmine barbell with both hands, interlacing your fingers and holding it at chest height. Position your arms straight out in front of you, parallel to the floor, with your elbows slightly bent.

While keeping your core engaged, rotate your torso and the landmine to one side. Twist through your waist, using your oblique muscles to generate the movement. Pivot on the ball of your opposite foot as you rotate away from it.
Rotate back to the starting position, then perform the same movement in the opposite direction.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

name: Gastrocnemius Stretch Push Up Position
steps: Get yourself in the pushup position.
Straighten your knees and try to push one heel down towards the ground.
Cross your other leg over the top to apply extra pressure to the stretch.

name: Chest Stretch Variation One
steps: Using a raised wall, place your arm at a
degree angle against it.
With a staggered stance, lean into the wall extending your chest.
Pause for a few seconds and then return to starting position and repeat on opposite side.

name: Band Shrug
steps: Place the band under your feet. Stand upright.
