Elevate your shoulder blades and then depress back to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Romanian Deadlift
steps: Place one knee on a bench and hold a dumbbell.
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Cable Standing Svend Press
steps: Stand facing away from low cables, pressing both handles together at your chest.
Extend your arms forward while continuously squeezing the handles together.
Pause briefly, then return the handles toward your chest.

name: Calf Raise 3A Soleus Bias Bilateral
steps: From the standing position, bend your knees till you get to a squated or semi-squated position
Maintain the squat while raising both heels off the ground
Hold the position for a split second before lowering your heels again
Do not rest at the bottom. As soon as you feel your heels touch the ground, repeat the movement

name: Eccentric Dragonflag
steps: Perform a reverse crunch and then kick your legs up toward the ceiling.
With your hips and knees extended, lower yourself slowly back to the start position.

name: Bodyweight Explosive Push Up
steps: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest, explode up.
Land softly, repeat for reps.

name: Traps mid back Stretch Variation Two
steps: Sit on the ground and lay one leg flat and the other over the top.
Hold your leg with the same side arm and slowly rotate your hips and back.
Hold at the peak of the stretch, then slowly return to starting position.
Switch sides and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Alternating Single Arm Thruster
steps: Hold two kettlebells at shoulder height, palms facing inward.
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing both kettlebells overhead.
Lower kettlebells as you descend again, alternating arms each rep.

name: Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise
steps: Sitting comfortably on a chair with your core stomach muscles engaged, place your feet on the floor.
Place the kettlebell on your legs, just above the knees and raise your heels upwards off the floor.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Bodyweight Curtsy Deficit Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

name: Smith Machine Situp
steps: Set up the Smith machine bar at an appropriate height.
Lie on your back beneath the bar, gripping it with your hands.
Engage your core, lift your upper body toward the bar, and exhale.
Lower your upper body back down in a controlled manner, inhaling.

name: Forearm Plank
steps: Place forearms on the ground with your elbows bent at a 90° angle aligned beneath your shoulders, with your arms parallel at shoulder-width.
Your feet should be together, with only your toes touching the floor.
Lift your belly off the floor and form a straight line from your heels to the crown of your head and hold.

name: Barbell J M Press
steps: Lie flat on bench and grip bar slightly narrower than shoulder-width.
Lower bar toward upper chest by bending elbows forward, not flaring out.
Extend elbows to press bar back to starting position above chest.

name: Smith Machine Narrow Stance Squat
steps: Place the bar on top of your traps. Take a narrow stance.
Push your hips back and break at the knees. Push your elbows forward to keep yourself from getting pitched too far forward.
Aim to get your hamstrings to parallel with the floor.
Push your heels into the floor and squat back to a standing position.

name: Barbell Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell at your shoulders with an overhand grip.
Step out to the side with your right foot and bend your right knee to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the opposite side by stepping out with your left foot.

name: Band Single Arm Bent Over Row
steps: Stand on band and hinge at hips, holding handle with arm extended.
Pull elbow toward your hip, keeping back flat and shoulders square.
Squeeze back at the top, then lower slowly to full stretch.

name: Band Seated Pulldown
steps: Sit facing anchor with band overhead and arms extended.
Pull elbows down toward ribs while keeping chest lifted.
Squeeze lats at the bottom, then return slowly to full stretch.

name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Single Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Lay sideways on an incline bench and press the elbow of the working arm into the bench.
Use your free arm to pull your upper body into the bench.
Break at the elbow until your elbow is fully flexed, then extend your elbow until the dumbbell is pointed at the ceiling.

name: Banded Side Walks
steps: Place a band either just below or above your knees.
Get into a quarter squat position.
Step side to side without letting there be any slack in the band to keep tension on the band.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Crunch
steps: Place your feet under the foot pads and grab the handles with your hands.
Flex your spine and bring your upper and lower body together.

name: Barbell Reverse Curl
steps: Take a double overhand grip that's about shoulder width. Flex your elbows while keeping your elbows tucked in. Try not to let them flare out.
Curl until your forearm presses into your bicep. Then fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep.

name: Landmine Staggered Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand in a staggered position. With the back leg bent and the front mostly extended.
Push your hips back until you feel a stretch through your front hamstring.
Push your hips back forward until you are standing.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Row
steps: Hinge forward at the hips while maintaining a flat back. Try to get your torso as close to parallel with the ground as your mobility will allow for.
Let your arms hang in front of you. Pull your elbows back towards the ceiling while flaring your elbows outward.

name: Kettlebell Rear Delt Row
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your upper chest and then lower the kettlebell- repeat.

name: TRX Oblique Crunch
steps: Place your feet in the TRX stirrups and get in to a hand plank position.
Pull both knees to your right elbow.
Extend your legs back to the starting position, then pull both knees to the left elbow.

name: Restful Cow Face Pose Legs
steps: Start in a seated position with your legs extended in front of you.
Cross your right leg over your left leg, placing your right foot on the floor beside your left hip.
Cross your left leg over your right leg, placing your left foot on the floor beside your right hip.
Relax your arms by your sides or place them on your abdomen and take deep breaths.

name: Band Spanish Squat
steps: Anchor a band to a stable point.
Place the loops of the band behind your knees.
Perform a normal squat and extend your knees against the band at the top.

name: Ez Bar Shrug
steps: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with a barbell in front of you.
Bend down and grab the bar with an overhand grip, your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your shoulders down as you grip the bar.
Stand up straight, lifting the bar off the ground and pulling it toward your hips. Keep your elbows close to your body and your shoulders down as you do this.
Once the bar is at your hips, raise your shoulders as high as you can, holding the position for a moment.

name: Switch Jump Mountain Climber
steps: Start in a plank position with hands under shoulders.
Jump one foot forward, switch legs mid-air.
Alternate legs quickly, maintaining a steady plank.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Alternating Curtsy Lunge
steps: Hold a dumbbell at your chest, feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally back into a lunge.
Alternate legs, keeping your chest up and core engaged.

name: Standing Forward Bend
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward at your hips, reaching your hands towards the ground.
Allow your head to hang heavy and feel a stretch in the back of your legs.
Hold for a few breaths and then slowly roll up to a standing position.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Take a shoulder width, double overhand or mixed grip.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Đẩy tạ đòn trên ghế phẳng
steps: Nằm thẳng trên ghế tập, hai chân đặt trên mặt đất. Duỗi thẳng tay và nhấc tạ ra khỏi giá đỡ.
Hạ thanh tạ xuống ngang ngực.
Nâng thanh tạ lên cho đến khi khuỷu tay của bạn duỗi thẳng hoàn toàn.

name: Barbell Feet Elevated Glute Bridge
steps: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a box, the barbell placed over your hips.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the box.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Bodyweight Tricep Extension
steps: Begin in a plank position. Hands shoulder width apart. Break at the elbows while letting your elbows fall to the floor.
Extend your elbows until you are back in the starting position.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Farmers Walk
steps: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, walk for a specified distance or duration.
Stay upright and don't lean to one side.

name: Cable Rope Pushdown
steps: The cable should be set all the way at the top of the machine.
Make sure to keep your upper arm glued at your side. Extend your elbows until you feel your triceps contract.

name: Downward Dog
steps: Begin on your hands and knees with your hands shoulder-width apart and your knees hip-width apart.
Spread your fingers wide and press down into your palms, making sure that your fingers are evenly spaced and facing forward.
Tuck your toes under and lift your knees off the ground, straightening your legs as much as possible.
Press your hips up and back, bringing your body into an inverted "V" shape.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulder blades spread apart, and try to press your heels down towards the ground.
Hold the pose for several breaths, then release and return to your starting position.

name: Kettlebell Step Up Double
steps: Standing up straight, using a bench as a step, raise one foot onto the bench and hold the kettlebell in the same arm as the straight leg.
Stand and bring both feet onto the bench. Slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat.

name: extended-side-angle-pose
steps: Begin in a lunge position with your right foot forward and your left foot back.
Place your right hand on a block or the ground on the outside of your right foot.
Reach your left arm overhead and then round your spine, bringing your left hand to your right ear.
Look down towards your right foot as you reach your left arm towards the front of the room, feeling a stretch in your side body. Hold for a few breaths and then switch sides.

name: Bodyweight Alternating Curtsy Lunge
steps: Place the barbell on your back
Step your foot back and around while simultaneously bringing the weight down.
Return to start and repeat on other leg.

name: Calf Raises
steps: Balance on the balls of your feet on the platform or plates, leaning forward to use the wall to assist with balance.
Lower the heels of your feet towards the ground and pause, then push through the balls of your feet like you are standing tip toe, pausing at the apex of the motion.
Repeat as necessary.

name: Barbell Supinated Row
steps: Begin by standing in front of a barbell with your feet about hip-width apart.
Bend at the hips and knees to grab the barbell with a supinated (underhand) grip, positioning the barbell about an inch away from your shins.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, use your back muscles to lift the barbell straight up towards your chest.
As the barbell reaches your chest, pause briefly, and then lower the barbell back to the starting position.

name: Smith Machine Single Leg Hip Thrust
steps: Start by lying on a bench with your foot on the ground and a barbell on your hips.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Plate Good Morning
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, the plate held behind the neck and the knees slightly bent.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping the back straight, until the torso is parallel to the floor.
Push through the hips to return to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Deficit Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, dumbbells in both hands, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

name: Kettlebell Alternating Lateral Lunge
steps: Hold one kettlebell with one or both hands, feet hip-width apart.
Step out to one side, bending the knee.
Push off, return to center, then switch sides.

name: Crunches
steps: Lay flat on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the ground, about a foot from your lower back.
Place your fingertips on your temples with your palms facing out.
Draw your belly into the base of your spine to engage the muscles, then raise your head and shoulders off the floor. Return to starting position and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Calf Raise
steps: Standing straight with a kettlebell in each hand, raise your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Band Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Start with both feet hip-width apart and step on the middle of the band with both feet. Hold the handles of the band in each hand and position the band above your chest, with your palms facing down.

Keeping your elbows slightly bent, slowly raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel with the floor. Make sure to internally rotate your shoulder joints by bringing your shoulder blades together and rotating your forearms inward towards your torso.
Hold the position for a few seconds and then slowly lower your arms back to the starting position, keeping the internal rotation of your shoulder joints throughout the movement.

name: Dumbbell Waiters Bow
steps: Place a barbell at about midway up your thigh. Press your quads into the barbell.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Front Rowing Preps Offering Seated
steps: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps, elbows bent by sides.
Palms face up, forearms parallel, shoulders relaxed and chest open.
Extend arms forward as if offering, maintaining upright posture.
Bend elbows to return, keeping tension and controlled movement.

name: Bosu Ball Curl
steps: Hold the bosu vertically.
Flex your elbows curling the bosu toward your chin.

name: Dead Hang
steps: Grip a pull-up bar with palms facing forward.
Hang with arms fully extended.
Hold for recommended amount of time, keeping your core engaged.

name: Mini Band Clock Tap
steps: Loop band around ankles, stand tall on one leg.
Tap opposite foot forward, side, then back.
Maintain balance and hip stability throughout movement.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Calf Raise
steps: Standing straight with a kettlebell in a goblet position, raise your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Laying Bent Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
Raise both knees towards your chest.
Lower back down without touching the floor; repeat for desired reps.

name: Cable External Rotation
steps: Hold the cable handle in one hand, elbow bent at
degrees going across your torso.
Rotate your arm outward, keeping your elbow stable.

name: Stability Ball Knee Tuck
steps: Start in a plank position with your feet on a stability ball and hands on the floor.
Engage your core and tuck your knees toward your chest, rolling the ball forward carefully.
Extend your legs back to the starting position, maintaining balance and control throughout the movement.

name: Cardio In In Out Out Shuffle
steps: Start with your feet side by side.
Bring one foot laterally, then the other.
Return the first foot to its starting position, then the other.

name: Cable Single Arm Reverse Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards. Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Bodyweight Stability Ball Hyperextension
steps: Lie face-down on a stability ball, hips centered, feet anchored, hands behind your head.
Engage your core, lift your upper body until aligned with legs, keeping your neck neutral.
Lower your torso slowly back to the starting position, maintaining control and steady breathing.

name: Chest Stretch Variation Two
steps: Lay on your side with one hand just in front of you.
With a slight bend in your arm, rotate your arm around your body as slowly as possible.
Return to the starting position and then repeat on the other side.

name: Barbell Deficit Conventional Deadlift
steps: Stand with your mid-foot under the bar, feet should be on a plate or elevated platform, and grip the bar with your hands, about a shoulder width apart.
Bend your knees, then lift the bar by straightening your back. It is important to keep your back straight.
Stand to your full height and hold.
Lower the bar to the floor by bending your knees and keeping your back straight.

name: Cable Straight Arm Pull In
steps: Use a handle attachment set all the way to the top of the cable crossover machine.
Walk a few steps away from the cable machine. Face your body sideways.
Face your palm forward. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage.

name: Dumbbell Incline Curl
steps: Hold the dumbbells with an underhand grip. Seated on an incline bench.
Slowly lift the dumbbell up to chest height
Return to starting position and repeat.

name: Plate Deadlift
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, the plate in front of the feet, and the knees slightly bent.
Bend the hips and knees to grip the plate with palms facing the body.
Keeping the back straight, stand up while lifting the plate off the ground.
Return the plate back to the starting position by bending the hips and knees, keeping control of the plate.

name: Side Plank Reach Through
steps: Begin in an elbow side plank position.
Reach for the ceiling with your off hand.
Rotate at the mid and upper spine and reach through the open space between the floor and your torso.
Reach backwards, and then rotate back into the starting position.

name: Barbell Banded Front Squat
steps: Loop bands under your feet and around the anchors, bar resting on front delts.
Keep chest tall, brace core, and lower until thighs reach parallel.
Drive through midfoot, extend hips and knees, and return to standing upright.

name: Barbell Z Press
steps: Begin by sitting on the ground with your legs extended and a barbell in your hands, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, lift the barbell up from your chest and press it straight up above your head.
Lower the barbell back down to your chest.

name: Bicycle Crunch
steps: Lie on your back.
Bend knees, hands behind head.
Twist torso, touch elbow to opposite knee. Repeat.

name: Band Single Arm Pulldown
steps: Anchor the band to a high point. Go into a seated position.
Grab the loop of the band and pull your upper arm to your side.

name: Mini Band Kneeling Row
steps: Anchor band around foot, kneel tall holding ends.
Row elbow back, squeezing shoulder blades together.
Return slowly, maintaining upright torso.

name: Stability Ball Pike
steps: Place your feet on the ball and get in to a plank position.
Pull your hips straight up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips until you're back in a plank position.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Seated Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Sit tall holding dumbbell overhead with one hand, arm fully extended.
Lower dumbbell behind head by bending elbow slowly.
Extend arm back up, squeezing triceps at the top.

name: Box Jump
steps: Stand in front of a box.
*Start with a low box if this is your first time*
Sink into a quarter of half squat and then pop your hips forward.
Try to land in the middle of the box as softly as possible to minimise impact on your joints.

name: Oblique Crunch
steps: Lie on your side, knees bent, hands behind head.
Bring your elbow towards your knees and flex your obliques.

name: Cable Decline Chest Fly
steps: Place the cable anchor at a higher level than your shoulders.
Sit on the bench, leave your elbows mostly extended.
Bring your fists together and flex your pecs.

name: Band Squat
steps: Stand with a shoulder width grip. Both feet should be on the band with the band loops in each of your hand.
Push your butt back and also break at the knees.
Try to hit parallel depth (bottom of your leg should be parallel with the ground). If you can't tell your squat depth, then try squatting in front of a mirror and watch your form.

name: Kettlebell Forward Lunge (Double)
steps: Hold kettlebell at your side.
Step forward, lunge, and return.
Repeat with opposite leg.

name: Calves Stretch Variation Three
steps: Balance the balls of your feet on the platform, leaning forward to use the wall to assist with balance. Engage your calves so that your feet are flat before beginning the stretch.
Lower the heels of your feet towards the ground and pause, then push through the balls of your feet like you are standing tip toe, pausing at the apex of the stretch.
Repeat as necessary.

name: Side Lying External Rotator Cuff Stretch
steps: Lie on your side with the under arm outstretched in front of you.
Pull your shoulder back to stabilise the scapula.
Bend your elbow at 90° or more.
Use your top arm to press the palm of the under arm out.

name: Bosu Ball Up And Over
steps: Stand next to Bosu, step up and over it.
Repeat, moving laterally side to side.
Keep a steady pace, engaging core muscles.

name: Bodyweight Alternating Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart.
Step right, lunge to side.
Return, then lunge left.

name: Kettlebell Thruster
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a kettlebell in each hand.
Bring the kettlebells to your shoulders, with your palms facing inward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, dip your knees slightly and then quickly extend them as you press the kettlebells upwards.
As you press the kettlebells upwards, also push your hips forward to help generate additional power.
Slowly lower the kettlebells back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Plate Overhead Walking Lunge
steps: Stand tall with a plate overhead.
Step with one foot forward bringing your back knee to the floor. Gently tap your knee then drive through your front leg.
Go back to a standing position and then step forward with the opposing legs.

name: Swing To Upright Row
steps: Start with a kettlebell between your legs, hinge at hips, swing it upward.
Lift kettlebell to chest level, elbows high, engaging shoulders.
Lower kettlebell back down, maintaining control. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Ez Bar Zercher Squat
steps: Begin by standing with your feet about hip-width apart and holding the bar in the crook of your arms, near your belly. Your palms should be facing towards your body.
Sit back and lower your body down until your thighs are parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Push through your heels to extend your hips and stand back up to the starting position.

name: Midback Series 1
steps: Novice
Lie supported, spine long, arms straight up toward ceiling.
Initiate movement by drawing shoulder blades together and down.
Move arms down towards your side, keeping neck relaxed and ribs down.
Maintain control throughout, emphasizing mid-back engagement over arm dominance.

name: Cable Standing Leg Extension
steps: Stand upright facing away from the cable crossover with the cable set to the height of your hips. Use an ankle/wrist attachment.
Extend at the knee against the cable.

name: Bosu Ball Hand Plank
steps: Place hands on Bosu, shoulder-width apart.
Extend legs, keeping body straight.
Hold the plank position, engaging core.

name: Cable Standing Alternating Internally Rotated Incline Chest Fly
steps: Stand between low cables with arms extended and palms facing downward.
Sweep one handle upward and across your chest with a slightly bent elbow.
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Rear Delt Fly
steps: With dumbbells in either hand, bend your knees with your feet slightly bowed out. Arch your back above your knees, and start with the weights touching in front of your chest.
With bent elbows, raise your arms up to shoulder level, pausing at the at the end of the motion.
Slowly lower your arms back to starting position.

name: Cable Rope Kneeling Crunch
steps: Use a rope attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Walk a few steps forward then fall into a kneeling position.
Push your hips back and flex your abs, then push hips forward until in the starting position.

name: Cable Leaning Single Arm Skullover
steps: Stand in front of cable stack facing away to and lean torso slightly forward, holding handle overhead.
Break at the elbow until your forearm touch your bicep, then flex at the shoulder joint bringing your upper arm to the side of your head.
Bring your elbow back forward, then extend your elbows.

name: Cable Single Leg Laying Leg Curl
steps: Bring a bench over to the cable stack, put the cable all the way at the bottom. Use an ankle attachment.
Lay on the bench.
Flex at the knee and pull your ankle straight back.

name: Hamstrings Stretch Variation Three
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg outstretched and the other bent at the knee, foot resting on the opposite inner thigh.
Reach forward to touch the toes of the outstretched leg.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then return to starting position.

name: Machine Seated Calf Raises
steps: Get comfortable on the machine, then place your lower thighs beneath the padded lever. Place your toes and the balls of your feet onto the foot supports.
Prevent the weight from slipping forward by gripping the handles, and release the safety bar. Lower the weight until your calves are extended.
Push your heels up to lift the padded lever and hold the contracted position, then slowly lower back down to the starting position. Repeat.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Arnold Press
steps: Start in a standing position

name: Star Prep
steps: Kneel sideways, one hand on bar, feet staggered.
Push knees outward and raise off hand until at shoulder height.

name: Band Glute Kickback
steps: Get into a quadruped position. Loop the band around both of your wrists and one of your feet.
Extend your knee and hip straight back until you feel like contraction in the glutes.
Flex at the knee until back in the starting position.

name: Cable Braced Single Arm Chest Press
steps: Stand sideways to cable, hinge forward, and grab something for stability.
Press across the body going just short of extending your elbow.

name: Dumbbell Neutral High Incline Bench Press
steps: Set bench to high incline and hold dumbbells with neutral grip at shoulders.
Press dumbbells upward until arms extend without locking elbows.
Lower slowly to shoulder level and repeat.

name: Machine Hip And Glute Abduction
steps: Stand on the platform and set the pad just over the opposing hip of the working leg.
Place the working leg over the pad.
Press your leg outward. Aim to get the longest range of motion possible.

name: Kettlebell Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Be careful getting the KB into place overhead. Push your elbows forward while keeping your elbows tucked in.
Look for what feels like a stretch in your triceps. Extend your elbows until your fists are pointed at the ceiling.

name: Triceps Stretch Variation Three
steps: Bend your left arm so your hand is at your shoulder, and hold your elbow with the opposite hand.
Gently push on your elbow so it is raised by your head.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then repeat with the other arm.

name: Glutes Stretch Variation One
steps: On your front, place one leg forward and then stretch out the same side arm across the mat/floor.
Fully extend your leg and arm.
Hold at the peak of the stretch, then slowly return to starting position.
Switch sides and repeat.

name: Wall Angels
steps: Stand against a wall with your back flat, arms at 90° by your sides.
Slowly raise arms overhead, keeping elbows and wrists in contact with the wall.
Lower arms back down to starting position, maintaining constant wall contact throughout.

name: Mini Band Around The World Plank
steps: Loop band around wrists, hold high plank position.
Move one hand forward, outward, then back in circular pattern.
Alternate sides, keeping hips level and core braced.

name: Serratus Activation Cross Punch
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell over your shoulder with a straight arm.
Form the sign of the cross adding a protraction (punch) on every end of the cross, including the middle position.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up
steps: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a kettlebell at one shoulder.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.

name: Medicine Ball Partner Situp Toss
steps: Lie facing partner, knees bent.
Sit up, toss medicine ball to partner.
Catch and lower down. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Shoulder External Rotation Deceleration
steps: Lie on a bench facing down.
Bring your arm parallel to the ground and bent at the elbow, while holding a weighted ball.
Externally rotate your shoulder letting go of the ball.
Grab the ball before it falls to the ground.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Single Arm Deadlift
steps: Start by standing on one leg with a dumbbell in one hand.
Slowly bend at the hips and lower the dumbbell towards the ground while extending your free leg behind you.
Keep your core engaged and your back straight as you lower the weight.
Once the dumbbell is close to the ground, push through your heel to return to the starting position.

name: Medicine Ball Russian Twist
steps: Sit with knees bent, feet off ground.
Twist torso side to side, touching medicine ball to ground.

name: Mini Band Glute Bridge
steps: Loop band above knees, lie on back knees bent.
Drive through heels, lift hips until fully extended.
Lower slowly, keeping knees pressed outward.

name: Dumbbell Spider Curl
steps: Start by placing your forearms on a flat bench and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
From this starting position, curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body and your core engaged.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Curtsy Deficit Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, dumbbells in front rack, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

name: TRX Hamstring Curl
steps: Start by facing the TRX straps and positioning yourself in a push-up position with your hands on the ground and your feet in the TRX foot cradles.
Keeping your core engaged and body in a straight line, bend your knees and bring your heels towards your glutes.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.

name: Bosu Ball Squat
steps: Stand on Bosu, feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, keeping knees aligned with toes.
Push through heels to stand back up.

name: Medicine Ball Halo
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hold a medicine ball.
Circle the ball around your head, maintaining control.
Complete the desired number of repetitions in both directions.

name: Kettlebell Snatch (Double)
steps: Begin with a two kettlebells between your legs, hinge at hips, then swing it upwards explosively.
As they rise, lock out arm overhead, wrist straight.
Control the descent, then repeat.

name: Walking Lunge
steps: Take a step forward shifting your weight onto the front leg.
Bend the knee of the front leg so the knee of the back leg comes close to the ground.
Stand up and go into lunging with the opposite leg.

name: Cardio Assault Bike
steps: Adjust seat and handlebar height for comfort and proper posture on the assault bike.
Start pedaling with even, controlled motion, maintaining your desired resistance level.
Monitor heart rate and intensity; increase or decrease resistance for an effective cardio workout.

name: Band Pallof Press
steps: Place the band at an anchor point that is shoulder height. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Start with your fingers interlocked around the band and your fists connected to your chest.
Extend at the elbows pressing the band away from your body until your elbows are fully extended.

name: Ring Twisting Chin Up
steps: Grab the rings shoulder width apart with a pronated grip (palms facing away).
With your body hanging and arms fully extended, pull yourself up and rotate your fists until your chin is past the rings.
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.

name: Cable Alternating Incline Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Lie on an incline bench, holding low cables with palms facing your feet.
Sweep one arm above your chest while maintaining a slight elbow bend.
Slowly lower the handle, then repeat with the opposite arm.

name: Cable Standing Hip Adduction
steps: Bring the cable all the way to the bottom of the stack. Use an ankle attachment.
Keeping your feet together, move your legs out to the sides and then back to the midline of your body. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Machine Goblet Sissy Squat
steps: Place the sissy squat pad just behind the knees and the front pad all the way up against your ankles.
Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Sit straight back into a squat. Then push your calves into the back of the pad and extend your knees back to the original position.

name: Cardio Single Leg Forward Hop
steps: Pick up one leg off the ground.
Hop forward and backward quickly while staying on your toes.

name: Plate Curtsy Lunge
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the torso.
Step back and across the body with the right foot, bending both legs to lower into a lunge position.
Push through the front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side by stepping back and across with the left foot.
Continue alternating sides for desired reps.

name: Cable Bar Reverse Grip Curl
steps: Use a bar attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm down. Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Kettlebell Situp
steps: Lay flat on your back with straight legs and hold the kettle bell above your chest at arms length.
Draw your belly into the base of your spine to engage the muscles, then raise your head and shoulders off the floor with the kettlebell raised at arms length above your chest.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Cardio Row Erg Rower Arms Only
steps: Make sure your feet are strapped in tightly.
Without bending your legs, pull the handle to your ribcage.
Fully extend your elbows before initiating the next rep.

name: Bodyweight Assisted Gironda Chin Up
steps: Grasp the chin-up bar with an underhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Place your feet on the ground, legs bent slightly.
Use your legs to assist as you pull your chest to the bar.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Heels Elevated Hip Thrust
steps: Start by lying on a bench with your foot on a plate or low box and a dumbbell on your hips.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Machine Hamstring Curl
steps: Lay down on the machine, placing your legs beneath the padded lever. Position your legs so that the padded lever is below your calve muscles.
Support yourself by grabbing the side handles of the machine, and slowly raise the weight with your legs, toes pointed straight.
Pause at the apex of the motion, then slowly return to starting position.

name: Cable Bayesian Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Dumbbell Laying Reverse Fly
steps: With dumbbells in either hand, lay on an incline bench that's at about 15-30 degrees.
With bent elbows, raise your arms up to shoulder level, pausing at the at the end of the motion.
Slowly lower your arms back to starting position.

name: One Arm Cow Face Pose
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your left knee and place your left foot on the floor, close to your right hip.
Cross your right leg over your left leg, stacking your knees on top of each other.
Bring your left arm up overhead, and bend your elbow so that your left hand reaches towards your upper back. Reach your right hand behind your back and try to clasp your left hand. Hold

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Reverse Incline Curl
steps: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor.
Take an overhand grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Medicine Ball Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back, place a medicine ball between your extended arms and bent knees.
Lower opposite arm and leg to floor, keeping back pressed against ground and medicine ball in place.
Alternate sides, maintain core engagement, and repeat for desired reps or time.

name: Dumbbell Full Front Raise
steps: Stand tall with an overhand grip on the dumbbell. Raise your arms until your fists are pointed toward the ceiling.
Return to the start under control. This exercise is prone to using momentum when you begin to fatigue.

name: Table Top Pose Variation 2
steps: Beginner
Start in a tabletop position on your hands and knees with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
Turn your hands so that your fingers are pointing towards your knees and the tops of your hands are on the floor.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold the pose for several breaths or as long as is comfortable.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Stability Ball Wall Squat
steps: Place a stability ball against a wall at about hip height.
Hold two dumbbells in front rack position.
Break at the hips and knees until you hit parallel or just below, then squat back up.

name: Bosu Serratus Activation Active Plank
steps: Support your weight on your forearms and toes (plank).
Allow your upper back to sink in between the shoulder blades.
Push your elbows into the ground and slightly forward, and move the shoulder blades away from the spine.

name: Band High Hammer Curl
steps: Start with the band anchored to something high with your feet staggered and a neutral grip.
Keep your elbows high. Curl until your fists are at your forehead.

name: Medicine Ball Ball Headlock Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding medicine ball close.
Squat down, keeping ball close to head and chest.
Stand back up, squeezing glutes. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Walking Calf Raises
steps: Walk forward and push your toe into the ground
Lift you heel off the ground each step and tense your calf muscle
Repeat on each leg and walk forward slowly

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Arnold Press
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder, with your palm facing you and your elbow bent.
From this starting position, extend your arm upwards so that the dumbbell is directly above your head.
As you extend your arm, rotate your palm to face away from your body.

name: Kettlebell Push Press
steps: Start with kettlebell in rack position.
Dip at knees and hips.
Explosively push kettlebell overhead, fully extending arms.

name: Barbell Spinal Jefferson Curl
steps: Stand on a platform holding barbell in front with feet hip-width apart.
Slowly roll down through spine one vertebra at a time, reaching toward toes.
Reverse the motion, rolling up through spine until standing tall again.

name: Front Rowing Preps Second Position Seated
steps: Sit tall with legs extended, arms holding straps at chest height.
Start with elbows bent, hands in front, palms facing in.
Open arms wide to second position, squeezing upper back.
Return with control, maintaining upright posture and steady strap tension.

name: Cable Bar Front Raise
steps: Face away from the cables.
With your elbows extended raise your fists straight up to the ceiling until they are at eye level.

name: Machine Tricep Pushdown
steps: Sit on the machine and place the back of your upper arm on the bench.
Extend your elbows until you feel a contraction in your triceps.
Bring the weight back to the starting position.

name: Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

name: Kettlebell Conventional Deadlift (Double)
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Bend at hips and knees to lift kettlebells.
Stand tall, then lower.

name: Cable Standing Single Arm Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Stand sideways to cable and hold handle at shoulder height, arm slightly bent.
Rotate palm inward and bring arm across chest in a sweeping arc.
Squeeze chest at end range, then return slowly while maintaining internal rotation.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Calf Raise
steps: Standing straight with a dumbbell in one hand, lift the same foot as the side without the dumbbell off the floor. Hold onto something for balance.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Overhead Press
steps: Start with both dumbbells near your shoulders in a neutral grip.
Press the dumbbells toward the ceiling.
Make sure you don't arch your back as you fatigue.

name: Kettlebell Step Up
steps: Standing up straight, using a bench as a step, raise one foot onto the bench and hold the kettlebell in the same arm as the straight leg.
Stand and bring both feet onto the bench. Slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat.

name: Shoulders Stretch Variation One
steps: Reach one arm behind your body, with your elbow pointing upward behind your head.
Assist the stretch with your other hand on your elbow to engage your shoulder.
Pause for a few seconds, then repeat the stretch with your other arm.

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Find a box or bench that is roughly knee height or a few inches lower. (The lower the box is the lower the mobility requirement).
You can either place your toes or the top of your foot on the box. Point your front foot forward or slightly turned outwards and break at the knees and hips simultaneously.
Aim to get your front leg to hit parallel depth (hamstring parallel with the ground) or lower.
The further forward your front foot is, the longer the Range of Motion is at your hips. The further back your front foot is, the longer the ROM at your knees.

name: TRX Forearm Side Plank
steps: Lie on your side with your legs straight and your feet resting in the TRX foot cradles.
Prop yourself up on your forearm and engage your core to maintain a straight line from your head to your feet.

name: Cardio Box Quick Feet
steps: Stay light on your toes and tap both feet to the ground in quick succession.
Move in a square pattern.

name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Floor Fly
steps: Lie on your back holding dumbbells above chest with palms turned downward.
Lower arms out wide while maintaining internal rotation and slight elbow bend.
Bring dumbbells back together over chest, squeezing pecs at the top.

name: Kettlebell Kickstand Squat
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, one foot slightly behind. Hold kettlebell in a goblet position.
Lower into a squat, keeping weight on front heel.
Return to standing, engaging glutes and core.

name: Kettlebell Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive
steps: Hold kettlebells in front rack position and place one foot on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping chest tall and core tight.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Upright Row
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and chest lifted, engage your core to maintain balance.
Begin the movement by lifting the dumbbell straight up towards your chin, keeping your elbow close to your body and the weight in line with your shoulder.
Continue to lift the weight until it reaches the chin or neck level, keeping the elbow high and close to the body.
Lower the weight back down to the starting position with control.

name: Landmine Goblet Curtsy Lunge
steps: Start facing the barbell while holding the end of the bar in the goblet position in front of your chest with your elbows close to your sides.
Step backward and across your body with one leg at a
degree angle while keeping your weight on your front heel to gently lower your back knee to the ground.
Drive through your front heel as you step back up and to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching legs.

name: Cable Single Arm Bench Chest Fly
steps: Bring a bench over to the cables, set the cable just below shoulder height.
Bring the handle to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Press the weight forward. From there, your shoulder should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbow stays in a fixed position.

name: Cardio Ski Erg
steps: Leap sideways, land on right foot, left leg behind to the side.
Drop into a single-leg burpee, right leg only, hands to ground.
Return to standing on right, leap sideways to left, repeat with left leg.

name: Smith Machine Reverse Crunch Hip Raise
steps: Lay flat on the ground. With your feet on the bar.
Lift your hips off the ground.

name: Kettlebell Front Rack Squat
steps: Hold kettlebells close to chest.
Squat down, keeping chest up.
Stand up, extending hips fully.

name: Medicine Ball Chest Press Toss
steps: Stand in front of a wall holding a medicine ball.
Press the ball forward, extending arms and tossing it.
Catch the ball and return to the starting position.

name: Hundred
steps: Lie supine, legs tabletop or extended, arms reaching long by sides.
Lift head and shoulders, engage core, gaze toward thighs.
Pump arms vigorously, inhaling five counts, exhaling five counts.
Maintain stable torso and strong abdominals for one hundred counts.

name: Barbell Bradford Press
steps: Hold a barbell at shoulder height with a pronated grip.
Press the barbell over your head.
Lower it behind your head, then return to the front. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Cardio Skater To Single Leg Burpee
steps: Leap sideways, land on right foot, left leg behind to the side.
Drop into a single-leg burpee, right leg only, hands to ground.
Return to standing on right, leap sideways to left, repeat with left leg.

name: Hamstrings Stretch Variation One
steps: Lie down with your legs reaching up the wall. your bum should be slightly off the floor.
Bend one leg and leave the other outstretched.
Push your thigh towards the wall.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then return to starting position.

name: Weighted Plank Up Down
steps: Start from a plank position. Place a plate on your back.
Go to one elbow then the other. Try to avoid rocking back and forth.

name: Bosu Ball Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on Bosu, lean back, hands on the floor.
Drive hips upward, squeezing glutes.
Lower hips back down to complete one rep.

name: Side Shoulder Girdle Stability Circles
steps: Stand sideways to a wall. Pin a gym ball between your palm and the wall (elbow straight).
Push your arm into the ball without leaning into it.
While applying pressure, form the sign of the cross (up/down/left/right) and circles.

name: Bosu Ball Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand on Bosu, step sideways into a lunge.
Bend knee, keeping the other leg straight.
Push off the bent leg, return to starting position.

name: Cable Kneeling Bilateral Pull In
steps: Use a handle attachment set all the way to the top of the cable crossover machine.
Kneel in the middle of the cable crossover.
Face your palm up toward the ceiling. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage.

name: Barbell Zercher Deficit Lunge
steps: Begin by standing with your feet on a plate and holding a barbell in the crook of your arms, near your belly. Your palms should be facing towards your body.
Step back with one foot off the plate and lower your back knee to the floor.
Push through your front leg and bring your back foot to the plate.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Forward Lunge
steps: Stand straight with your feet slightly apart and hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Bring the same leg as the arm holding the kettlebell in front of you, squat down until your thigh is parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Smith Machine Side Plank Up Down
steps: Start by lying on your side with your feet stacked on top of each other and the bar on your hip.
Place your bottom elbow on the ground beneath your shoulder and engage your core to raise your hips off the ground.
Your hips will do all the moving. Think, "hips up, hips down."

name: Plate Bicep Curl
steps: Hold plate in both hands.
Flex your elbows until the plate nears your chest.
Extend your elbows until they are fully extended.

name: Bodyweight Waiters Bow
steps: Place a barbell at about midway up your thigh. Press your quads into the barbell.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Gastrocnemius Stretch Unilateral On Wall
steps: Stand by a wall but not too close.
Place the palms on the wall and extend one leg behind you, while slightly bending the front leg.
Push the wall in order to drive the heel of the extended leg into the ground till you feel a stretch in your calf.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
steps: Hold the dumbbells with a neutral grip (thumbs facing the ceiling).
Slowly lift the dumbbell up to chest height
Return to starting position and repeat.

name: Bosu Ball Situp
steps: Lie on back, bosu elevated toward the ceiling.
Sit up, engaging core muscles.
Lower back down to complete one situp.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
steps: Bring your elbows to the floor, rest for a second to remove all the momentum from the rep, then press to a lockout.

name: Barbell Low Bar Good Morning
steps: Place the bar between your traps and rear delts. Pull your shoulder blades back to give the bar a shelf to sit on.
Push your hips back until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings. This means you're nearing the end of your Range of Motion with out rounding your spine.
When you feel the stretch push your hips forward until you'e in a standing position.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Twisting Curl
steps: Sit on incline bench holding dumbbell at side, palm facing inward.
Curl dumbbell while twisting palm toward shoulder.

name: Machine Donkey Calf Raise
steps: Adjust the machine to fit your height. Place your elbows on the pad, grab the handles. The vertical pad should be resting on your lower back.
Raise your heels toward the ceiling.

name: Plate Staggered Waiters Bow
steps: Set up a bar at mid way up your quad. Place the working leg against the bar.
Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.

name: Bosu Ball Wood Chopper
steps: Stand tall holding the bosu.
Swing bosu diagonally across the body.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Curl
steps: Stand up straight with a kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis.
Raise the kettlebell bending your arms at the elbow until the kettlebell is level with your chest.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

name: Cable Braced Wrist Curl
steps: Stand facing cable, brace forearm on support with palm up holding handle.
Lower wrist slowly to feel stretch in forearm flexors.
Curl wrist upward, squeezing forearm at the top.

name: Cardio Band Hammer Curl Jacks
steps: Stand with a band looped under both feet and the band grasped in both hands.
Do a light hop and bring your feet outward while simultaneously flexing the elbows.
Bring both feet back together and extend the elbows.

name: Bodyweight Hands Up Push Ups
steps: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body. Bring chest all the way to the floor and raise hands off the ground.
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Quad Stomp
steps: Place your front foot on a low box and take a split stance. Put all of your weight on your front foot.
Break at the knees and lower yourself until your calves touch your hamstrings.
Push yourself back to the starting position.

name: Cable Braced Single Arm Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Stand sideways to cable, hinge forward, and hold handle at shoulder height with an internally rotated shoulder.
Brace free hand against support, then bring working arm across chest in an arc.
Squeeze chest at the end, then slowly return to starting position.

name: Barbell Power Snatch
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, barbell over midfoot. Grip the bar wide (outside shoulders), hook grip recommended.
Keep chest up, back straight, and drive through heels to lift the bar off the ground, keeping it close to your body.
As the bar reaches mid-thigh, explode upwards by extending hips, knees, and ankles, shrugging shoulders and pulling the bar high.
Drop under the bar slightly, catching it overhead with arms locked out. Stand up fully to complete the lift.

name: Kettlebell Larsen Press
steps: Start in a bench press position with your legs elevated. Try to keep your knees with a slight bend in them.
Lower kettlebells toward chest while keeping legs elevated and torso stable.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without arching lower back.

name: Machine Bicep Curl
steps: Adjust the seat to fit your height and place your elbows on the elbow pad.
Grab the handles and flex your elbows.

name: Machine 45 Degree Back Extension
steps: Position your thighs on the padding and hook your feet on the platform supports.
Keeping your back straight, slowly bend at your waist until your legs and back are at a 45° angle.
Slowly raise your body to the starting position.

name: Landmine Bicep Curl
steps: Stand beside the landmine with your feet shoulder-width apart while grasping the end of the landmine barbell with the hand farther away from the landmine attachment, palm facing up and your elbow close to your side.
Curl the barbell up towards your opposite shoulder, contracting your bicep muscles, then slowly lower the barbell back down.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

name: Mini Band Jump Squat
steps: Loop band above knees, stand feet shoulder width.
Squat down, knees pushed outward against band.
Explode upward into jump, land softly and reset.

name: Kettlebell Bottoms Up Overhead Press
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a kettlebell in each hand with the bottom of the kettlebell facing up.
Bring the kettlebells to your shoulders, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, extend your arms upwards so that the kettlebells are overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Medicine Ball Partner Side Toss
steps: Stand facing partner, side by side.
Toss medicine ball to partner's side.
Catch and repeat toss on other side.

name: Dumbbell Leg Extension
steps: Place a dumbbell between your feet. Lean back slightly and hold on to the bench.
Extend your knees until you feel your quads contract hard.

name: Scapular Elevation
steps: From the standing or seated position straighten your back.
Pull the shoulders back but keep them relaxed.
Move shoulders towards from your ears and return to the starting, relaxed position.

name: Cardio Lateral Shuffle
steps: Start with a wide stance.
Shuffle sideways for a specified distance while maintaining a quarter squat position.

name: TRX Rear Delt Row
steps: Stand facing away from the TRX straps and grab the handles with both hands.
Step away so your body is leaning away from the anchor point.
Flex your elbows and pull your elbows straight back behind your body.
Make sure to keep your elbows flared outward.

name: Stability Ball Sissy Squat
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, stability ball behind your back against a wall.
Lean back onto the ball, bend knees forward, lowering slowly while keeping hips extended.
Push through toes, straighten legs, and return to standing while maintaining balance and control.

name: Band High Face Pull
steps: Start with a band anchored to a high point. Stagger your stance.
Pull the band to the bridge of your nose.

name: Cable Bent Over Bar Pullover
steps: You can use any attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward somewhat.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. Imagine trying to pull the attachment through your thighs at the bottom.

name: Shoulder Flexion Thoracic Extensions
steps: Place a tube roller or half tube on the ground parallel to your body.
Lie on the tube making sure your whole back and neck are supported.
Knees bent and on the ground, lower back flat on the tube and chin tucked in.
Bring your arms by you hips and pull shoulders back.
This is your starting position. Raise arms and drop them back towards the ground over your head

name: Cable Standing Low To High Wood Chopper
steps: Stand sideways to cable and grasp handle near hip level with both hands.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally upward toward opposite shoulder.
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.

name: Cable Standing Alternating Incline Chest Press
steps: Stand facing away from low cables with handles beside your chest.
Press one handle forward and upward until your arm is extended.
Return under control, then press with the opposite arm.

name: Trap Bar Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand inside trap bar, grip handles, stand tall.
Step one foot backward into lunge position.
Lower until front thigh is parallel to ground.
Push through front heel to return standing.

name: Crescent Moon Pose Quad Stretch With Block
steps: Begin in Crescent Moon Pose with your right foot forward and a block nearby.
Place the block at the highest height under your left hand.
Reach your left arm behind you and take hold of your left foot or ankle.

Gently pull your foot towards your buttocks while pressing your left hand into the block to deepen the stretch in your left quad. Hold for a few breaths before releasing and repeating on the other side.

name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
steps: Lay on a bench with two dumbbells extended in front of you.
You should have a slight bend in your elbows and maintain that bend. Your shoulder joint should do all the movement.
Bring the dumbbells out to your side. Stop the dumbbells before going behind your body.
Bring the dumbbells back together at the top.

name: Stair Climber
steps: Step onto step, grip handles lightly, maintain tall posture and neutral spine.
Drive through midfoot, alternate steps smoothly, avoid leaning heavily on handles.
Set moderate pace, breathe rhythmically, keep knees tracking over toes.

name: Barbell Situp
steps: Hold the bar with a slightly wider than shoulder width grip. Push the bar up toward the ceiling and maintain that elbow extension.
Flex your abs and sit-up. Aim to get your torso vertical while maintaining the barbell overhead.

name: Cable Rope Kneeling Face Pull
steps: Start with the cables at the top. Use a rope attachment. Fall to a half kneeling position.
Pull the metal piece in the middle of the rope to the bridge of your nose.

name: Half Monkey Pose
steps: Start in a tabletop position with your hands and knees on the floor.
Step your right foot forward, placing it between your hands.
Straighten your right leg and flex your toes towards your face, keeping your hands on the floor for support.
Hold for several breaths, then switch sides and repeat.

name: Cable Incline Bench Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cables should be set fairly low.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

name: Dumbbell External Rotation
steps: Hold a dumbbell in one hand, elbow bent at 90 degrees while resting on your inner thigh/ knee.
Rotate your arm outward, keeping your elbow stable.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Row
steps: Start by standing in front of a flat bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Place your other hand on the bench for support, and bend at the waist so that your chest is parallel to the ground.
From this starting position, row the dumbbell up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blade together as you do so.
Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.

name: Band Curl
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, with the band under both feet.
Grasp the handles of the band with both hands, keeping your arms straight and extended in front of you.
Keep your back straight, abs engaged, and shoulders relaxed as you curl your hands towards your shoulders, bending at the elbows.

name: Standing Shoulder Flexion Mobility
steps: From the standing position grab the dowel with one arm, thumb on top, in front of the centre of your body.
Grab the dowel with your other arm to the side and behind your body.
The arm that is back, guides the other in front of you and into the overhead position.

name: Medicine Ball Reverse Lunge Twist
steps: Hold medicine ball at chest.
Step back into lunge position, extend your arms, twist torso.
Return to starting position. Repeat on other leg.

name: Barbell Seated Full Front Raise
steps: Sit on an incline bench with an overhand grip on the barbell. Raise your arms until your fists are pointed toward the ceiling.
Return to the start under control. This exercise is prone to using momentum when you begin to fatigue.

name: Treadmill Backwards Walk
steps: Face the opposite direction on the treadmill.
Hold on to the arms to find your balance.
Walk backwards pushing your toes through the front of your shoes.

name: Single Leg Slider Hamstring Curl 2
steps: Beginner
Lie on your back with bent knees and heels on a slider.
Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back on the ground).
Press the heels into the ground to raise your hips off it.
Extend and bend the working leg.

name: Barbell Single Leg Hip Thrust
steps: Start by lying on a bench with your foot on the ground and a barbell on your hips.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Barbell Supinated Pendlay Row
steps: Begin by standing in front of a barbell with your feet about hip-width apart and your palms facing towards your body.
Bend at the hips and knees to grab the barbell with a pronated (overhand) grip, positioning the barbell about an inch away from your shins.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, use your back muscles to lift the barbell straight up towards your chest.
As the barbell reaches your chest, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing towards your body (supinated grip), and then lower the barbell back to the starting position.

name: Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands
steps: Begin in Warrior II pose, with your right foot forward and your left foot back.
Bring your hands together in a prayer position at your heart.
Exhale and twist your torso to the right, placing your left elbow on the outside of your right knee.
Hold for several breaths and then repeat on the other side.

name: Kettlebell Lateral Lunge (Single)
steps: Stand straight with your feet shoulder width apart. Keep your back straight and hold the kettlebell in front of your pelvis.
Take a large step to one side, holding the kettlebell low and lunge into the bent leg.
Return to the starting position and repeat

name: Stability Ball Atomic Push Up
steps: Place feet on a stability ball, hands on the floor in a push-up position.
Lower your chest toward the floor, then push up while tucking knees toward your chest.
Extend legs back to starting position, maintaining control and stability throughout the movement.

name: Seated Ulnar Nerve Slider
steps: Abduct your arm at 90° palm facing down.
Bend your elbow and wrist bringing your front of your fingertips to your temple while leaning the head towards the the arm.
Lean the head away from the arm as you extend the elbow and flex the wrist.
Alternate between positions to mobilise the ulnar nerve.

name: Cable Decline Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Lie on a bench, holding cables higher than shoulder height with palms facing your feet.
Sweep both handles together above your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause briefly, then lower your arms under control.

name: Weighted Push Ups
steps: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders. Place a plate on your back.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.

name: Plate Deficit Pushup
steps: Start in a pushup position with both hands on a plate. This will extend your range of motion.
Break at the elbows and shoulders until your upper arm travels behind the body slightly.
Then press back into the original position.

name: Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift
steps: Stand with feet wide apart, toes pointing slightly outward, and kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
Bend at hips and knees, keeping back straight, and grip the kettlebell handle.
Lift the kettlebell by extending hips and knees, stand up straight, and return to the starting position.

name: Landmine Hack Squat
steps: Start facing away from the landmine attachment with the end of the barbell resting on one shoulder against the base of your neck while leaning slightly back into the weight of the barbell.

Squat down with control while keeping the weight of the barbell as close to centered over your midpoint as possible, then drive through your heels to stand all the way back up and return to starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps, then switch the side of your body the barbell is on every subsequent set.

name: Mini Band Side Laying Hip Abduction
steps: Loop band above knees, lie on side legs straight.
Lift top leg upward without rotating hips.
Lower slowly, maintaining constant band tension.

name: Kettlebell Clean And Press
steps: Start with kettlebells between legs.
Swing kettlebells up to shoulder.
Press kettlebells overhead.

name: Plate Hollow Hold
steps: Lay flat on the ground with your arms extended over head holding a weight plate.
Pick your upper back and your legs off the ground. Your body should be in a banana shape.

name: Biceps Stretch Variation Four
steps: Stand an arms width away from the wall.
Raise your arms out behind you, and place them on the wall with your fingers pointing up.
Bend your knees whilst keeping your hands in the same position.

name: Calves Stretch Variation One
steps: Place the ball of your foot against the wall with your heel on the ground. Place your hands on the wall in front of your shoulders.
Keeping your knee straight, slowly lean towards the wall, pause for a few seconds when you feel the stretch extending through your calf muscle.
Return to the starting position, and repeat the stretch with your other leg.

name: Cable Zercher Squat
steps: Start with a straight bar or easy bar attachment .
Place the bar in your elbows, squat straight up and then walk back a few steps.
Break at your knees and hips to initiate the squat. Make sure you maintain a flat back.
Squat all the way back to a standing position.

name: Barbell 30 Degree Shrug
steps: Hold barbell with a wide grip. Your arms should be at a roughly
degree angle.
Pull your shoulders towards your ears instead of straight up toward the ceiling.

name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Rolling Curl
steps: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips pushed toward the ceiling.
Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Long Stretch Plank Position
steps: Place hands on footbar, shoulders over wrists, legs extended long.
Engage core and glutes, forming a straight line head to heels.
Press heels back, protract shoulders slightly, neck neutral.
Hold with steady breathing and full-body tension.

name: Corpse Pose
steps: Lie down on your back with your legs straight and arms at your sides.
Close your eyes and take deep breaths in through your nose and out through your mouth.
Allow your body to completely relax and let go of any tension.
Hold for several minutes and then slowly come back up to a seated position.

name: Machine Overhand Overhead Press
steps: Adjust the seat to match your height.
Press your back into the back pad.
Press upwards until your elbows are nearly extended. But not fully extended.
Lower until the plates nearly touch back down.

name: Machine Standing Plate Loaded Preacher Curl
steps: Rest the back of your arms on the preacher bench.
Grab the handles. Curl the weight up until your elbows are fully flexed.
Lower until the point just before the weight rests at the bottom.

name: Mini Band Tricep Pushdown
steps: Loop band around wrists.
Keep one hand at shoulder height and press your other hand down.

name: Hamstring Bridge With Elevated Legs Box Bilateral
steps: Lie on your back. Place your heels on a box or bench, having a 90° angle at hips and knees.
Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back against the ground).
Push through your heels into the box, lifting your hips up to the point where there is a straight line from your chest to your knees.

name: Wide Legged Standing Forward Bend Holding Heels
steps: Start standing at the top of your mat with your feet wide apart.
Exhale and fold forward from your hips, bringing your hands up and over your head towards the ground.
Hold for a few breaths and then release the hands and come back up to standing.

name: Cable High Single Arm Reverse Rolling Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set at elbow level.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards, as you curl hinge forward.
As you extend your elbow, also extend your hips until you are back in a standing position.

name: Bosu Ball Calf Raise
steps: Stand on Bosu with feet hip-width apart.
Rise up on toes, squeezing calves.
Lower heels back down to complete one rep.

name: Mini Band Plank Step Out
steps: Loop band around ankles, hold high plank.
Step one foot outward, resisting band pull.
Return and alternate, maintaining stable hips.

name: Mini Band Standing Hip Abduction
steps: Loop band around ankles, stand tall holding support.
Lift one leg out to side, torso upright.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Machine Neutral Overhead Press
steps: Adjust the seat to match your height.
Press your back into the back pad.
Press upwards until your elbows are nearly extended. But not fully extended.
Lower until the plates nearly touch back down.

name: Warrior Three
steps: Start in mountain pose, standing with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Step your left foot back about 3-4 feet and raise it off the ground, while keeping your right foot facing forward.
Inhale and reach your arms forward, parallel to the ground.
Exhale and hinge forward at your hips, bringing your torso parallel to the ground and extending your left leg straight back. Keep your arms and right leg straight and hold the pose for a few breaths
inhale and return to mountain pose. Repeat on the other side.

name: Landmine Single Arm Staggered Overhead Press
steps: Stand facing the bar in a split stance with one leg forward and bent and the other back and straight. Hold the bar in the hand on the side of the leg that is back with the end of the bar at your shoulder with your elbow tucked beneath your hand.
Drive the bar upwards until your arm is fully extended. Pause briefly before lowering the end of the bar back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

name: Machine Hack Squat
steps: Position yourself in the hack squat machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Place feet shoulder-width apart on the platform. Keep your back straight, and slowly lower into a squat position.
Press through your heels to return to the starting position, keeping your core engaged. Repeat for desired reps and sets.

name: Plate Front Raise
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the torso, palms facing the thighs.
Keeping the elbows slightly bent, lift the plate up to the front of the body.
Raise the plate up until the arms are fully extended, maintaining control of the plate.
Lower the plate back to the starting position and repeat for desired reps.

name: Bodyweight Staggered Waiters Bow
steps: Set up a bar at mid way up your quad. Place the working leg against the bar.
Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.

name: Butt Kick
steps: Stand tall, jog in place, bringing heels toward your glutes.
Keep your core tight and swing arms naturally.
Alternate legs quickly, maintaining a steady rhythm.

name: EZ Bar Preacher Curl
steps: Position yourself on preacher bench; grasp EZ bar with underhand grip, elbows extended.
Slowly curl bar towards shoulders; keep upper arms stationary, focus on biceps.
Lower bar back to starting position; maintain control, repeat for reps.

name: Band Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Stand with one or both feet on band. Go up and over your head with the band to the starting position.
Flex and extend your elbows.

name: Stability Ball Straight Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back, heels on a stability ball, legs straight, arms by your sides.
Press through your heels, lift hips, engage glutes and core, forming a straight line.
Slowly lower hips, maintaining control, then repeat for reps.

name: Machine Rear Deltoid Row
steps: Place your chest against the pad and grab the handles with an overhand grip.
Pull your elbows straight back and keep your elbows flared throughout the rep.

name: Trap Bar Single Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand inside trap bar, lift one foot slightly off ground.
Hinge hips back while lowering bar and extending free leg behind.
Keep hips square and back neutral throughout movement.
Drive through standing foot to return upright.

name: Barbell Clean And Jerk
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, grip the bar just outside your knees. Pull the bar from the floor by driving through your legs, keeping your back straight.
As the bar reaches your hips, extend explosively, shrug, and drop under to catch it in a front squat position with elbows high. Stand up tall.
Dip slightly, then drive through your legs to push the bar overhead.
Stabilize the bar overhead, lock arms, then bring feet together before lowering the bar safely.

name: Forward Arm Circle
steps: Hold your arms out to your sides.
Rotate your arms forward in small circles.

name: Machine Horizontal Leg Press Calf Raise
steps: Adjust the machine in accordance with your height.
The balls of your feet should be supporting your weight on the bottom of the platform, your heels extending off of it.
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.

name: Barbell Low Bar Squat
steps: Pull your shoulder blades back really hard and place the bar on your posterior delts.
Push your hips back and break at the knees to initiate the squat.
Aim to get your hamstrings to parallel with the ground. Push your heels into the floor and squat back up to a standing position.

name: Footwork Heels On The Bar
steps: Lie supine, heels on bar hip-width, toes lifted slightly.
Press bar away, fully extending legs without locking knees.
Maintain neutral pelvis, ribs down, and steady core engagement.
Bend knees to return with control, keeping heels connected.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Rear Delt Row
steps: Hinge at hips with back flat, holding dumbbell under shoulder with arm extended.
Pull elbow out and back at a wide angle, targeting rear delt.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to full stretch.

name: Ez Bar Overhead Press
steps: Take a roughly shoulder width grip. There should be a straight line from your elbow to fist (vertical forearms).
Pull your chin back and press the weight toward the ceiling by extending at the elbow joint and flexing at the shoulder joint.
Press until your elbows are extended and push your head forward slightly.
Return to the start position with control. Pulling your chin back to allow the bar to pass your face safely.

name: Medicine Ball Thruster
steps: Hold medicine ball at chest with elbows tucked and feet shoulder-width.
