Squat down until thighs are parallel, keeping chest tall.
Drive upward and press ball overhead in one smooth motion.

name: Barbell Guillotine Incline Bench Press
steps: Set bench to moderate incline and grip bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower bar toward upper chest or neck, keeping elbows out wide.
Press bar back up in a straight line over shoulders.

name: Barbell Figure Four Heels Elevated Hip Thrust
steps: Put your shoulder blades on a bench and cross one leg over the other. Put one foot on a low box or plate.
Start with your hips up.
Drop your hips and then push your hips up toward the ceiling.

name: Kettlebell Russian Twist
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs bent, knees together and feet raised slightly off the floor.

Starting on one side and sitting up straight with your core muscles engaged, lift the kettlebell off the floor with both hands and bring it across your body to the other side, rotating your chest towards the floor as you do so.
Tap the kettlebell lightly on the floor and bring the kettlebell back across your body to the starting position, rotating your chest towards the floor.
Repeat, keeping the legs bent and feet raised throughout the exercise.

name: Band Side Bend
steps: Stand with band anchored low on one side, holding handle at hip.
Lean torso away from anchor, keeping hips and legs still.
Contract obliques to return upright, maintaining smooth control.

name: Side Splits Skating
steps: Stand on reformer, feet on platforms, hinged forward, spine neutral.
Push carriage out.
Return to center with control, maintaining upright posture.

name: Ez Bar Reverse Curl
steps: Take a double overhand grip that's about shoulder width. Flex your elbows while keeping your elbows tucked in. Try not to let them flare out.
Curl until your forearm presses into your bicep. Then fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep.

name: Band Front Raise
steps: Stand on the band with one or
feet depending on how heavy you want the band to be.
With your elbows extended raise your fists straight up to the ceiling until they are at eye level.

name: Warrior One
steps: Start in mountain pose, standing with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Step your left foot back about 3-4 feet and turn it slightly inward, while keeping your right foot facing forward.
Inhale and raise your arms overhead, then exhale and bend your right knee, bringing it directly over your ankle.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, then inhale and return to mountain pose. Repeat on the other side.

name: Kettlebell Windmill Bottom Hand
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart. Hold the kettlebell in your bottom hand and extend the other arm above your head.
Keeping your legs straight and the kettlebell inside your thigh, lower the kettlebell towards the ground, twisting your body towards the side of the raised arm.
Return to the starting position, tilt your pelvis forward and repeat.

name: Cable Kneeling Straight Arm Pull In
steps: Kneel between high cables, holding the handle with your outside arms extended.
Face your palms downward. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage.

name: Machine Standing Hamstring Curl
steps: Press yourself into the pads and put your calves against the lower pads.
Flex your knee until you feel a contraction in your hamstring, then lower back to the start.

name: Cable Seated Single Arm Face Pull
steps: Sit facing cable and hold handle with arm extended at shoulder height.
Pull handle toward upper face while driving elbow outward and back.
Squeeze rear delt, then return slowly, maintaining control.

name: Barbell Hang Clean And Press
steps: Hold bar just above knees with slight bend in hips and knees.
Explosively pull bar to shoulders, catching it in a partial squat.
Stand tall and press bar overhead until arms are fully extended.

name: Dumbbell Superman Hold
steps: Lie face down on a mat.
Hold dumbbells out in front
Lift arms and legs simultaneously, squeezing lower back.

name: Bosu Ball Walkover Pushup
steps: Place both hands on Bosu, wider than shoulder-width.
Perform a pushup, then walk hands to the other side.
Perform another pushup, repeat back and forth.

name: Band Press Around
steps: Stand with band behind you and hold loop at chest height.
Press one arm forward and across your body in a sweeping arc.
Squeeze chest at full extension, then return slowly and switch sides.

name: Shoulder Abduction Stretch
steps: Stand sideways to a wall.
Raise the arm that is on the side of the wall and place the blade of the palm against the wall.
Slide your arm up over your head and step in towards the wall to increase the stretch.

name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge
steps: Lay flat on the ground with both feet planted. Make sure you keep your heels glued to the floor.
Place the dumbbell on your hips. Push your hips toward the ceiling until you feel your glutes contract.
Then return to the floor.

name: Band Single Arm Pec Fly
steps: Attach the band to an anchor point that is about shoulder height. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Extend your shoulder joint and bring your arm across your body until you feel a contraction in your pecs.

name: Lower back Stretch Variation Two
steps: Lay flat on the floor with your arms at either side.
With one leg, hook one foot under the joint of your other leg.
Rotate your hips so that your knees are pointing sideways, keeping your hooked leg flat against the floor.
Pause at the apex of the stretch and repeat with your other leg.

name: Plate Reach
steps: Start in a standing position with a plate against your chest.
Press the plate away from your body until your elbows are extended.

name: Cable Single Arm Rear Delt Row
steps: Use a handle attachment, grab with an overhand grip and take a position with the cable crossing your body.
Pull your elbows back while flaring your elbows outward.

name: Mountain
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.
Press your feet into the ground and engage your leg muscles.
Lift your chest and roll your shoulders back and down.
Take a deep breath in, and as you exhale, release any tension in your body and relax your muscles.

name: Stability Ball Goblet Wall Squat
steps: Place a stability ball against a wall at about hip height.
Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Break at the hips and knees until you hit parallel or just below, then squat back up.
